input: Eight types of marriage in classical texts
outcome: Brahma, Daiva, Arsha, Prajapatya, Gandharva (love), Asura (bride sold), Rakshasa (kidnap), Paisacha (forced)
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Houses to read for marriage: 2, 4, 7, 8, 12
outcome: 2nd=family, 4th=comfort, 7th=spouse/partnership, 8th=mangalya and in-laws, 12th=bed pleasure
strength_note: Check D-1 and D-9 both
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Check D-1 and D-9 (and D-4 for home comforts) for marriage promise
outcome: Marriage is judged from D-1 and D-9 together; afflictions in them reduce the promise
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Female marriage age bands
outcome: Early below 22; timely 22-26; delayed 26-30; very delayed above 30
strength_note: Also depends on country, time and place
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Marriage promise from birth: judge 7th house, 7th lord, Lagna lord, Jupiter, Venus, 2nd house and Venus condition in D-9
outcome: These factors show whether and how early marriage will happen
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: 7th house/7th lord, Jupiter, Venus, 2nd house free of malefic affliction
outcome: Early marriage
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Mild affliction on 7th/7th lord with some benefic aspect, e.g. afflicted Jupiter aspecting
outcome: Marriage at a timely age
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Strong affliction of the 1-7 axis, no Jupiter aspect, Venus combust or in malefic influence
outcome: Delayed marriage
strength_note: If some benefic influence exists, marriage can still happen
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Marriage timing by dasha, then transit
outcome: Dasha of lord of 7th, Lagna lord, 2nd lord, or Venus/Rahu related to 2nd or 7th house gives marriage
strength_note: Double transit of Jupiter and Saturn on 7th/7th lord confirms
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Transit of Jupiter and Saturn (double transit) over 7th house or 7th lord
outcome: Triggers marriage when running dasha supports
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Malefics in 1st, 2nd and 7th house and 7th lord in fall or enemy sign or eclipsed (combust)
outcome: Possible more than one marriage
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Lords of 7th and 11th associated or in mutual aspect
outcome: Indication of a second marriage (as noted)
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Venus and 7th lord both in dual signs and dual navamsha
outcome: Combination for more than one marriage
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Kundli matching step 1: Ayu milan
outcome: Check longevity of both boy and girl and any widowhood combination before matching
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Kundli matching step 2: Graha milan
outcome: Compare 7th (married life), 4th (comfort), 12th (bed), 5th (children), 2nd (family) of both charts; if both have equal affliction it is acceptable
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Kundli matching step 3: cross-chart reading
outcome: Take partner's 7th house as Lagna in the other chart and see if afflictions increase or reduce
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Kundli matching step 4: dasha comparison
outcome: Compare current and coming dashas of both partners from own and partner's chart
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Ashtakoot milan total 36 points
outcome: Eight kootas with points: Varna 1, Vashya 2, Tara 3, Yoni 4, Graha maitri 5, Gana 6, Bhakoot 7, Nadi 8
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Tara milan: count nakshatra number from one to other and divide by 9
outcome: Remainder 3, 5 or 7 is malefic, others benefic; benefic gives 1.5 points each way, up to 3
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Yoni milan: animal pairs of nakshatras
outcome: Same yoni 4 points, friendly 3, neutral 2, inimical 1, highly inimical 0
strength_note: Natural enemies include cow-tiger, serpent-mongoose, dog-deer, cat-rat
source: Marriage Part1 (Drive notes)

input: Graha maitri koota: lords of the two Moon signs are mutual friends
outcome: Full 5 points; one friendly and other neutral 4; both neutral 3; one friendly and other enemy 1; one neutral and other enemy 0.5
source: Marriage part2 & Children (Drive notes)

input: Gana koota: Deva, Manav (human), Rakshasa
outcome: Same gana 6 points; Deva-Manav about 5; Manav-Rakshasa low; Deva-Rakshasa 0 points
strength_note: Bride and groom ganas are listed in the panchang
source: Marriage part2 & Children (Drive notes)

input: Bhakoot: Moon signs of boy and girl in 2/12, 5/9 or 6/8 relation
outcome: These are malefic and give 0 points
strength_note: Bhakoot dosha is not counted when the two sign lords are same or friends (e.g. 12-1, 2-3 pairs treated as not malefic as noted)
source: Marriage part2 & Children (Drive notes)

input: Bhakoot results: 2/12 more expenses; 5/9 (Nav-Pancham) trouble in children/sickness; 6/8 sickness or death
outcome: Gives problems of that type in married life
strength_note: Same sign or 7/7 (Sam-Saptam) is good
source: Marriage part2 & Children (Drive notes)

input: Nadi koota: Aadi, Madhya, Antya
outcome: Same nadi gives 0 points, different nadi gives 8 points; same nadi is a dosha affecting health and children of couple
source: Marriage part2 & Children (Drive notes)

input: Nadi dosha with same Moon sign but different nakshatra, or same nakshatra but different charan or sign
outcome: Nadi dosha is cancelled (as noted)
source: Marriage part2 & Children (Drive notes)

input: Mars in 1, 2, 4, 7, 8 or 12 from Lagna (Mangal dosha)
outcome: Can cause sickness, separation or divorce in marriage
strength_note: Judge how afflicted Mars is; Jupiter or Moon aspect helps
source: Marriage part2 & Children (Drive notes)

input: Both boy and girl have Mangal dosha
outcome: The dosha cancels out
source: Marriage part2 & Children (Drive notes)

input: One partner has Mangal dosha and the other does not
outcome: Dangerous; harm to the partner without it
strength_note: Less dangerous if Mars is exalted or in own sign, or if Mars is aspected by benefics
source: Marriage part2 & Children (Drive notes)

input: Twelve types of children in classical texts
outcome: Aurasa (own), Kshetraj (by another man for husband), Dattaka (adopted), Kritrima, Gudhotpanna, Apaviddha, Paunarbhava, Kanina, Sahoda, Kritaka (bought) and others
source: Marriage part2 & Children (Drive notes)

input: Child birth dasha

input: Charts for children: D-1 and D-7; 5th house, 5th lord and Jupiter

input: Child prediction delay: do not predict until karmic causes are weighed
outcome: Delay may come from curses (snake, father, mother, brother, maternal uncle, Brahmin, guru, wife, spirit) shown by karaka and house lord in 6/8/12 with Rahu/Saturn

input: Delay or obstruction to children

input: Transit of Saturn, Jupiter and Moon connecting with 5th house and its lord

source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Natural benefic aspecting an afflicted house when benefic is itself a lord or signification of that matter and is afflicted
outcome: Benefic aspect does not relieve the affliction
strength_note: Treat it as on the same line as the afflicted factor
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Rahu and Ketu aspect 5th, 7th, 9th, 12th houses fully; 2nd and 10th half
outcome: They carry influence of planets joined or aspecting them to the houses they aspect
strength_note: Rahu dasha gives effects of Mars if Rahu is with Mars
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Planets in kendra or trikona from another
outcome: Mool trikona signs of planets matter: Venus for Taurus Lagna gives mainly 6th house results via Libra
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Mars, Saturn or Sun in 4th, 5th or 9th
outcome: Becomes weak and harms the house it owns
strength_note: Example: Sun in Scorpio in 4th for Leo Lagna is only mediocre
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Aspects
outcome: All planets aspect 7th; Saturn also 3rd and 10th; Jupiter 5th and 9th; Mars 4th and 8th
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Planet with no planet in its own sign
outcome: Gives own independent results; if a malefic occupies its sign, it gives that malefic's results
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Prediction needs house, house lord and karaka (house, lord, significator)
outcome: Judge every matter with these three factors
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Wife judged by 7th house, 7th lord and Venus; husband by 7th, its lord and Jupiter
outcome: Karakas for spouse
strength_note: Maternal uncles: 6th house with Mercury; comforts and conveyance 4th with Venus
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Matter judged as from the relation's own house (e.g. longevity of father from 9th, 8th from 9th is 4th)
outcome: Treat the relation's house as lagna for his or her affairs
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Love marriage
outcome: Lords of 1st, 3rd, 10th or 11th influence marriage factors
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Sun, Saturn and Rahu (two or more, or their sign lords) afflict 7th house, 7th lord and Venus/Jupiter
outcome: Separation from spouse, divorce
strength_note: Same trio afflicting 2nd: separation from family, sent to hostel
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Moon within 72 degrees of Sun (either side)
outcome: Moon is weak and acts malefic; strongest at 180 degrees from Sun
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Mercury alone and uninfluenced
outcome: Acts benefic; takes nature of planets associating or aspecting it
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu natural malefics; Jupiter, Venus natural benefics
outcome: Malefics harm and benefics help houses influenced
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Malefic influences on both sides of a planet or house (hemming)
outcome: Early death of the relation signified, even if benefic aspects the planet
strength_note: Example: wife dying early with Ketu, Mars, Saturn influence
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch II Rules for interpretation

input: Putra dosha: Rahu in 5th, 5th lord in a dusthana, 5th and Jupiter surrounded by malefics, 5th lord with female planets
outcome: Son denied or only one son after shanti
strength_note: Retrograde or strong male Jupiter aspecting 5th and its lord is a silver ray giving a son after astrological remedies
remedy: Astrological shanti (remedial rites)
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch III-V

input: Putra dosha present but Moon in 10th house
outcome: Native still gets a son to perform funeral rites (kriya karma is 10th house)
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch III-V

input: Sons judged from 5th house, 5th lord and Jupiter; also from the 9th as 5th from 5th
outcome: Check all three factors for issue
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch III-V

input: Benefics, especially Jupiter, influence 2nd house and its lord
outcome: Good savings
strength_note: Malefics, Rahu, Saturn or 6th lord on 2nd: little or no savings
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch III-V

input: 2nd house is 4th from the 11th house of income
outcome: 2nd house shows accumulated money and savings
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch III-V

input: Lords of Lagna and 2nd occupy a house together
outcome: That house shows source of livelihood
strength_note: Lagna (and karakamsa) also shows nature of profession
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch III-V

input: Moon and Sun in 6th aspected by Saturn
outcome: Livelihood by unbecoming means
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch III-V

input: Sun, Jupiter, Mars govern government service
outcome: Their link with 10th and Lagna points to government job
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch III-V

input: Moon (eye signifier) and 2nd lord from Chandra Lagna afflicted by malefics, with 12th from Chandra Lagna afflicted
outcome: Eye trouble, dasha of afflicted planets (e.g. Moon bhukti in Rahu)
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch III-V

input: Wife's longevity: 7th lord strong in own sign even in 8th, aspected by Jupiter, benefic in 7th
outcome: Long life of wife despite diseases
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch III-V

input: 7th lord in 8th with malefic Rahu and aspected by malefics, 7th lord weak
outcome: First wife dies
strength_note: Counter view: benefic in 7th or Jupiter aspect on 8th from 7th gives long life
source: Sapta Rishi Nadi commentary (Bhasin), Ch III-V

input: House has fewer than 28 bindus in Sarvashtakavarga
outcome: House is not good for its matters
strength_note: Notes also say 28 is the minimum for a good house
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Benefic planet in a kendra house
outcome: Good event occurs at an age equal to the bindus of that house
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Planet in 8th house
outcome: Bad event may occur in the year (age) equal to bindus of that house
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Fewer bindus in 12th house and more in 2nd house
outcome: Saver, accumulates money
strength_note: More in 12th than 2nd: spendthrift
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Many bindus in 10th and fewer in 11th
outcome: More work, less gain
strength_note: Interpretation from notes
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Large difference in bindus between 1st and 7th houses
outcome: Divorce, death of spouse or unhappy marriage
strength_note: Notes say large difference is not preferred
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: 8th house has more bindus than Lagna
outcome: Not preferred; affects longevity
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Lagna and 4th both high in bindus and their lords exchange houses
outcome: Wealthy person living in palace-like house
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Total bindus of Lagna, 2nd, 4th, 9th, 10th, 11th more than 164
outcome: Wealthy person
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Total bindus of 6th, 8th, 12th less than 76
outcome: Income exceeds expenditure
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Kendra and trikona houses together have many bindus
outcome: Wealthy, wise, spiritual
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Lagna, Sun sign and Moon sign each have more than 30 bindus
outcome: Person becomes wise through own efforts
strength_note: From Sudarshan chakra
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Saturn transits 4th from Moon (dhaiya)
outcome: Change of place
strength_note: Saturn in 8th from Moon (ashtam shani) or kantak shani: loss of health
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Planet transiting a house with 0 bindus in its own ashtakavarga (esp. Saturn or Jupiter)
outcome: Death-like suffering
strength_note: 1 bindu: loss; 2: loss, obstruction, expense; 3: worry, misunderstanding; 4: mixed
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Planet transiting a house with 5 or 6 bindus in its BAV
outcome: 5: good health and understanding; 6: increase of wealth and high status
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Planet transiting a house with 7 or 8 bindus in its BAV
outcome: 7: all kinds of happiness; 8: fulfilment of all desires, name and fame
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Sun debilitated in Lagna with fewer than 3 bindus
outcome: Weak health
strength_note: Sun exalted or friendly with 5+ bindus: long life, political power, good administrator
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Sun in 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th with good bindus after reduction
outcome: Good results
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Moon in Lagna with few bindus
outcome: Constant worry and litigation
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Moon in kendra or trikona with 5 or more bindus
outcome: Good results in its own period
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Mars in 4th or 8th from Moon with few bindus
outcome: Child separated from mother
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Mars in Lagna, 4th or 10th in own or exalted sign with good bindus
outcome: Powerful, wealthy person
strength_note: Mars in kendra or trikona in Aries, Sagittarius or Capricorn with 4-5 bindus: head of state
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Jupiter in 6th, 8th or 12th with good bindus
outcome: Good health, enemies destroyed, long life
strength_note: Jupiter there with few bindus: sorrow in life
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Jupiter with 8 bindus in own or exalted sign and not combust
outcome: Very wealthy
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Jupiter in Lagna or 5th with least bindus
outcome: Unhappy regarding children
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Venus in Lagna or kendra with good bindus, not combust or debilitated
outcome: Good vehicles
strength_note: Venus in 10th with good bindus: more than one vehicle
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Saturn in Lagna with least bindus
outcome: Loss of wealth
strength_note: Saturn with 8 bindus: becomes head of village, city or state
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Saturn transit through sign where its BAV bindus are many
outcome: Good time; few bindus bad time
strength_note: Notes use Saturn transit from natal Moon star
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: Mercury placed in a house with good bindus
outcome: Learner; own/exalted house with many bindus makes that house prosper
source: Ashtakvarga.pdf (handwritten class notes, OCR)

input: KP method: cuspal sub lord of a house
outcome: Sub lord promises or denies the matter of that house; results come only in joint period of significators of the matter
strength_note: Core sub-disposition theory
source: Nakshatra Chintamani (C. R. Bhatt), Ch I Grouping of houses

input: Significator planet in its dasha, bhukti, antara
outcome: Gives results of the houses occupied and owned by its star lord; favourable if sub lord is harmonious with star lord's matters
source: Nakshatra Chintamani (C. R. Bhatt), Ch I Grouping of houses

input: Longevity
outcome: Houses 1, 8 and 3 show longevity; Saturn is chief governor
strength_note: Marakas: 12th to each (houses 12, 7, 2)
source: Nakshatra Chintamani (C. R. Bhatt), Ch I Grouping of houses

input: Badhaka house: 11th for movable lagna, 9th for fixed, 7th for dual
outcome: Badhaka is more harmful than maraka; for death consider badhaka first, then maraka houses
source: Nakshatra Chintamani (C. R. Bhatt), Ch I Grouping of houses

input: Health and disease
outcome: Lagna for health; 6th for disease; 1, 5, 11 for cure
strength_note: Houses 8 and 12 for accident; Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu cause accidents
source: Nakshatra Chintamani (C. R. Bhatt), Ch I Grouping of houses

input: Education
outcome: Houses 4, 9, 11 (4th main, 9th higher study); 6th for competitive exams; Mercury and Jupiter chief governors
strength_note: Completion of education: houses 3, 5, 8
source: Nakshatra Chintamani (C. R. Bhatt), Ch I Grouping of houses

input: Purchase or construction of building
outcome: Houses 4, 11, 12
strength_note: Sale of building: 3, 5, 10; Mars governs buildings, Saturn land and mines
source: Nakshatra Chintamani (C. R. Bhatt), Ch I Grouping of houses

input: Marriage
outcome: Houses 2, 7, 11 for marriage; Venus chief governor
strength_note: Separation or divorce: houses 1, 6, 10
source: Nakshatra Chintamani (C. R. Bhatt), Ch I Grouping of houses

input: Child birth
outcome: Houses 2, 5, 11 (5th for female, 11th for male important); Jupiter natural significator
strength_note: No child or separation from child: 1, 4, 10; women Moon fertility and Mars menstruation; men Venus fertility, Sun vitality
source: Nakshatra Chintamani (C. R. Bhatt), Ch I Grouping of houses

input: Foreign travel
outcome: Houses 3, 9, 12; Moon chief governor of journey
strength_note: Return home: 3, 9, 11
source: Nakshatra Chintamani (C. R. Bhatt), Ch I Grouping of houses

input: Service or profession
outcome: Houses 2, 6, 10; Sun chief governor
strength_note: Change of job: 1, 5, 9 (12th from 2, 6, 10) or 2,6,10,11 for promotion; transfer: 3, 10, 12; suspension: 1, 8, 9, 12; retirement or dismissal: 1, 5, 9, 12 (also 8 for gratuity)
source: Nakshatra Chintamani (C. R. Bhatt), Ch I Grouping of houses

input: Gain of money
outcome: Houses 2, 6, 11; lottery 2, 3, 6, 11; speculation 2, 5, 6, 11; Jupiter chief governor of money
source: Nakshatra Chintamani (C. R. Bhatt), Ch I Grouping of houses

input: Independent business
outcome: Houses 2, 7, 10 (7th main house for business)
source: Nakshatra Chintamani (C. R. Bhatt), Ch I Grouping of houses

input: Order of strength of significators of a house
outcome: 1) planet in star of an occupant of the house, 2) occupant, 3) planet in star of the owner, 4) owner, 5) planet in conjunction or aspect with these significators
strength_note: Star is stronger than sign
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I Significators and strength

input: Rahu or Ketu
outcome: Acts as agent of planet it conjoins or is aspected by and of owner of the sign it occupies; gives results first of conjoined or aspecting planet, then its star lord, then sign owner
strength_note: Rahu/Ketu take first preference in place of the significator they represent; not treated as retrograde
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I Significators and strength

input: Planet in star of Rahu or Ketu
outcome: Planet signifies the matters of Rahu/Ketu's agency
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I Significators and strength

input: Planet gives mostly results of house occupied, then owned
outcome: Angles stronger than succedent then cadent houses
strength_note: Owner of 6, 8, 12 from the house judged becomes weak or malefic
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I Significators and strength

input: Planet connected with owner of 6, 8, 12 by occupation, star, conjunction or aspect
outcome: Planet is weakened or afflicted
strength_note: Planet in own or exalted sign strong; debilitated weak
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I Significators and strength

input: Planet connected with another planet
outcome: Connected if in its sign, in its star or sub, or in conjunction or aspect with it
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I Significators and strength

input: Harmonious and detrimental houses per matter: house group for matter harmonious; 12th-from houses detrimental
outcome: Sub lord that signifies harmonious houses supports the matter; one signifying detrimental houses denies it
strength_note: Example: marriage harmonious 2,7,11; detrimental 1,6,10
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I significators, sub lord and timing

input: Significator of a matter: its dasha, bhukti and antara (joint period of significator, star lord and sub lord)
outcome: Event happens in joint period of the significators of the houses concerned
strength_note: Four-level joint periods; include sookshma
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I significators, sub lord and timing

input: Significator's sub lord harmonious to the matter shown by the star lord
outcome: Favourable result in its period
strength_note: Sub lord detrimental: unfavourable result
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I significators, sub lord and timing

input: Dasha ruler significator of 7th (via star) whose sub lord is a significator of 1, 6 or 10
outcome: No marriage in that period
strength_note: Sub lord significator of 2, 7 or 11: marriage happens in that period
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I significators, sub lord and timing

input: Dasha ruler significator of 9th with sub lord owning 8 (12th from 9)
outcome: Studies given up in that period
strength_note: Sub lord harmonious to 4, 9, 11: further studies in that period
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I significators, sub lord and timing

input: Joint period rulers significators of houses 1, 5, 9, 12
outcome: Retirement from service
strength_note: Example in book: retirement during Mars-Mercury-Saturn period
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I significators, sub lord and timing

input: Period ruler significator of houses 2, 6, 11 (with 6 for loan receipt, 7 lender) and sub lord harmonious
outcome: Money or loan received in its period
strength_note: Houses 8 and 12 mean repayment or loss
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I significators, sub lord and timing

input: A planet benefic to the native may be malefic for his father or mother
outcome: Judge each relation with houses counted from relation's house (father from 9th, mother from 4th)
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I significators, sub lord and timing

input: No planet or house wholly benefic or malefic
outcome: A planet is benefic if in star of occupant or owner of the house giving desired matters and its sub lord connects with those matters
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I significators, sub lord and timing

input: Planet in star of owner of 6th with sub lord connected to 8th
outcome: Chronic disease in its dasha, even if same planet helps career
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I significators, sub lord and timing

input: Joint period of significators of badhaka and maraka houses counted from relation's house
outcome: Death of that relation (father from 9th house, mother from 4th)
strength_note: Book example: mother died in Ketu-Venus-Rahu period
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I significators, sub lord and timing

input: Too many significators of a house
outcome: Eliminate: give first preference to Rahu/Ketu if representing a significator; remove planets whose sub lord is detrimental to the house
strength_note: The dasha ruler fixed by birth Moon is important if connected to the matter
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I significators, sub lord and timing

input: Transit duration of planets through a nakshatra
outcome: Saturn about 13 months, Rahu/Ketu about 8 months, Jupiter about 5 months 10 days, Mars about 20 days, Sun about 13 days, Moon about 24 hours
strength_note: Sun and Moon show day-to-day and hour effects
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch III Planets in transit

input: Any transiting planet in the star area of a natal significator of a house
outcome: Influences matters of the houses that significator signifies
strength_note: Sub lord of transiting planet decides favourable or not
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch III Planets in transit

input: Transiting planets in the star of natal significators of 6th house (illness) whose sub lords are connected with 6 or 8
outcome: Ill health in that transit
strength_note: Worse while running joint dasha period of same significators
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch III Planets in transit

input: Transit planet in star area of the running dasha-bhukti-antara rulers and its sub lord not detrimental
outcome: Gives same results as the joint period indicates
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch III Planets in transit

input: Sun stays 1-3 days in one sub and Moon about 3 hours; Saturn, Jupiter, Rahu, Ketu many days
outcome: Sun and Moon sub transits fix the specific day and hour of event
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch III Planets in transit

input: Cuspal sub lord of a house is significator of that house or of houses of the matter
outcome: Matter of the house is promised
strength_note: If it signifies houses of denial (12th-from group), matter denied
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 13 Cuspal sub lord

input: Cusp sub lord promises the matter
outcome: Only then do results occur during joint period of significators of the matter
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 13 Cuspal sub lord

input: Sub lord of Lagna cusp is owner of 6, 8 or 12
outcome: Short life up to 33 years
strength_note: Owner of 1, 5, 9 or 10: long life beyond 66; mixed of both: middle life up to 66
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 13 Cuspal sub lord

input: Sub lord of Lagna cusp signifies badhaka and maraka houses or sub lords of 3rd and 8th cusps do
outcome: Not good for long life
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 13 Cuspal sub lord

input: Sub lord of Lagna in star of occupant of 1st or 11th
outcome: Health normal
strength_note: In star of occupant or owner of 6, 8 or 12: poor health
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 13 Cuspal sub lord

input: Sub lord of Lagna or 8th cusp in star of occupant or owner of 8 or 12
outcome: Accident
strength_note: Star of 8 or 7 or 2: fatal; star of 2, 7 or 11: survives
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 13 Cuspal sub lord

input: Sub lord of 4th cusp is Mercury or Jupiter, or in star of occupant/owner of 4, 9, 11 with star lord connected to Mercury/Jupiter
outcome: Academic qualifications
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 13 Cuspal sub lord

input: Sub lord of 4th cusp in star of occupant or owner of 4, 11 or 12 with Mars or Saturn connected
outcome: Own building
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 13 Cuspal sub lord

input: Sub lord of 10th cusp signifies 3 or 10
outcome: Native will sell his building
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 13 Cuspal sub lord

input: Sub lord of 7th cusp is significator of 2, 7 or 11
outcome: Native will marry
strength_note: Significator of 1, 6 or 10: will not marry
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 13 Cuspal sub lord

input: Sub lord of 5th cusp is significator of 2, 5 or 11 (5th for females, 11th for males first)
outcome: Child birth promised
strength_note: Significator of 1, 4, 10: no child
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 13 Cuspal sub lord

input: Sub lord of 10th or 6th cusp is significator of 2, 6 or 10
outcome: Earns money in profession or service
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 13 Cuspal sub lord

input: Ruling planets at time of query or judgment: day lord, Lagna sign lord, Lagna star lord, Moon sign lord, Moon star lord
outcome: These are the ruling planets; Rahu/Ketu included if conjoined or aspecting or in sign of a ruling planet; omit those in star/sub of retrograde planet
strength_note: Preference order: Lagna star lord, Moon star lord, Moon sign lord, Lagna sign lord, day lord
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch II Ruling planets

input: Ruling planets at time of judgment coincide with significators of the matter
outcome: Event happens in period of those planets
strength_note: Used to confirm timing and to rectify birth time
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch II Ruling planets

input: Moon's star lord, sub lord and sub-sub lord at birth
outcome: Give dasha, bhukti and antara ruler at birth
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch II Ruling planets

input: Two planets in same sign with same star and sub lord
outcome: Sub-sub lord decides which gives better results in its period
strength_note: Planet in sub-sub of a good-house owner does better
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch II Ruling planets

input: Dasha ruler signifies both 2,5,11 and 1,4,10
outcome: Child birth in sub period of significator of 2,5,11; no child or separation in sub period of significator of 1,4,10
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 14 Joint period rulers

input: Star lord of dasha or bhukti ruler placed in 6th, 8th or 12th from its own sign
outcome: Dasha ruler does not give favourable results of the house owned by its star lord
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 14 Joint period rulers

input: Planet and its star lord are in 6th/8th (6/8) signs from each other
outcome: Results not to the desired extent in their joint period; only ordinary temporary rise
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 14 Joint period rulers

input: Star lord of the dasha or bhukti ruler is retrograde
outcome: Ups and downs, promotions and reversions in that period
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 14 Joint period rulers

input: Joint period rulers in reception, conjunction or mutual aspect
outcome: They influence each other's affairs
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 14 Joint period rulers

input: Joint period rulers give results of houses owned by their star lords
outcome: Strength depends on strength of the star lords
source: Nakshatra Chintamani, Ch I sec 14 Joint period rulers

input: Moon in anupachaya sign (not 3,6,10,11 from lagna) aspected by benefic male planet at time of menses
outcome: sexual union of husband and wife, conception possible
strength_note: Upachaya signs are 3rd,6th,10th,11th from ascendant
source: Brihat Jataka (Iyer tr.), Ch.4 st.1

input: Moon aspected by several malefic planets in a woman's chart at time of union
outcome: woman becomes unchaste (commentator view)
strength_note: Commentator addition; Sun aspect: officer, Mars: voluptuary, Mercury: fickle person, Venus: handsome person, Saturn: servant
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.1 notes

input: Sun, Moon, Venus, Mars in own navamsas at union, or Jupiter in lagna/5th/9th
outcome: union produces a child
strength_note: Useless if the man lacks virility
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.3

input: At conception Mars or Saturn in 7th from Sun or Moon
outcome: illness of husband or wife respectively
timing: in the month ruled by that planet
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.4

input: Mars and Jupiter in 12th and 2nd from Sun and Moon, or one conjunct and other aspecting Sun/Moon, at conception
outcome: death of husband and wife respectively
timing: month of the powerful Saturn/Mars; before child birth
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.4

input: Malefics in 12th house and lagna not aspected by benefics, at conception
outcome: pregnant woman dies
strength_note: Also if Saturn in lagna aspected by waning Moon and Mars
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.6

input: Lagna or Moon hemmed between malefics and not aspected by benefics
outcome: pregnant woman dies
timing: before delivery, in month of powerful malefic
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.7

input: Malefics in 4th and Mars in 8th from lagna/Moon; or Mars in 4th and Sun in 12th
outcome: pregnant woman dies
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.8

input: Mars in lagna and Sun in 7th at conception
outcome: pregnant woman dies by weapons
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.9

input: Lord of a pregnancy month is afflicted at conception
outcome: miscarriage in that month
timing: month lords 1-7: Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Sun, Moon, Saturn, Mercury
strength_note: Dim planet only causes suffering of the foetus, not loss
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.9 and 16

input: Benefics with Moon/lagna or in 2,4,5,7,9,10 from them, malefics in 3rd and 11th, Moon/lagna aspected by Sun
outcome: safe delivery
strength_note: Another reading says aspected by Jupiter, which commentator says is against Saravali
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.10

input: Lagna, Sun, Jupiter, Moon powerful in odd signs and odd navamsas
outcome: male child
strength_note: Even signs and even navamsas (Moon, Venus, Mars) give female; majority of powerful planets decides
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.11

input: Sun and Jupiter in male dual navamsas (Gemini, Sagittarius) aspected by Mercury
outcome: male twins
strength_note: Venus and Mars in female dual navamsas (Virgo, Pisces) aspected by Mercury give female twins
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.11

input: Saturn in an odd sign counted from lagna
outcome: male child
strength_note: Applies only if the earlier sex yogas are absent
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.12

input: Moon and Sun in even and odd signs aspecting each other; or Saturn and Mercury similarly; or Venus, lagna and Moon in male signs and male navamsas
outcome: child of ambiguous sex (napumsaka)
strength_note: Only when male and female yogas are absent
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.13

input: Moon and Venus in even signs; Mercury, Mars, Jupiter, lagna in odd signs
outcome: one male and one female child (twins)
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.14

input: Moon in Taurus and malefics in last navamsa of Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces
outcome: child is mute
strength_note: If Moon aspected by benefic, speech comes after long time; if by malefics the child never speaks
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.17

input: Cancer lagna with Moon in it aspected by Saturn and Mars
outcome: child is hunchbacked
strength_note: Not if aspected by Jupiter
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.18

input: Pisces lagna aspected by Saturn, Moon and Mars
outcome: child is lame
strength_note: Not if aspected by Jupiter
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.18

input: Malefic and Moon in last navamsa of Cancer, Scorpio or Pisces
outcome: child born deaf
strength_note: Not if aspected by Jupiter
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.18

input: Leo lagna occupied by Sun and Moon, aspected by Mars and Saturn
outcome: child born blind
strength_note: If benefics aspect, only a spot in the eye; Sun alone in Leo: right eye; Moon alone: left eye; Moon/Sun in 12th gives blindness of left/right eye
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.4 st.20

input: Lagna not aspected by Moon at birth, and Sun in 9th or 8th
outcome: father not present at birth; abroad if movable sign, at home if fixed, returning if dual
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.5 st.1

input: Saturn in lagna, or Mars in 7th, or Moon between Mercury and Venus at birth
outcome: father is away at the birth
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.5 st.2

input: Jupiter aspects neither lagna nor Moon, or Moon with Sun accompanied by a malefic
outcome: illegitimate child
strength_note: Jupiter aspecting either one, or Moon in a Jupiter sign/drekkana/navamsa, removes this (Garga, Yavanesvara)
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.5 st.6

input: Two malefics (Mars, Saturn) in a malefic sign in 8th, 7th or 9th from Sun
outcome: father is in custody at time of birth
strength_note: Sun in movable sign: abroad; fixed: own country; dual: on way home
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.5 st.7

input: Moon in lagna, Saturn in 12th aspected by a malefic
outcome: birth takes place in a prison
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.5 st.10

input: Pindayurdaya: max years Sun 19, Moon 25, Mars 15, Mercury 12, Jupiter 15, Venus 21, Saturn 20 at exaltation degree
outcome: base years for longevity calculation
strength_note: Half at debilitation degree, proportion in between; lagna gives years equal to navamsas risen
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.7 st.1-2

input: Planet in enemy sign (Pindayurdaya)
outcome: loses one third of its years
strength_note: Combust planet loses one half; no cut for Mars in enemy sign, nor Saturn/Venus combust
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.7 st.2

input: Malefic planet in 12th,11th,10th,9th,8th,7th from lagna (Pindayurdaya)
outcome: reduction of full, 1/2, 1/3, 1/5, 1/6 of its years respectively (chakrapata)
strength_note: Benefic in those houses gives half the cut
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.7 st.3

input: Malefic in lagna (Pindayurdaya)
outcome: total years multiplied by navamsas elapsed from Aries and divided by 108 is subtracted
strength_note: Only half cut if malefic is aspected by a benefic
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.7 st.4

input: Maximum human life span
outcome: 120 years (elephant same; horse 32; ass and camel 25; ox and buffalo 24; dog 12; goat 16)
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.7 st.5

input: Satyacharya method: planet in exaltation sign or retrograde
outcome: its years are trebled
strength_note: Doubled if in vargottama, own sign or own drekkana; if both applicable use the larger multiplier once; commentator says this is the best ayurdaya method
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.7 st.11-13

input: Cancer lagna with Jupiter and Moon in it, Mercury and Venus in kendras, other planets in 11th, 6th, 3rd
outcome: life far beyond normal span (yogayu)
strength_note: Ordinary ayurdaya rules do not apply
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.7 st.14

input: Sarvashtakavarga total in a sign
outcome: above 30 transit through the sign gives good results; 25 to 30 mixed; below 25 bad
strength_note: Grand total of all seven planets' tables is 337
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 notes (Sarvashtakavarga)

input: Choosing lagna for starting good work or forming connections
outcome: start good work when rising sign has the largest figure in Sarvashtakavarga
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 notes

input: SAV figure of 11th house greater than 10th, 12th less than 11th, and lagna figure greater than 12th
outcome: person is happy and prosperous (small effort, large gain, small loss)
strength_note: Otherwise unhappy
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 notes (Sarvashtakavarga rule 2)

input: Houses (except 6,8,12) with large SAV figures
outcome: matters of those houses prosper
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 notes (rule 3)

input: Sum SAV of the 4 signs from Pisces, the 4 from Cancer, the 4 from Scorpio
outcome: the largest total marks the happiest third of life (early, middle, late)
strength_note: Three or more malefics in a set of four signs bring misery in that part of life
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 notes (rule 4)

input: Sum of SAV figures of signs occupied by Saturn, lagna and Mars
outcome: gives the year of life with disease or other miseries
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 notes (rule 5)

input: Sum of SAV figures of signs occupied by Rahu, Mars and Saturn
outcome: gives the year of poison, weapon or wound trouble
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 notes (rule 6)

input: Sum of SAV figures of signs occupied by benefic planets
outcome: gives the year in which a son, wealth and the like are gained
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 notes (rule 7)

input: Figure in the 5th house from Jupiter in Jupiter's own ashtakavarga
outcome: number of sons; those lost early equal the planets in enemy or debilitation signs
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 notes (A.V. of Jupiter)

input: Venus transits the sign with the largest figure in Venus's reduced ashtakavarga
outcome: person gains a wife, land and wealth
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 notes (A.V. of Venus)

input: Saturn transits a sign with zero figure in Mars's ashtakavarga
outcome: disease if Mars strong; death if Mars weak and not lagna lord
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 notes (A.V. of Mars)

input: Saturn transits a sign with zero figure in Mercury's ashtakavarga
outcome: death or loss of son or friends
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 notes (A.V. of Mercury)

input: Sun's reduced ashtakavarga total times figure in 9th from Sun, divided by 27; Saturn transits that star or its trine stars during a malefic dasa
outcome: father or paternal uncle dies or suffers
strength_note: Mother: use Moon's A.V., figure in 4th from Moon
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 notes (A.V. of Sun, Moon)

input: Sun transits a sign with no figure (zero) in Sun's ashtakavarga
outcome: do not begin any work; disease, misery and quarrel result
strength_note: Same for Moon and signs empty in Moon's A.V.
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 notes

input: Benefic places of Sun: 1,2,4,7,8,9,10,11 from Sun, Mars, Saturn; 5,7,12 from Venus; 5,6,9,11 from Jupiter; 3,6,10,11 from Moon; 3,5,6,9,10,11,12 from Mercury; 3,4,6,10,11,12 from lagna
outcome: bindu positions for Sun's ashtakavarga
strength_note: Rest are malefic; a place is benefic if more benefic than malefic marks
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.9 st.1

outcome: swelling disease (elephantiasis type)

outcome: emaciated body
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.23 st.8

outcome: leprosy

outcome: blindness by the cause of the strongest of them (Moon phlegm, Mars bile, Sun heat, Saturn wind)

outcome: windy diseases
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.23 st.13

input: Mars in 7th and Jupiter in lagna
outcome: insanity
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.23 st.13

input: Saturn in lagna and Mars in 5th, 7th or 9th; or waning Moon and Saturn in 12th
outcome: idiocy
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.23 st.13

outcome: ugly teeth
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.23 st.15

outcome: weak eyesight
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.23 st.15

input: Malefics in 12th, 5th, 2nd, 9th houses
outcome: imprisonment or restraint (type by rising sign: rope for Aries/Taurus/Sagittarius, fetters for Gemini/Virgo/Libra/Aquarius, fortress for Cancer/Capricorn/Pisces, cellar for Scorpio)
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.23 st.16

input: Moon with Saturn, aspected by Mars, ringed by halo
outcome: harsh speech, epilepsy or consumption
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.23 st.17

input: Sun, Saturn, Mars in 10th without benefic aspect
outcome: servant: one planet high rank, two middle, three low
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.23 st.17

input: Woman's chart: 8th house
outcome: husband's death is read from the 8th house; fortune and husband from the 7th; body from lagna and Moon sign
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.24 st.1

input: Woman's lagna and Moon sign both even signs, aspected by benefics
outcome: truly feminine, virtuous, modest
strength_note: Odd signs: masculine nature; malefic influence: wicked
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.24 st.2

input: Woman's lagna or Moon sign Aries/Scorpio with Mars trimsamsa
outcome: unchaste before marriage; Saturn trimsamsa: servitude; Jupiter: chaste; Mercury: deceitful; Venus: bad conduct
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.24 st.3

input: Woman's lagna/Moon sign Cancer with Saturn trimsamsa
outcome: murders her husband (Jupiter trimsamsa: good qualities)
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.24 st.5

input: Woman's lagna/Moon sign Taurus or Libra with Saturn trimsamsa
outcome: marries a second time
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.24 st.4

input: Woman's 7th house empty, weak and not aspected by benefics
outcome: husband is wicked
strength_note: Mercury in 7th: husband impotent; Sun: rejected by husband; Mars aspected by malefics: widowed young; Saturn aspected by malefics: unmarried till old; movable sign: husband abroad
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.24 st.8

input: Woman's 7th house occupied by several malefics
outcome: widowhood
strength_note: Benefics and malefics both: leaves husband and remarries
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.24 st.9

outcome: adultery
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.24 st.9

input: Woman: setting sign or navamsa is Saturn's / Mars's / Venus's / Mercury's
outcome: husband old and foolish / irritable but devoted / handsome and loving / learned
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.24 st.11

outcome: husband lustful and quiet / brave and self-controlled / soft and busy
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.24 st.12

outcome: envious and comfort-loving / learned in fine arts / beautiful, loved by husband, musical / very wealthy and virtuous
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.24 st.13

input: Woman: malefic in 8th house
outcome: widowhood, in the antardasa of the planet whose navamsa the 8th lord occupies
timing: antardasa of planet owning navamsa of 8th lord
strength_note: Benefic in 2nd also: she dies before her husband
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.24 st.14

input: Woman: malefic in 7th and some planet in 9th
outcome: becomes an ascetic of that planet's class
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.24 st.16

outcome: death by excess of that planet's humour; Sun bile, Moon wind and phlegm, Mars bile, Mercury all three, Jupiter phlegm, Venus wind and phlegm, Saturn wind
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.1

input: Planet in 8th house: Sun / Moon / Mars / Mercury / Jupiter / Venus / Saturn
outcome: death by fire / water / weapons / fever / unknown disease / thirst / starvation
strength_note: Movable 8th sign: dies abroad; fixed: at home; dual: on the way
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.1

input: Sun and Mars in 4th or 10th
outcome: death by stones
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.2

input: Saturn in 4th, Moon in 7th, Mars in 10th
outcome: death by falling into a well
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.2

outcome: death by drowning
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.2

input: Saturn in Cancer and Moon in Capricorn
outcome: death by dropsy
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.3

input: Moon in Aries or Scorpio between malefics
outcome: death by weapon or fire
strength_note: Virgo: blood disease; Capricorn/Aquarius: hanging, fire or fall
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.3

input: Two malefics in 5th or 9th without benefic aspect
outcome: death in prison or restraint
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.4

input: Sun in 4th and Mars in 10th aspected by waning Moon
outcome: death by a spear
strength_note: Aspected by Saturn instead: struck by wood
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.5

outcome: death from a fall from a vehicle
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.8

outcome: death caught in a machine
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.8

input: Waning Moon aspected by strong Mars and Saturn in 8th
outcome: death from disease of private parts
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.9

input: Cause of death when no listed yoga exists
outcome: read from the 22nd drekkana from the rising drekkana; its lord or its sign lord, whichever is stronger, decides the cause
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.11

input: Place of death
outcome: sign of lord of rising navamsa (or sign of planet with it or aspecting it); Aries sheep-place, Taurus cattle-place, Gemini house, Cancer well, Leo forest, Virgo waterbank, Libra market, Scorpio hole, Sagittarius horse-place, Capricorn watery tract, Aquarius house, Pisces water
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.12

input: Jupiter in 6th, a kendra or 8th in exaltation; or Pisces lagna with Jupiter in a benefic navamsa and other planets weak
outcome: attains salvation after death
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.15

input: Lord of drekkana occupied by stronger of Sun/Moon is Jupiter / Moon or Venus / Sun or Mars / Saturn or Mercury

source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.14

outcome: body is burnt / thrown in water / left to dry
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.25 st.13

input: Planet in 10th house from lagna or Moon is Sun / Moon / Mars / Mercury / Jupiter / Venus / Saturn

strength_note: If both 10ths are occupied, both sources; several planets give several sources
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.10 st.1

outcome: farming, water produce, pearls and shells, income through women
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.10 st.2

input: Navamsa lord of 10th lord is Mars
outcome: metals, minerals, fire, weapons; wealth by bold acts
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.10 st.2

input: Navamsa lord of 10th lord is Mercury
outcome: writer, accountant, handicrafts
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.10 st.2

input: Navamsa lord of 10th lord is Jupiter
outcome: wealth via Brahmins, gods, learned men, mines, virtuous acts
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.10 st.3

input: Navamsa lord of 10th lord is Venus
outcome: gems, silver, cows and buffaloes
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.10 st.3

input: Navamsa lord of 10th lord is Saturn
outcome: hard labour, carrying burdens, low or cruel work
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.10 st.3

input: Powerful benefics in 11th, lagna or 2nd

strength_note: Three or more exalted benefics: good king

input: Three or more powerful planets in own, exaltation or moolatrikona signs

source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.11 st.13

input: Lagna and Moon vargottama aspected by groups of 4,5 or 6 planets (Sun, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn)

outcome: king
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.11 st.4

outcome: king
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.11 st.4

outcome: king
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.11 st.5

outcome: king
source: Brihat Jataka, Ch.11 st.5

input: Lord of 10th in Mars navamsa
outcome: Income from metals, battles, cooking, land, gold, weapons, adventure, spying
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.5 sl.4

input: Lord of 10th in Mercury navamsa
outcome: Income from poetry, scriptures, scribe or clerical work, astrology, priesthood
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.5 sl.5

input: Lord of 10th in Jupiter navamsa
outcome: Livelihood via Brahmins, temples, royal favour, Puranas, teaching morality, moneylending

input: Lord of 10th in Venus navamsa
outcome: Income through women, cattle, dance and music, silver, scents, milk, ornaments, silk, royal companion, poetry

outcome: Livelihood by roots and fruits, hard labour, servants, carrying burdens, base work, sculpture, wood

outcome: Native earns in his own country

input: Sun to Saturn in order is 10th from stronger of Lagna or Moon

input: Mars/Mercury/Jupiter/Venus/Saturn in own or exalted sign in a kendra (Ruchaka, Bhadra, Hamsa, Malavya, Sasa)

input: Planets other than Sun in 2nd from Moon (Sunapha)
outcome: King or equal, self-earned wealth, wise

input: Planets other than Sun in 12th from Moon (Anapha)
outcome: Healthy, powerful, famous, comfortable, contented
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.5-6

input: Planets in both 2nd and 12th from Moon (Durudhara)
outcome: Wealth, vehicles, enjoyments, generous, has attendants
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.5-7

input: Benefics in 2nd and 12th from Lagna (Subhakartari)
outcome: Long life, fearless, disease-free, rich
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.11

input: Malefics in 2nd and 12th from Lagna (Papakartari)
outcome: Poor, unhappy, loss of wife and children, limb defect, short life
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.11

input: Benefics in 10th from Lagna or Moon (Amala)
outcome: Virtuous, famous, wealthy, honoured by ruler, sons
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.19-20

input: All benefics in upachaya houses from Lagna or Moon (Vasumat)
outcome: Plenty of money
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.19-20

input: Moon in kendra from Jupiter (Kesari)
outcome: Destroys enemies, eloquent, long-lived, intelligent, famous
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.14,16

input: Moon in kendra/panaphara/apoklima from Sun (Adhama/Sama/Varishta)
outcome: Wealth, fame, happiness, learning at lowest, middle, highest levels
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.14,18

input: Day birth male with Sun, Moon, Lagna in odd signs (night birth female in even signs) (Mahabhagya)
outcome: Generous, famous, ruler, lives 80 years; female gets wealth, long-lived husband, sons
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.14-15

input: Venus, Jupiter, Mercury in kendra, trikona or 2nd and Jupiter strong (Saraswati)
outcome: Learned, skilled in poetry and accounts, wealthy, wife and children
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.26-27

input: 9th lord and Venus in own/exalted sign in kendra or trikona (Lakshmi)
outcome: Wealthy, healthy, king-like, pleases subjects
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.21,24

input: Moon in Lakshmi-type position aspected by Jupiter (Gauri)
outcome: Handsome, illustrious family, friend of ruler, good sons
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.21,25

input: Lord of Lagna, Sun, Moon in kendra/trikona in own, exalted or friendly signs (Srikantha)
outcome: Devoted to Shiva, powerful, helps the virtuous
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.28-29

input: Venus, 9th lord, Mercury similarly placed (Srinatha)
outcome: Wealthy, eloquent, devout, good wife and sons, loved by all
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.28,30

input: Jupiter, 5th lord, Saturn similarly placed (Virinchi)
outcome: Knowledge of Brahma, wise, wealthy, many disciples, long life
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.28,31

input: Lords of 9th and 10th conjoined in an auspicious house (Raja yoga)
outcome: Becomes king with full royal pomp
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.37-38

input: Lord of a kendra and lord of a trikona conjoined in auspicious house (Sankha)
outcome: Enjoys comforts, many women
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.37-38

input: Lord of sign occupied by Lagna lord is exalted/own in kendra or trikona (Kahala); same for the next lord (Parvata)
outcome: Prosperous, noble, ruler of earth; Parvata gives lasting wealth
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.35-36

input: Benefics in 7th, 6th, 8th from Moon or Lagna (Adhi yoga)
outcome: Becomes commander, minister, ruler respectively; wealthy, long-lived, defeats enemies
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.42-43

input: No planet in 2nd/12th from Moon (Kemadruma)
outcome: Obscure, miserable, poor, menial work, even if born royal
strength_note: Cancelled by some if Moon has a planet with it or a kendra from Moon has planets
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.5-7

input: Benefics (not Moon) in 2nd/12th/both from Sun (Subhavesi/Subhavasi/Subhobhayachari)
outcome: Handsome, brave, famous, liked, eloquent, wealthy
strength_note: Malefics in same places give opposite: vilifying, deceit, dishonour
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.8-10

input: Moon in 6th/8th/12th from Jupiter (Sakata)
outcome: Repeated loss and regain of luck, ordinary, mental grief
strength_note: Cancelled if Moon is in kendra from Lagna
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.14,17

input: Benefics in 5th, 6th, 7th in order (Subhamala)
outcome: Director or governor, honoured by kings, good wife and sons
strength_note: Benefics in 8th, 6th, 12th is Asubhamala: bad ways, unhappy, quarrelsome
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.21-23

input: Exchange of signs (parivartana) involving lords of 6th, 8th, 12th (Dainya)
outcome: Foolish, sinful, tormented by enemies, obstacles in undertakings
strength_note: 30 of the 66 exchanges
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.32-33

input: Exchange of signs among lords of 1,2,4,5,7,9,10,11 (Maha yoga)
outcome: Fortunate, wealthy, lord, gets vehicles, children, rewards from ruler
strength_note: 28 of the 66 exchanges
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.32,34

input: Exchange of signs involving 3rd lord (Khala)
outcome: Mixed life: sometimes prosperity, sometimes distress
strength_note: 8 of the 66 exchanges
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.32-33

input: Planets occupy 7,6,5,4,3,2,1 signs (Veena, Dama, Pasa, Kedara, Sula, Yuga, Gola)
outcome: Veena music and wealth; Dama liberal; Pasa opulent; Kedara land; Sula cruel; Yuga heretic poor; Gola poor and short-lived
strength_note: Apply only when earlier yogas absent
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.39-41

input: Bhava occupied or aspected by benefics with its lord well placed or exalted (12 Bhava yogas Chamara to Musala)
outcome: Chamara growing importance; Dhenu food and wealth; Jaladhi cattle and mansion; Chhatra minister; Kama good wife; Bhagya palanquin and lasting wealth; Khyati king with sons
strength_note: Lagna to 12th bhava in order
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.44-54

input: Lagna (1st house) affected by malefics or its lord badly placed (Avayoga)
outcome: Insignificant, poverty, short life, humiliation, shaky position
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.57-58

input: Nisswa yoga (2nd house afflicted)
outcome: No kind words, barren wife, no children, no learning, wealth robbed by enemies
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.59

input: Kuhu yoga (4th house afflicted)
outcome: Loses mother, vehicles, friends, house; attached to low woman
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.61

input: Pamara yoga (5th house afflicted)
outcome: Loses children or has none, liar, miserable living
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.62

input: Dushkriti yoga (7th house afflicted)
outcome: Loses wife, other women, venereal disease, trouble from ruler
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.64

input: Harsha yoga (6th house) and Sarala yoga (8th house) good form
outcome: Harsha: happiness, wins enemies, sons; Sarala: long life, fearless, success
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.63,65

input: Nirbhagya yoga (9th house afflicted)
outcome: Loses paternal property, irreligious, indigent
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.66

input: Duryoga: 6th, 8th, 12th lords strong in kendra/trikona while lords of 1,4,9,10 weak or in 6,8,12
outcome: Own labour fruitless, insignificant, lives abroad
strength_note: If reversed (6/8/12 lords weak in dusthana, 1/4/9/10 strong in kendra/kona) becomes king, fortunate
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.6 sl.67,70

input: Three or more planets in exaltation or own sign in kendras
outcome: Becomes king; five or more make a king even from ordinary family
strength_note: Royal birth needed for 3; no Duryoga or combustion
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.1-2

input: Single debilitated planet with bright rays, retrograde, in house other than 6/8/12
outcome: King-equal; two or three such planets make a king
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.3

input: Two to four planets with directional strength (digbala)
outcome: Royal-born becomes king; 4 or 5 such planets make even ordinary-born a king
strength_note: Saturn excluded in count of five
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.4

input: Vargottama navamsa in rising Lagna or Moon in vargottama, Lagna aspected by four planets other than Moon
outcome: Low-born becomes king
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.5

input: Lagna lord in kendra or 9th in vargottama and 9th lord exalted or own in vargottama
outcome: Powerful king with elephant and chowries
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.6

input: Full white Moon aspected by planet in exaltation or own sign; or full Moon in kendra other than Lagna
outcome: Low-born becomes king with elephants and horses
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.7

input: Venus in Ashwini in Lagna aspected by three or more planets
outcome: King who destroys enemies
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.8

input: Full Moon in vargottama aspected by strong planet, no malefic in Lagna
outcome: Becomes emperor, beautiful body
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.13

input: Jupiter/Mercury/Venus/Moon in 9th, bright, uneclipsed, aspected by friends
outcome: Great king worshipped like a deity
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.14

input: Jupiter and Moon in kendra aspected by Venus with no debilitated planet
outcome: King of unparalleled fame
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.18

input: Single planet in exact exaltation point aspected by friends
outcome: Becomes king; wealthy if also with a friend
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.21

input: Full Moon in Pisces aspected by friendly planet, or full Moon exalted
outcome: Eminent, generous king
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.22

input: Moon in navamsa of very friendly planet aspected by Venus (wealth) or by Jupiter (rules whole earth)
outcome: Becomes king
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.23

input: Malefics in 3,6,11 from Lagna lord; or Mars+Mercury in 2nd; or Sun+Venus in 4th; or Mars+Saturn+Jupiter in 10,11,1
outcome: Four Rajayogas for kingship
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.24

input: Planet debilitated and lord of its debilitation sign or its exaltation-sign lord is in kendra from Lagna or Moon (Neechabhanga)
outcome: Becomes king/emperor, just, respected by other kings
strength_note: Stronger when both lords in mutual kendra or debilitated planet aspected by its sign lord and not in 6/8/12
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.7 sl.26-30

input: Sun in Lagna

outcome: 2nd: poor, no learning, stammer; 3rd: strong, brave, wealthy, hostile to relatives; 4th: no happiness, land, house, serves State
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.2

input: Sun in 5th house
outcome: No happiness or riches, few children, short life, travels forests
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.3

input: Sun in 6th house
outcome: King, famous, wealthy, victorious
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.3

input: Sun in 7th house
outcome: Displeasure of ruler, wanders, no wife, humiliation
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.3

input: Sun in 8th house
outcome: Loss of wealth and friends, short life, defective eyesight
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.3

outcome: Loses father but has children and relatives, religious
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.4

input: Sun in 10th or 11th house

source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.6-7

outcome: 9th: prosperous, children, early success; 10th: good deeds; 11th: long-lived, rich, children, servants

outcome: Disliked, misery, insult, indolent
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.7

input: Mars in Lagna
outcome: Injured limb, short-lived, cruel, adventurous

input: Mars in 4th house
outcome: No friends, mother, land, house or vehicles
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.8

input: Mars in 5th house
outcome: Unhappy, childless, reverses
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.9

input: Mars in 6th house
outcome: Wealthy, famous, king, victorious
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.9

input: Mars in 7th house
outcome: Improper acts, disease, wandering, loses wife
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.9

input: Mars in 8th house
outcome: Deformed body, poor, short-lived, cursed by people
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.9

input: Mars in 10th house
outcome: Becomes a king, cruel but liberal, praised by important people
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.10

input: Mars in 11th house
outcome: Wealth, happiness, brave, no sorrow
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.10

input: Mars in 12th house
outcome: Eye defects, cruel, no wife, slanderer
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.10

input: Mercury in Lagna
outcome: Long-lived, sweet speech, sharp-witted, learned in all sastras
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.11

input: Mercury in 2nd house
outcome: Earns by own talent, poet, good speaker
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.11

input: Mercury in 4th or 5th house
outcome: Learned, witty, friends, land, wealth, many children

input: Mercury in 10th house
outcome: Success in all undertakings, learning, strength, truthful
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.13

input: Mercury in 12th house
outcome: Miserable, no learning, humiliation, inactive
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.13

input: Jupiter in Lagna
outcome: Handsome, fortunate, long-lived, fearless, with children

input: Jupiter in 5th house
outcome: Distress through sons; intelligent, king's adviser
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.15

input: Jupiter in 7th house
outcome: Good wife and sons, amiable, more generous than father

input: Jupiter in 8th house
outcome: Poor, menial livelihood, long-lived

input: Jupiter in 9th or 10th house
outcome: 9th: famous minister, wealth, children; 10th: good conduct, very rich, friend of king

source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.16

outcome: Healthy beautiful body, happy, long life
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.17

input: Venus in 3rd house
outcome: Wifeless, unhappy, poor, miserly
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.17

input: Venus in 4th house
outcome: Good vehicles, house, jewels, clothes
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.17

input: Venus in 5th house
outcome: Immense wealth, wise, children
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.18

input: Venus in 7th house
outcome: Good wife but affairs with bad women; may lose a wife yet be wealthy
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.18

input: Venus in 8th house
outcome: Long-lived, rich, ruler
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.18

input: Venus in 10th house
outcome: Widely renowned, friends, happily employed
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.19

input: Venus in 11th house
outcome: Rich, fond of women, many comforts
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.19

input: Saturn in Lagna in own or exalted sign
outcome: On par with a king, head of a city; in other signs sorrow, poverty from childhood
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.20

input: Saturn in 2nd house
outcome: Ugly face, no wealth early; later lives in foreign country with vehicles and wealth
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.21

input: Saturn in 4th house
outcome: Unhappy, houseless, no vehicles, loses mother
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.22

input: Saturn in 5th house
outcome: Roaming, loses reason, no children, wealth or happiness
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.22

input: Saturn in 7th house
outcome: Bad wife, poverty, roaming, distress
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.22

input: Saturn in 8th house
outcome: Unclean, no wealth, piles, cruel, hungry
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.23

input: Saturn in 10th house
outcome: King or minister, agriculture, brave, rich, renowned
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.24

input: Saturn in 11th house
outcome: Long life, lasting wealth, good income, healthy
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.24

input: Saturn in 9th or 12th house
outcome: 9th: loses fortune, children, father; 12th: poor, childless, limb defect, driven out by enemies
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.24

outcome: Short life, wealth and strength but diseases in head and face
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.25

input: Rahu in 7th house
outcome: Loses wealth through women, separation from beloved
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.26

input: Rahu in 5th, 10th or 11th house
outcome: Childless (5th); limited issue (10th, 11th)
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.26-27

input: Rahu in 10th or 3rd house
outcome: 10th: famous, fearless; 3rd: proud, long-lived, wealthy, hostile to brothers
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.25,27

input: Ketu in Lagna
outcome: Ungrateful, unhappy, fall from position, deformed, bad company
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.28

input: Ketu in 3rd house
outcome: Long life, strength, wealth, fame, happy with wife, loses a brother
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.29

input: Ketu in 4th house
outcome: Loses land, vehicles, mother; leaves native country, lives on others' bounty
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.29

input: Ketu in 5th house
outcome: Loss of children, stomach disease
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.30

input: Ketu in 6th house
outcome: Magnanimous, lasting fame, authority, destroys enemies
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.30

input: Ketu in 7th house
outcome: Disrespect, bad women, loss of wife
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.31

input: Ketu in 11th house
outcome: Hoards money, achieves aims
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.33

strength_note: Rahu acts like Saturn, Ketu like Mars; effect rises or falls with distance from middle
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.8 sl.34-35

input: Any planet in exaltation

strength_note: Effects mainly during that planet's dasa
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.9 sl.14

input: Planet in own sign
outcome: In its dasa: power through wealthy person, new house and land, honour, may recover lost articles
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.9 sl.15

input: Planet in friend's sign
outcome: Success through friends, new friendships, sons, wife, wealth, help from all
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.9 sl.16

input: Planet in enemy's sign
outcome: In its dasa: base mind, lives in others' houses, destitute, even friends turn hostile
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.9 sl.17

input: Planet debilitated
outcome: In its dasa: loss of position, humiliation, debts, menial work, long walking
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.9 sl.18

input: Planet combust (eclipsed by Sun)
outcome: In its dasa: early end, loss of wife, children, wealth, quarrels
strength_note: Planet in neutral sign gives no marked change
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.9 sl.19

input: Planet retrograde (even in enemy or debilitation sign)
outcome: Gives effects like exaltation; planet in vargottama navamsa gives effects like own house
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.9 sl.20

outcome: Effects given for that sign as Lagna also apply to the Moon sign
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.9 sl.13

input: 5th and 7th houses (from Lagna or Moon) occupied or aspected by 9th lord, benefics or own lords

source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.1

input: Malefics in 12th, 4th, 8th from Venus; or Venus between two malefics; or Venus with or aspected by malefics
outcome: Loss of wife
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.1

input: 7th lord in 5th house
outcome: Loses wife or has no son
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.2

input: Lord of 5th or 8th in 7th house
outcome: Loss of wife is certain
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.2

input: Weak Moon in 5th and malefics in 12th, 7th and 1st
outcome: No wife and no children
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.2

input: Sun and Rahu in 7th house
outcome: Loss of wealth through women
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.2

input: Venus in Scorpio as 7th; or Mercury in Taurus as 7th; or Jupiter debilitated in 7th; or Saturn/Mars in Pisces as 7th
outcome: Wife dies
strength_note: Saturn and Mars together in Cancer 7th give chaste, fortunate, beautiful wife
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.3

input: 7th house or 7th lord with malefics, between malefics, debilitated, enemy sign or combust
outcome: Loss of wife certain
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.4

input: Venus with malefic in 7th, 5th or 9th
outcome: No wife or crippled wife
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.4

input: Venus in sign or navamsa of Mars or Saturn, or aspected by them
outcome: Affairs with others' wives
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.4

input: Venus and Moon opposed by Mars and Saturn
outcome: Wifeless or childless
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.5

input: 7th lord and Venus both in dual signs or navamsas; or hermaphrodite planet in 7th and two planets in 11th
outcome: Two wives
strength_note: Count wives by number of planets with 7th lord and Venus
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.5

input: Number of planets in 7th house
outcome: Number of women in life; malefics show those who die early, benefics those who survive
strength_note: Strong benefic 7th lord gives good partner and children; malefic owning 7th does good; benefic who owns 6/8/12 spoils
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.6

input: Malefics occupy or aspect 2nd and 7th houses
outcome: Loss of wife; for husband see 7th and 8th in wife chart; benefics there give lucky couple
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.7

input: Moon with Saturn in 7th in woman's chart
outcome: Remarriage; man has no wife or children
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.8

input: Debilitated or enemy-sign malefics in 7th, 8th or 2nd
outcome: Death of wife or husband
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.8

input: 7th house even sign, 7th lord and Venus in even signs, 5th and 7th lords strong and not combust
outcome: Blessed with wife and children
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.9

input: Lords of 2nd, 7th, 12th aspected by Jupiter in kendra or trikona, or benefics in 2nd, 7th, 11th from 7th lord
outcome: Wife happy with children
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.10

input: Marriage or acquiring a wife
outcome: Dasa of planet in 7th, aspecting 7th or owning 7th; or when Lagna lord transits the 7th sign

input: Venus or 7th lord transits sign trine to rasi or navamsa of Lagna lord
outcome: Marriage may happen
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.12

input: Dasa of stronger of (lords of rasi and navamsa held by 7th lord) or (Venus, Moon), when Jupiter transits trine to 7th lord's rasi or navamsa
outcome: Marriage takes place
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.14

input: Direction of wife's country
outcome: Direction of sign owned by strongest of: planet in 7th, 7th lord, Venus
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.12

input: Wife's birth rasi
outcome: Trine to rasi or navamsa of Lagna lord and 7th lord, or their exaltation/debilitation signs
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.11

input: 7th lord in enemy or debilitation sign, combust or aspected by malefics, with 7th afflicted
outcome: Loss of wife
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.10 sl.15

input: Woman's chart: 8th house, 9th, Lagna, 7th, 4th
outcome: 8th shows prosperity; 9th children; Lagna looks; 7th husband and her influence; 4th chastity
strength_note: Benefic there good; malefic bad unless owning that house
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.11 sl.1

input: Woman's Lagna and Moon in even signs aspected by benefics
outcome: Good sons, excellent husband, prosperous; odd signs with malefics give masculine, ungovernable, poor
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.11 sl.2

input: Woman: 7th house or setting navamsa owned by benefic
outcome: Husband handsome, famous, learned, wealthy; otherwise deformed, gambler, couple lives apart
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.11 sl.3

input: Woman: Mars in or owning rasi and navamsa of 7th
outcome: Widowhood; mixed planets in 7th give remarriage; malefics in 8th destroy husband
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.11 sl.3

input: Woman: benefics in trikona; weak malefics in trikona
outcome: Children and wealth; with weak malefics, barren or children die early
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.11 sl.5

outcome: Diseased womb
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.11 sl.4

input: Woman: malefics in 4th house
outcome: Unchaste; benefics with Moon, Lagna, 4th give chastity
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.11 sl.4-5

input: Jupiter and 5th lord (from Lagna and Moon) well placed, 5th aspected by benefic, or Lagna lord and 5th lord together/exchange/mutual aspect
outcome: Children assured
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.12 sl.1

input: 5th houses from Lagna, Jupiter, Moon with malefics and no benefic aspect, hemmed by malefics, lords in 6/8/12
outcome: No issue at all
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.12 sl.2

input: Malefic owning 5th sits in 5th (children); malefic in 5th (many sons); benefic owning or exalted in 5th

source: Phaladeepika, Adh.12 sl.3

input: 5th house is Scorpio, Virgo or Leo

source: Phaladeepika, Adh.12 sl.3

input: Sun in 5th in childless sign, Saturn 8th, Mars Lagna (or Saturn Lagna, Jupiter 8th, Mars 12th); or Moon 11th with malefic 5th from Jupiter and many planets in Lagna

input: Sun, Mars or Venus alone in 5th in Cancer

outcome: Extinction of family line
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.12 sl.6

input: 5th house sign of Saturn or Mercury aspected by Mandi or Saturn; or 5th lord weak and unconnected with 1st and 7th lords
outcome: Son by adoption
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.12 sl.8

outcome: Loss of children

input: 5th lord, Jupiter, Mars, Sun in male navamsas

source: Phaladeepika, Adh.12 sl.19-22

input: Childlessness from afflicted 5th

strength_note: Appropriate japa and gifts for the planet

input: Barrenness indicated by chidra tithi or vishti karana (computed from Moon and Sun figures)

input: Birth of son

input: Lagna lord transits conjunction with 5th lord, its exaltation sign, own sign, 5th house, or sign of 5th lord

strength_note: Remedy: yearly birthday homa and medical care till age 12
