strength_note: Ashlesha gives the reverse
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.13 sl.8

input: Malefics alone in 8th and kendras; or all in 1st and 8th; or 1st and 7th; Moon/Lagna between malefics; weak Moon in 6/8/12
outcome: Child dies soon after birth
strength_note: Also waning Moon with malefic in 1,5,7,9; malefics in 7 and 8; no benefic in or aspecting kendra
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.13 sl.12

input: Lagna lord or Moon-sign lord weak in 6/8/12
outcome: Child dies in years equal to sign number (from Aries); weak decanate lord gives months; weak navamsa lord days
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.13 sl.13

input: Benefics and Lagna lord in kendra / panaphara / apoklima
outcome: Long / medium / short life; 8th lord and malefics in those places reverse this
strength_note: Judged together with friendship of Lagna lord with 8th lord and of Sun with Lagna lord
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.13 sl.15

input: Lagna lord (and Moon sign lord) stronger than 8th lord from each, rasi and navamsa
outcome: Long life; otherwise short
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.13 sl.16

input: Short-life yoga: Saturn transits point equal to sum of natal Saturn, Jupiter, Sun, Moon
outcome: Death in first Saturn cycle for short life, second for medium, third for long life
strength_note: Dasa and bhukti at the time must also be bad
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.13 sl.18

input: Lagna lord with malefic, combust, debilitated or in enemy sign; it transits 6/8/12 or Lagna
outcome: Death is predicted at that time
strength_note: Same from navamsa Lagna, decanate Lagna, Moon sign
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.13 sl.19

input: Lagna lord strong in kendra aspected by benefics, no malefic aspect
outcome: Wards off death, long life and sovereignty
strength_note: Strong Jupiter in Lagna removes many evils; waxing Moon in trikona/11th/kendra in Sun, Moon or Jupiter sign wards off ills
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.13 sl.21-23

input: No malefics in 1,4,5,7,8,9,10 and Lagna lord and Jupiter in kendras
outcome: 100 years free from disease
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.13 sl.24

input: Disease read from planets in 6th, 8th, 12th, 6th lord and planets with it
outcome: Disease type from the planet; more reliable if two or three yogas agree
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.1

input: Sun afflicting: fever, burning, epilepsy, heart disease, eye trouble, skin disease; danger from fire, weapons, poison, enemies
outcome: Sun-type diseases
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.2

input: Moon afflicting: sleepiness, phlegm, diarrhoea, jaundice, mental disturbance, blood impurity, danger from water
outcome: Moon-type diseases
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.3

input: Mars afflicting: thirst, bilious fever, blood disorder, leprosy, eye disease, epilepsy, deformities, psoriasis, trouble from enemies and thieves
outcome: Mars-type diseases
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.4

input: Mercury afflicting: mental disease, speech, throat and nose, fever, skin disease, anaemia, bad dreams
outcome: Mercury-type diseases
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.5

input: Jupiter afflicting: intestinal disorder, swoon, phlegm, ear trouble, giddiness, harm via Brahmins and elders
outcome: Jupiter-type diseases
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.6

input: Venus afflicting: anaemia, urinary and genital diseases, loss of vigour through sex, eye trouble
outcome: Venus-type diseases
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.7

input: Saturn afflicting: wind and phlegm, leg paralysis, belly-ache, heart pain, injury to limb, mental anguish
outcome: Saturn-type diseases
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.8

input: Rahu afflicting: palpitation, leprosy, mental aberration, poison, leg pain; Ketu: disputes and enemies
outcome: Rahu/Ketu diseases
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.9

input: Moon and Sun in 12th and 2nd with or aspected by Saturn and Mars
outcome: Eye disease
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.10

input: 3rd and 11th houses and Jupiter with or aspected by Saturn and Mars
outcome: Ear disease
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.10

input: Mars in 5th with 6th or 8th lord
outcome: Belly-ache
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.10

input: Lords of 8th and 6th in 7th and 8th with malefics
outcome: Rectal disease; with Venus, disease of private parts
strength_note: Use common sense and experience
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.10

input: Sun in 6th/8th: fever; Mars or Ketu: ulcers; Venus: genital disease; Jupiter: consumption; Saturn: nervous disease
outcome: Disease by planet in 6th or 8th
strength_note: Rahu aspected by Mars: carbuncle; Saturn with Moon: enlarged spleen; waning Moon in water sign with malefic: dropsy or consumption
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.11

input: Cause of death
outcome: Death by disease of the strongest planet in or aspecting 8th; if none, by 8th sign nature or house of 8th lord; else by 8th lord or 22nd decanate lord
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.12-13

input: Cause of death by planet
outcome: Sun fire, fever, weapon; Moon water diseases; Mars accident, fire, weapons; Mercury anaemia, giddiness; Jupiter phlegm, easy death; Venus venereal; Saturn wind disease, typhoid; Rahu poison, leprosy; Ketu suicide, assassination, worms
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.14-15

input: 8th lord malefic and malefic occupied with malefic star; two malefics in kendras aspecting each other
outcome: Death by weapon, fire, tiger, snake, ruler's anger, poison
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.20

input: 12th house or lord in benefic sign/navamsa or with benefic
outcome: Peaceful death; otherwise painful
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.21

input: Planet with 12th lord or in 12th or in 12th navamsa
outcome: Afterlife destination: Sun/Moon Kailasa, Venus heaven, Mars earth, Mercury Vaikuntha, Jupiter Brahmaloka, Saturn Yama's world, Ketu hell
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.14 sl.23

input: Bhava strength
outcome: Bhava gives full good results if occupied or aspected by benefics or own lord, free of malefic influence, lord not debilitated, combust or in enemy sign
strength_note: Malefic owning the bhava also does good
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.1

input: Trikona, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 10th from a bhava hold benefics or its lord, no malefics
outcome: Bhava is strong; mixed occupants mix results; malefic-filled gives decay
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.2

input: Bhava lord in 8th, combust, debilitated or enemy sign with no benefic aspect
outcome: Bhava is destroyed; a malefic in it doubles ruin
strength_note: Even a benefic non-lord there cannot help
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.3

input: Bhava lord in 6/8/12 or occupied by lord of 6/8/12; malefics in 6/8/12 from bhava
outcome: Bhava suffers annihilation
strength_note: Benefic aspect rescues it
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.4-5

input: Dasa of 8th lord from the bhava, 22nd decanate lord, or weak planets in 6th, 7th, 8th from it
outcome: Bhava is destroyed in that dasa
strength_note: Malefics in 3, 6, 11 and benefics in kendra/kona from bhava give success in their dasas
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.7

input: Dasa of 3rd lord, Moon, planet in or aspecting 8th, Saturn, 22nd decanate lord, Mandi sign lord, or weak Rahu
outcome: Bhava destroyed in that dasa
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.8

input: Lagna lord's placement
outcome: Bhava occupied by Lagna lord prospers; it pushes houses owned by planets associated with it
strength_note: Lagna lord owning dusthana as well gives Lagna result only
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.9-10

input: Planet owning two houses
outcome: Moolatrikona house result is full, other half; both come in its dasa, first half gives the house coming first
strength_note: Others say odd-sign planet gives odd house first
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.11

input: Planet in bhavasandhi (junction of houses)
outcome: Gives no effect in its dasa and bhukti even if strong
strength_note: Check this before predicting dasas
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.13-14

input: Karakas of bhavas 1 to 12
outcome: Sun; Jupiter; Mars; Moon+Mercury; Jupiter; Saturn+Mars; Venus; Saturn; Sun+Jupiter; Jupiter+Sun+Mercury+Saturn; Jupiter; Saturn
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.17

input: Natural significations
outcome: Sun father and fortune; Moon mother and mind; Mars brothers, land; Mercury learning, uncle; Jupiter sons, wealth; Venus wife, vehicles; Saturn longevity, livelihood, death cause
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.15-16

input: Judging any bhava or relative
outcome: Treat that bhava as Lagna and read 12 houses from it; for father use Sun as Lagna (2nd from Sun father's wealth, 8th his longevity, 10th his work), likewise Moon for mother, Mars for brothers
strength_note: Good result when bhava, its lord and its karaka are all strong
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.20-25

input: Karakas placed in own bhava: Moon 4th, Mars 3rd, Jupiter 5th, Venus 7th, Saturn 8th
outcome: Some authors say these spoil the bhava concerned
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.26

input: Lagna lord conjoined with a bhava lord or sitting in a bhava
outcome: Gives effects of that bhava; good if bhava and lord strong, bad if weak
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.27

input: Bhava owners strong and linked with Lagna lord having many ashtakavarga dots in Lagna lord's chart
outcome: Happy effects of that bhava; few dots and weak owners give adverse effects
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.28

input: Lord of a dusthana sitting in another house of his own
outcome: Dasa gives results of the house occupied, not of the dusthana owned (e.g. Saturn in Capricorn as 5th gives sons)
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.29

input: Planets linked by exchange, conjunction, mutual aspect, mutual kendra or mutual trine
outcome: Five kinds of connection between two planets
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.15 sl.30

input: Lagna lord in kendra/kona strong, exalted or own, 8th lord not in kendra, benefic in Lagna
outcome: Long life, rich, honoured, fearless, good family
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.2

input: Lagna lord with strong planet; in exaltation; in own sign; in movable/fixed/dual sign
outcome: Patronage of king; becomes king; lives in native place; wanders; stays in one place; mixed
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.3

input: Lagna lord in dusthana, enemy or debilitation sign
outcome: Miserable life in despicable surroundings; weak Lagna brings constant calamity and disease
strength_note: Strong Lagna gives prosperity and prominence
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.4

input: 2nd lord conjoined with Jupiter, Mercury, Venus, Moon, Mars, Rahu, Ketu
outcome: Scriptures and law (Jupiter); politics (Mercury); erotic arts (Venus); arts (Moon); hard labour (Mars); stammering (Rahu, Ketu)
strength_note: Malefics in 2nd make a fool without wealth; 2nd lord with Saturn low learning
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.5-6

input: Lords of 3rd and Lagna exchange places and are strong
outcome: Brave, helps brothers, daring acts
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.7

input: 3rd lord strong with benefic, Mars strong in benefic house
outcome: Brothers prosper; if weak or badly placed, loss of brothers
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.8

input: 4th lord and Moon in dusthana, hemmed by malefics or aspected by malefics
outcome: Death of mother; if strong with benefics, mother happy
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.10

input: Lagna lord in 4th or 4th lord in Lagna with Moon aspect
outcome: Native performs mother's funeral rites; if in enemy/debilitation signs or 6/8 unlinked, he cannot
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.11

input: 4th lord and Venus well placed in Lagna and 4th
outcome: Palanquin, lordship, gold, silk, jewels, cows, elephants, horses
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.13

input: 4th lord in dusthana or with Sun and Mars, or Mars and Sun in 4th
outcome: Birth house is burnt; Rahu/Saturn with 4th lord gives old dilapidated house; enemy planet there gives usurped property
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.14

input: Malefics in 6th, or Lagna lord with strong 6th lord, or 6th lord in 6th or kendra, or with malefics
outcome: Constant intense trouble from enemies
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.16

input: 6th lord in dusthana, debilitated or combust, Lagna lord stronger, Sun in 9th
outcome: Enemies destroyed
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.18

input: 7th house linked with benefic and 7th lord strong
outcome: Wife virtuous, happy, with children
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.20

input: 8th lord not in kendra and weaker than Lagna lord
outcome: Long-lived, free from anxiety and obstacles
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.22

input: Mars or Sun in 9th and 9th lord in dusthana or between malefics
outcome: Father dies soon after birth; if not, in Sun or Mars dasa
strength_note: Strong Sun (day) or Saturn (night) with strong 9th lord gives long-lived father
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.22-23

input: Sun and Moon in trine to Saturn and Mars
outcome: Child abandoned by both parents; Jupiter aspect gives long happy life
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.24

input: 9th lord Saturn in movable sign without benefic aspect, or Sun in dusthana
outcome: Brought up by foster-father; Saturn aspect on 9th in movable sign with strong 12th lord gives adoption
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.25-26

input: Benefic in 10th with strong 10th lord in kendra/kona own or exalted, or Lagna lord in 10th
outcome: Revered, famous, virtuous, king-like wealth, long-lived
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.27

input: Sun or Mars in 10th with well-placed 10th lord
outcome: Mighty personage, great valorous undertakings; Rahu, Saturn, Ketu in 10th give sinful acts
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.28

input: Bhava owned by planet with 11th lord, and bhava where 11th lord sits
outcome: Gains come in matters of those bhavas
strength_note: Loss in matters of bhava owned by planet in 12th and bhava of 12th lord
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.29-30

input: Lagna lord transits trine to sign/amsa of bhava lord, or enters the bhava; bhava lord transits trine to Lagna lord's sign or Lagna; or both conjoin or aspect
outcome: Success or gain of that bhava; also when karaka transits with lord of Lagna/Moon sign
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.31

input: Jupiter transits trine to rasi/amsa of bhava lord
outcome: Good effect of bhava realised
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.32

input: Lagna lord and bhava lord conjoin in transit (also from Moon)
outcome: Success of bhava if bhava lord strong; if inimical or 6/8 apart, rivalry with that person in transit; if friends, new friendship
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.16 sl.33-35

input: Saturn transits rasi and navamsa of 8th or 12th lord from a bhava, or trines of these
outcome: Total destruction of that bhava
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.17 sl.1

input: Saturn transits sign/navamsa (or trines) of 8th lord, Gulika, natal Saturn or 22nd decanate lord
outcome: Death may happen
strength_note: Judge also Jupiter, Sun, Moon transits over same points
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.17 sl.2-5

input: Saturn transits sign of birth Saturn, Moon sign lord or 8th lord, or its trines
outcome: Death may be expected
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.17 sl.24

input: Sun transits 6th, 7th or 12th from natal Venus
outcome: Death sure per authorities
strength_note: Use with dasa
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.17 sl.27

input: Vimshottari dasa order from Krittika repeating every nine stars
outcome: Sun 6, Moon 10, Mars 7, Rahu 18, Jupiter 16, Saturn 19, Mercury 17, Ketu 7, Venus 20 years
strength_note: Balance = (Moon's remaining part of star) x years of star lord
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.19 sl.2-3

input: Sun mahadasa, Sun badly placed
outcome: Quarrel, ruler's displeasure, illness among relatives, wandering, mental anguish, fire danger to wealth, sons, wife
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.19 sl.5

input: Sun mahadasa, Sun well placed
outcome: Wealth through bold acts, journeys, kings; fame, business success, devotion to duty
strength_note: Also money by cruel acts, trouble from fire and beasts, eye and stomach illness, separation from parents
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.19 sl.6,18

input: Moon mahadasa
outcome: Peace of mind, business success, food, wife, children, ornaments, cows, land; money via prayers and royal favour; may suffer wind disease
strength_note: Judge Moon's strength first: first 10 days of lunar month moderate, middle 10 full, last 10 waning
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.19 sl.7-8,19

input: Mars mahadasa
outcome: Wealth through fire, king, fighting, medicine, cheating; bile and blood disorders, fever, quarrels with wife, relatives, elders; low women
strength_note: Also land, litigation, more cattle and land, quarrels with brothers and sons
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.19 sl.9,20

input: Mercury mahadasa
outcome: Friends, comforts, fame among learned, elders' favour, clever speech, wife and children happy, exalted position; money via teachers, Brahmins, new land, cows, horses
strength_note: Wind, heat and phlegm diseases
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.19 sl.10,24

input: Jupiter mahadasa
outcome: Virtuous deeds, children, honour from ruler, elephants, horses, vehicles, wishes fulfilled; new clothes, retinue, respect
strength_note: Ear disease, phlegm, separation from elders
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.19 sl.11,22

input: Venus mahadasa
outcome: Vehicles, cows, gems, enjoyment with young women, travel, royal gifts; acquisition of wife, jewels, trade and agriculture profit
strength_note: Also grief, parents or elders may die
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.19 sl.12,26

input: Saturn mahadasa
outcome: Wife and children get gout or wind disease, agricultural loss, bad women, servants desert, absence from home, sudden loss of relations, land, wealth
strength_note: Gain via country troubles, fighting, servants, cattle; piles, burning limbs
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.19 sl.13,23

input: Rahu mahadasa
outcome: Trouble from ruler, thieves, poison, fire, weapons, children's illness, dismissal from office, failure of business
strength_note: If Rahu with benefic in good house: affluence like a king; Rahu in Virgo, Pisces or Scorpio gives honour and lands but lost at end
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.19 sl.14-16

input: Ketu mahadasa
outcome: Trouble from enemies, thieves, ruler, wounds, fever, false blame, fire danger, living abroad, confusion over women, tooth and leg pain
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.19 sl.17,25

input: Dasa of Lagna lord (Lagna strong)
outcome: Rise to eminence, strong body, increasing prosperity
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.2

input: Dasa of strong 2nd lord
outcome: Family success, good meals, money by lectures, eloquence
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.3

input: Dasa of strong 3rd lord
outcome: Help of brothers, good news, valour, army leadership, honour
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.4

input: Dasa of strong 4th lord
outcome: Help to relatives, farming success, vehicles, new land and house, promotion
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.5

input: Dasa of strong 5th lord
outcome: Birth of son, honour with relatives, post as counsellor, meritorious acts
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.6

input: Dasa of strong 6th lord
outcome: Enemies subdued, perfect health, power
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.7

input: Dasa of strong 7th lord
outcome: New clothes, jewels, bed, pleasures with beloved, marriages and festivities in family, trips
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.8

input: Dasa of strong 8th lord
outcome: Debts cleared, own elevation, quarrels cease, cattle and servants
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.9

input: Dasa of strong 9th lord
outcome: Prosperity with wife, sons, grandchildren; merit; royal favour; reverence to Brahmins and gods
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.10

input: Dasa of strong 10th lord
outcome: Business or undertaking succeeds, renown, permanent position, respect
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.11

input: Dasa of strong 11th lord
outcome: Uninterrupted income, meeting relatives, servants, domestic happiness
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.12

input: Dasa of strong 12th lord
outcome: Spending for good causes, merit, royal honours
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.13

input: Dasa of weak or badly placed Lagna lord
outcome: Imprisonment, hidden life, fear, disease, loss of position
strength_note: 2nd lord weak: foolish talk in assembly, untruthful, eye trouble, heavy spending
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.15

input: Dasa of weak 3rd lord in dusthana / weak 4th lord
outcome: Brother's death, evil counsel, hidden enemies; 4th: mother distressed, friends sick, danger to house, land, cattle
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.16

input: Dasa of weak 5th lord
outcome: Loss of a son, mental aberration, stomach trouble, ruler's displeasure
strength_note: Weak 6th lord dasa: thieves, defeat, disease, servility, wounds
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.17

input: Dasa of weak 7th lord
outcome: Separation from beloved, affairs with bad women, genital disease, wandering
strength_note: Weak 8th lord dasa: sorrow, poverty, calumny, sickness, death
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.18

input: Dasa of weak 9th lord
outcome: Wrath of deity, trouble to wife and children, father or elder may die, penury
strength_note: Weak 10th lord dasa: work fruitless, loss of honour, absence abroad
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.19

input: Dasa of weak 11th lord or weak 12th lord
outcome: 11th: bad news, trouble to brother, child's sickness, ear disease; 12th: diseases, dishonour, bondage, wealth vanishes
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.20

input: Planet in vargottama navamsa
outcome: Its dasa is favourable; mixed if combust or debilitated; unfavourable when dasa and antardasa lords both own or occupy 6/8/12
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.22

input: Malefic dasa with antardasa of lord of 3rd, 5th or 7th star from natal star, or Moon-sign lord or 8th lord
outcome: Trouble from thieves and enemies, misery
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.23

input: 4th dasa in order is Saturn's, 6th is Jupiter's, 5th is Mars or Rahu; planet at sign end or owning 6/8/12
outcome: Such dasas are dangerous
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.24

input: Mars in an upward-facing sign or in exalted sign as 10th/11th house
outcome: Its dasa gives a kingdom, wins enemies, vehicles, army
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.25

input: Venus uneclipsed, free of malefics, in own or exalted sign as 12th, 10th or 11th
outcome: Dasa gives gems, wealth, praise
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.26

input: Benefics in debilitation, enemy sign, 6th or 12th (or malefics so placed)
outcome: Benefic dasa gives bad results; malefic gives very intense misery
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.27

input: Antardasa of planet inimical to dasa lord, in 6th/enemy house, or inimical to Lagna lord
outcome: Danger from enemies, loss or change of position; friends turn hostile
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.28

input: Antardasa lord's house counted from dasa lord
outcome: Only that bhava's results come in the bhukti; bad if bhukti lord in 6/8/12 from dasa lord, good elsewhere
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.29

input: Planet in exaltation, moolatrikona, own, friend, enemy, debilitation sign
outcome: Benefic influence full, three quarters, half, quarter, minimal, nil; reversed for malefics; combust acts like debilitated
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.30

input: Weakest among Saturn, Mandi, Rahu, 22nd decanate lord, 8th lord and lords of their navamsa signs
outcome: Its dasa is fatal; death when Saturn transits 6th, 8th or 12th
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.31

input: Stronger of 8th-lord's sign lord and navamsa lord / 22nd and rising decanate lords: its dasa plus Jupiter transit of 8th lord's rasi, navamsa or trines
outcome: Death may occur
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.32

input: Jupiter, Moon-sign lord and Lagna lord in kendras
outcome: Middle of life is good; planets in prishtodaya signs give results late, ubhayodaya in the middle, shirshodaya early
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.33

input: Dasa lord transits own, exalted or friendly sign (and was strong at birth)
outcome: Prospers the bhava it rules; if weak at birth, its transit destroys the bhava it passes
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.34-35

input: Moon transits exaltation or friend sign of dasa lord, or 3rd, 6th, 7th, 10th, 11th or trine from dasa lord
outcome: Happy effects in that dasa; otherwise not happy
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.36

input: Bhukti lord in transit through own or exalted sign or retrograde (good); debilitation, enemy sign or combust (misery)
outcome: Result of bhukti accordingly
strength_note: Good bhukti shows when Sun enters its exaltation sign or Jupiter transits there
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.37-38

input: Rahu's dasa
outcome: Gives results of planet he associates with; that planet turns evil toward end of its own dasa
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.39

input: Lords of 2nd and 7th (maraka) and planets in them powerful
outcome: They can cause death in their dasa; weak 8th or 12th lord can bring death in its bhukti
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.40

input: Parashara view on dasa lords
outcome: Kendra-owning benefic is bad, malefic good; trikona owners always good; 3rd, 6th, 11th lords bad even if benefic; 8th lord who is Lagna lord is good; Sun/Moon owning 8th good
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.41

input: Trikona lord in kendra or kendra lord in trikona
outcome: Auspicious; in each other's bhukti they cooperate and make the period good
strength_note: Kendra and trikona lords related become yogakaraka even if they own bad houses
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.20 sl.42,45

input: Planets related to dasa lord (by conjunction, aspect, exchange, kendra or trikona)

input: Dasa of trikona lord with bhukti of kendra lord, and the reverse

input: Dasa of planet fallen from exaltation (avarohini), in friend's or exalted sign (madhya), rising from debilitation (arohini), in debilitation/enemy (adhama)

input: Death of relative of a bhava

input: Dasa lord transits Lagna or 3rd, 6th, 10th, 11th from it, or friend or benefic comes to Lagna

input: Dasa lord's position from natal Moon during transit; Moon in friend sign, exaltation, 7th, trikona or upachaya from dasa lord

outcome: Danger to life; if planet is benefic only business failure
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.26 sl.28

input: Janma, Anujanma, Trijanma stars (1st, 10th, 19th) fall on Sun's sankranti, planet sign change, eclipse, planetary war, or meteor fall
outcome: Death or serious misfortune expected
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.26 sl.29

input: Planet aspected by an unfavourable planet while giving good results (or the reverse)
outcome: Effects become void; same for aspect by its enemies
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.26 sl.30

input: Planet in exaltation or own sign transiting an unfavourable house
outcome: Does no harm; in favourable house gives full good
strength_note: Planet debilitated, enemy or combust in a favourable house is void; in unfavourable house gives aggravated bad
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.26 sl.31-32

input: Saturn, Sun, Mars or Jupiter transit 12th, 8th or 1st from Moon
outcome: Danger to life, fall from position, loss of wealth
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.26 sl.33

input: Moon in 8th, Mars 7th, Rahu 9th, Venus 6th, Jupiter 3rd, Sun 5th, Saturn 1st, Mercury 4th in transit
outcome: Loss of honour and wealth, danger to life if all conditions exist
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.26 sl.34

input: Nakshatra counted from natal star in transit, by planet: Sun on 1st star face (destruction), 2-5 head (wealth), 6-9 breast (success), 10-13 right hand (gain), 14-19 feet (loss), 20-23 left hand (illness), 24-25 eyes (gain), 26-27 genitals (danger to life)
outcome: Tara-based transit by body parts
strength_note: Mars, Saturn etc. have their own tables
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.26 sl.35-40

input: Planet transits sign with many benefic dots in its ashtakavarga, even 6th, 8th or 12th
outcome: Result is good always
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.26 sl.41

input: Latta: Sun's 12th, Mars' 3rd, Jupiter's 6th, Saturn's 8th star ahead; rear: Venus' 5th, Mercury' 7th, Rahu's 9th, Moon' 22nd star behind; hits natal star
outcome: Sickness and anguish: Sun ruin of business, Rahu/Ketu misery, Jupiter death or ruin of relatives, Venus quarrel, Mercury loss of position, Moon great loss
strength_note: Two or three lattas together multiply the evil
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.26 sl.42-47

input: Sun conjunct Moon / Mars / Mercury / Jupiter / Venus / Saturn
outcome: Machinery and stone work; sinful deeds; clever and famous; helps others though cruel; actor or weapons earner; metalwork or pottery
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.18 sl.1

input: Moon conjunct Mars / Mercury / Jupiter / Venus / Saturn
outcome: Rough tools, spirits, earthenware trade; sweet speech, fame; wealthy family chief but fickle; weaving and tailoring; son of a remarried widow
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.18 sl.2

input: Mars conjunct Mercury / Jupiter / Venus / Saturn
outcome: Herbs, oils, drugs, boxing; city head, king or rich Brahmin; shepherd, wrestler, gambler, adulterer; miserable, untruthful
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.18 sl.3

input: Mercury conjunct Jupiter / Venus / Saturn; Jupiter conjunct Venus / Saturn
outcome: Actor, musician, dancer; eloquent, landed, assembly head; cheat, licentious; learned, wealthy with wife; barber, potter or cook
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.18 sl.4

input: Venus conjunct Saturn
outcome: Short-sighted, wealth grows through a young woman, marriage key to financial success, writing and painting skill
strength_note: With more than two planets combine the pair results
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.18 sl.5

input: Moon in Aries aspected by Mars / Mercury / Jupiter / Venus / Saturn / Sun
outcome: King; learned; king; king-equal; thief; poor
strength_note: Similar six-fold lists given for Moon in every sign (Adh.18 sl.6-11), e.g. Moon in Leo aspected in order: king, astrologer, wealthy, king, barber, king
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.18 sl.6

input: Moon in Mars navamsa aspected by Sun / Mars / Mercury / Jupiter / Venus / Saturn
outcome: City watchman; fond of killing; close fighter; king; rich; promotes quarrels
strength_note: Similar lists given for Moon in other planets' navamsas
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.18 sl.12-15

input: Moon in vargottama / own navamsa / other navamsa
outcome: Good effects of Moon-aspect rules are full / middling / little; bad effects reverse; strong navamsa lord overrides the sign-aspect result
source: Phaladeepika, Adh.18 sl.17

input: Planets in Virgo, Gemini, Taurus, Leo, Sagittarius, Aquarius (several planets)
outcome: Famous king with army, elephants, horses; planets in Libra, Aries, Taurus, Pisces give emperor
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.1

input: Planets in Virgo, Aries, Libra, Leo, Aquarius; planets in 3rd, 4th, 5th houses
outcome: King; ruler of wealthy countries; a planet each in 3,4,5,2,9,1,7 gives just king
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.2

input: Benefics in 9th and 11th, malefics in 6th and 10th; or planets in Moon's hora
outcome: King
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.3

input: Strong benefics in 1st, 4th, 7th, 10th and Mars and Saturn in 9th and 11th
outcome: King with every amiable virtue
strength_note: Combination is rare
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.4

input: Moon or Lagna in vargottama aspected by planets in 4th, 10th, 7th (at least four planets other than Moon)
outcome: Leader of men, king
strength_note: Per Saravali and Brihatjataka quoted in commentary
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.5

input: Venus in Ashwini in Lagna aspected by all other planets
outcome: Head of family, destroys enemies, many women
strength_note: 3 or more planets in own navamsa (not debilitation) with one in Lagna make a king; 5 or more a very wealthy one
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.6

input: Venus with strong Lagna lord in 2nd house (not in debilitation or enemy sign)
outcome: King
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.7

input: Venus in Pisces Lagna and Pisces navamsa; or strong Lagna lord exalted aspected by Moon; or Lagna lord in exaltation kendra sign alone
outcome: King; royal person; ruler of earth
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.8

input: Full Moon in 9th in own, exalted or friendly sign with Saturn in 10th and Mars in 2nd
outcome: Lord of earth
strength_note: Full strong Moon in a kendra other than Lagna aspected by Venus and Jupiter gives a king who gives land gifts
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.9

input: Planet at exact exaltation point aspected by very friendly planet; or Venus strong in 11th
outcome: King; king's peer
strength_note: 2 or 3 exalted planets with Moon in Cancer and strong Lagna give king honoured everywhere
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.10

input: Malefics in upachaya houses and benefics in 1st or 10th
outcome: Cruel king who crushes enemies
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.11

input: Mars in Sagittarius, Aries or Leo as Lagna aspected by friendly planet; Sun, Moon, Jupiter strong in 3rd, 9th, 5th
outcome: King by own prowess; king as rich as Kubera
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.12

input: 10th lord in 8th in navamsa of its exalted sign, own or friend sign
outcome: King of kings
strength_note: Also Jupiter debilitated in Lagna with malefic in 8th in the 8th navamsa-sign of a malefic
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.15

input: Jupiter as Lagna lord in 12th, Saturn (3rd lord) in 12th from Jupiter, Sun in 11th
outcome: King of kings
strength_note: Mercury with or aspected by Jupiter makes king's favourite
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.16

input: Jupiter in Lagna and Mercury in kendra aspected by 9th lord
outcome: Equal to kings
strength_note: Strong Saturn in moolatrikona or exalted in kendra/trikona aspected by 11th lord also gives equality with rulers
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.17

input: Moon in Lagna, Jupiter in 4th, Venus in 10th, Saturn in own or exalted sign
outcome: King or king's equal
strength_note: Benefics in 12,11,1,2,3,10 give a sovereign-like person favoured by kings
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.18

input: 10th and 9th lords with 2nd lord (or 6th and 5th lords exchanging signs, or 7th and 6th lords in mutual kendras with 2nd lord)
outcome: Three wealth yogas; with 4th lord or karaka aspect also many vehicles
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.21

input: Six planets in exaltation; five exalted with Jupiter in Lagna
outcome: King of kings; ruler of all lands
strength_note: One to four exalted planets alone do not make an ordinary person a king; malefics only give cruel king
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.22

input: Full Moon with a planet other than Lagna lord aspected by Venus, Mercury, Jupiter; or Jupiter, Venus, Mars in vargottama with no malefic in kendra
outcome: King; ruler of men
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.29

input: All planets in shirshodaya signs and Moon in Cancer aspected by benefics; or Lagna lord in 9th or 10th with Moon in Lagna
outcome: King; ruler of earth
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.30

input: Lagna lord in upachaya from Moon, benefics in kendras in benefic navamsas, malefics powerless
outcome: King equal to Indra
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.32

input: Mercury in Lagna, Jupiter in 7th, full Moon in Cancer 4th, Venus in 10th
outcome: Ruler of the earth, healthy and undisturbed
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.37

input: Strong full Moon (predominant in strength)
outcome: Victorious king
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.48

input: Jupiter with Venus in 2nd house
outcome: Lord of earth, conquers enemies
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.49

input: Lagna lord in kendra, 10th lord in 4th, 9th lord in 11th
outcome: King with long life
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.50

input: Mercury in moolatrikona, unobscured, in swastha state
outcome: Excellent knowledge of every kind of learning
strength_note: Other planets so placed do not give this
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.41

input: Sun strong in Sagittarius Lagna, Mars with Moon in 10th, Venus in 11th or 12th
outcome: King comparable to Indra
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.50

input: Malefics in 3rd, 11th, 6th and Lagna lord aspected by benefics
outcome: Strong energetic king praised by all
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.51

input: Moon with Saturn in 11th, 4th or 10th, born in royal family
outcome: King or rich man equal to king
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.53

input: Lagna lord in upachaya, Moon in 9th, benefics strong in benefic vargas in kendras; or Jupiter and Moon in Taurus with Lagna lord in trikona unaspected by Saturn/Mars
outcome: King; ruler of earth
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.54

input: Sun in Pisces and Moon in Cancer
outcome: King
strength_note: Planets aspected by enemy or debilitated planets fail to give royal fortune
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.55

input: One to seven planets in debilitation or enemy signs
outcome: Increasing misery: no wealth, no comfort, no intellect, sickness, captivity, involvement in murder and crimes
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.56

input: Saturn in Lagna in Sagittarius, Pisces, Libra, Aries, Capricorn or Aquarius
outcome: Lord of men, handsome, wise; leads town or village
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.57

input: Planet strength by sign status
outcome: Benefic gives full result in exaltation, three quarters in moolatrikona, half in own sign, quarter in friend sign, minimal in enemy sign, nil in debilitation or combustion; reversed for malefics
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.58

input: Mahapurusha yogas (Ruchaka, Bhadra, Hamsa, Malavya, Sasa): planet in kendra in moolatrikona, own or exalted sign
outcome: Ruchaka: strong, learned, king, lives 70 years; Bhadra: majestic, king, lives 80; Hamsa: handsome, learned, lives 82; Malavya: powerful, wealthy, lives 77; Sasa: king or minister, cruel, lives 70
strength_note: Full strength planet needed
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.59-65

input: Timing of a yoga's results
outcome: A yoga takes effect in dasa of the planet causing it (the strongest planet in it); rajayogas act in dasa and antardasa of Lagna lord or 10th lord/occupant
strength_note: Mahapurusha-type yogas act through life
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.66

input: Mercury 2nd from Sun, Moon 11th from Mercury, Jupiter in trikona from Moon (Bhaskara yoga)
outcome: Brave, learned, handsome, good speaker, capable
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.67

input: Mars 3rd from Moon, Saturn 7th from Mars, Venus 7th from Saturn, Jupiter 7th from Venus
outcome: Celebrated, eloquent, rich, royal rank
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.68

input: Jupiter in Lagna, Moon in kendra from Jupiter, Rahu 2nd from Moon, Sun and Mars 3rd from it (Budha yoga)
outcome: Majestic, strong, famous, learned, skilled trader, no enemies
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.70

input: Moon in Lagna or 7th without Jupiter's aspect, or planets with few ashtakavarga dots (Kemadruma)
outcome: Poverty; Kemadruma destroys rajayogas
strength_note: Cancelled when Moon or Venus in kendra is aspected by Jupiter, or Moon with benefic, or Moon between benefics
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.71-82

input: Moon seized by Rahu/Ketu aspected by malefic, or malefic in 4th from Lagna or Moon
outcome: Soon poverty
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.75

input: Mars 2nd (or 12th) from Moon in Sunapha
outcome: Fierce, wealthy king, hypocritical, brave
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.86

input: Mercury 2nd from Moon (Sunapha)
outcome: Well versed in Vedas, arts and music, intelligent, pleasant speaker
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.87

input: Jupiter 2nd from Moon (Sunapha)
outcome: Excels in knowledge, prosperous, good family, favoured by ruler
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.88

input: Venus 2nd from Moon (Sunapha)
outcome: Brave, married, rich in land, cattle and horses
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.89

input: Saturn 2nd from Moon (Sunapha)
outcome: Esteem of people, talented, wealthy
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.90

input: Moon between Mars and Mercury / Mars and Jupiter / Mars and Venus
outcome: Untruthful, clever, depraved, avaricious / renowned self-made but harassed by foes / athletic and handsome
source: Jataka Parijata Vol I, Adh.7 sl.96-98

input: Dasa results
outcome: Good and evil in life come in the dasa periods; yogas decide the character of dasa; adapt results to the caste of the native
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.1-2

input: Planet strong, moving to exaltation, with above-average ashtakavarga dots, in 10th, 11th or 1st, in exaltation/benefic varga, with six-fold strength
outcome: Its dasa is propitious
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.4

input: Planet owns sign occupied by Mandi, sits with Mandi, has few dots, is in enemy/debilitation/combust, is in bhava sandhi or with malefics
outcome: Its dasa produces evil
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.5

input: At start of dasa, Lagna lord is in Lagna or 3rd, 6th, 10th, 11th from it; or Lagna falls in lord's saptavarga; or friend/benefic in Lagna
outcome: Dasa is auspicious
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.6,14

input: Moon (in transit) in friend's sign of dasa lord, its exaltation sign, 7th, trikona or upachaya from dasa lord
outcome: Good effects in dasa; the bhava of that sign prospers, otherwise suffers
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.7-8

input: Planet's ishta (good) portion exceeds kashta (bad) portion
outcome: Good results in its dasa; reverse gives evil; equal gives mixed
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.10-11

input: Dasa lord in own sign, exaltation, friend's sign, upachaya from Lagna, or aspected by benefic or friend
outcome: Dasa and bhukti favourable
strength_note: Two mutually friendly strong planets give prosperity in dasa and bhukti; two weak enemies give evil
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.15-16

input: Planet occupies a bhava
outcome: In its dasa it affects that bhava: benefic improves it, malefic harms it
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.17

input: Dasa lord with benefic / with malefic / with mixed planet
outcome: Very auspicious / barren of effect / mixed results
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.18

input: Dasa and apahara of a planet
outcome: Acquisition of property in the metal ruled by that planet if benefic; diminishing if malefic
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.19

input: Dasa of planet that is karaka of a concern
outcome: That concern prospers in its dasa if planet is well placed; fails if afflicted; dasa with hostile planet multiplies enemies
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.20-21

input: Dasa of Jupiter (karaka of royalty) or lord of the 10th
outcome: Royal favour; lord of 9th gives religious austerities; lord of 10th gives sacrifices and merit
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.22

input: Planet in shirshodaya sign / prishtodaya sign / both
outcome: Gives results at start / end / all through its period
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.24

input: Dasa of 6th lord; dasa/apahara of 8th lord; dasa/apahara of 7th lord
outcome: 6th: lamentation; 8th: death may set in; 7th: loss of near relative
strength_note: Prosperity in apaharas of lords of the Sampat, Sadhaka, Maitra, Paramamaitra, Kshema stars
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.26

input: Dasa of planet in rikshasandhi (end of nakshatra) or at 30th degree of a sign
outcome: Sorrow and disease; planet at last degree of sign may bring death
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.27

input: Planet debilitated at birth
outcome: Cannot give good, nor can planets with it; with Rahu does harm
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.28

input: Planet very inimical to a bhava lord sits in a house with no benefic dots
outcome: That bhava is destroyed in the inimical planet's dasa
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.29

input: Dasa of planet owning or with the badhaka (obstructing) lord; planet in kendra from badhaka sthana
outcome: Disease, distress, sorrow, foreign travel; planets in 6/8 from each other: danger, exile in their dasa-apahara
strength_note: Badhaka houses: 11th for movable Lagna, 9th for fixed, 7th for dual
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.30

input: Dasa planet in Deeptha / Swastha / Mudita / Santha state
outcome: Kingship and wealth / traditions, comfort, health / royal favour and power / health and prosperity
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.31

input: Dasa planet in Pidita / Deena / Vikala / Khala / Bheeta state
outcome: Danger from robbers, rulers, loss of younger brother / distress / distress and disease / mental anguish / dread of enemies
strength_note: Shakta state gives learning, wealth, austerities
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.32

input: Nakshatra dasa start
outcome: Start dasa from lord of strongest of Lagna star, Moon star, name star, query Moon star; Utpanna/Adhana/Kshema cycles from 5th, 8th, 4th star; all planets tend to do evil at end of their dasas
strength_note: Dasas ending together mark end of life
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.33-35

input: Day birth: sum of Sun and Saturn; night birth: Moon and Rahu: find star and corresponding point in its mahadasa
outcome: Time of death
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.36

input: Malefic in Lagna during its dasa with malefic bhukti
outcome: Distress, disease, loss of wealth, danger from rulers and foes; mixed in benefic bhukti
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.41

input: Dasa of Lagna lord with bhukti of malefic
outcome: Disease, death or loss of place
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.42

input: Dasa of 2nd lord with Saturn bhukti; malefic 2nd lord with Saturn, Mars, Rahu, Sun antara
outcome: Loss of wealth, quarrels with friends and kin
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.43-44

input: Malefic occupying 2nd house in its antardasa
outcome: Ruler's displeasure, loss of honour and wealth, imprisonment, hatred of friends
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.45

input: Malefic 3rd lord dasa with malefic bhukti (Saturn, Mars, Rahu, Ketu, Sun)
outcome: Trouble from foes, weapons, thieves; loss of or quarrels with brothers and sisters
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.46-47

input: Dasa of non-benefic 4th lord with malefic bhukti
outcome: Loss of place, quarrels with relatives, damage to agriculture, cattle, wealth
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.48

input: 5th lord dasa with malefic apahara / benefic apahara
outcome: Danger from ruler or son falls ill / gain of wealth and children, kindness of rulers, wishes fulfilled
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.49

input: 7th lord dasa with apahara of planet in khala state
outcome: Loss of wife, becomes a wanderer
strength_note: 6th lord dasa with non-benefic bhukti: danger from king or fire, misfortune, disease
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.50

input: 8th lord dasa with malefic apahara
outcome: Risk from foes, loss of life, wealth, fame, ejection from honour
strength_note: 9th lord dasa with malefic bhukti: death of parents, imprisonment, waste of wealth
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.51

input: 10th lord dasa (khala state) with malefic bhukti
outcome: Sickness to dear ones, removal from office, loss of comfort, fame and money
strength_note: 11th lord dasa with Saturn, Mars, Sun, Rahu bhukti: ruin of business, ruler's danger, loss
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.52

input: 12th lord dasa with Sun, Saturn or Mars bhukti
outcome: Discord with wife, sons, relatives, loss of strength, honour, wealth; Rahu bhukti poison risk
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.53

input: Dasa and bhukti of planets 6th/8th from each other; dasa and antara of two weak planets in same house; malefic dasa with malefic antara
outcome: Loss of place or life; death of native may be predicted
strength_note: Malefics in malefic sign aspected by enemies bring death in their dasa
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.54-56

input: Planet inimical to lord of a death-dealing dasa
outcome: Death time comes in its bhukti, antara and sukshma dasa, especially when malefic
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.57

input: Antardasa length (Parijata method)
outcome: Mahadasa years x antardasa planet years; product without unit digit gives months; unit digit x 3 gives days
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.61

input: Sun dasa phases
outcome: Start: father ill and expense; middle: trouble to household; end: ease and comfort
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.71

input: Sun dasa, Sun in debilitation navamsa in exaltation sign
outcome: Blame, danger, death of son, wife or paternal relative, farming loss
strength_note: Sun in debilitation sign in exalted navamsa: regal prosperity, but loss of wealth or demise near end
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.72

input: Sun dasa, Mars antardasa
outcome: Wealth in gems and gold, royal favour, bile diseases
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.64

input: Sun dasa, Rahu antardasa
outcome: Fear of premature death, trouble from relatives and enemies, loss of place
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.65

input: Sun dasa, Jupiter antardasa
outcome: Wealth through a worthy son, honour, virtue, good society
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.66

input: Sun dasa, Saturn antardasa
outcome: Hostility from all, lack of energy, ignoble calling, worry, risk from rulers and thieves
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.67

input: Sun dasa, Ketu antardasa
outcome: Throat disease, mental anguish, eye inflammation, premature death
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.69

input: Moon dasa, Saturn antardasa
outcome: Mother's suffering, wind and bile ailments, harsh words, discord with unfriendly people
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.78

input: Moon dasa, Mercury antardasa
outcome: Wealth from maternal relatives, learned men, clothes and ornaments
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.79

input: Moon dasa, Ketu antardasa
outcome: Wife ill, loss of relatives, stomach disease, loss of property
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.80

input: Moon dasa, Venus antardasa
outcome: Dowry via wife, farm and cattle comforts; disease inherited from mother
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.81

input: Moon dasa, Sun antardasa
outcome: Almost regal power, health, enemies decline, prosperity
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.82

input: Moon dasa phases
outcome: Start: effect of bhava Moon owns; middle: effect of sign and Moon's position; end: effect of aspects and body part of the bhava
strength_note: Same pattern applies to other planets' dasas
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.83

input: Mars dasa phases and own bhukti
outcome: Start: humiliation and waste of wealth; middle and end: danger from rulers, fire, robbers
strength_note: Mars own bhukti: heat, friends dislike, brother annoyance, ruler danger, ruin of undertakings
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.84-85,94

input: Mars dasa, Jupiter antardasa
outcome: Wealth and land via Brahmins, health, public esteem
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.87

input: Mars dasa, Saturn antardasa
outcome: Misery from illness, enemies, robbers, kings, loss of wealth
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.88

input: Mars debilitation navamsa in exalted sign dasa
outcome: Death among children and brothers; Mars in debilitation sign in exalted navamsa gives farming success and land
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.95

input: Rahu dasa phases
outcome: Start: distress; middle: enjoyment; end: bereavement of parents and loss of status
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.109

input: Rahu dasa, Rahu in Cancer, Taurus or Aries
outcome: Wealth, honour from ruler, wives and dependants; Virgo, Pisces or Sagittarius gives wife, children, land but lost at end of dasa; Leo, Virgo or Cancer gives kingship
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.106-108

input: Rahu dasa, Jupiter antardasa
outcome: Disappearance of ailments and enemies, royal favour, wealth, children
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.98

input: Rahu dasa, Ketu antardasa
outcome: Robbery, loss of wealth and honour, loss of children, cattle deaths
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.101

input: Jupiter dasa
outcome: Rank, wealth, vehicles, royal goodwill, power, knowledge, wife and children
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.110-111

input: Jupiter dasa, Saturn antardasa
outcome: Aversion, mental anguish, waste of wealth through sons, business failure
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.112

input: Jupiter dasa, Mars antardasa
outcome: Business failure, wandering, high fever, loss of wealth
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.118

input: Jupiter debilitation navamsa in exalted sign dasa
outcome: Danger from robbers, foes, rulers, hatred of wife and sons; Jupiter in debilitation sign in exalted navamsa gives royal favour, learning, fame, perhaps lordship of the country
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.120

input: Saturn dasa
outcome: Goats, asses, camels, old women, coarse grain; wealth through guild or village headship; rules a low tribe
strength_note: Own bhukti: disease, envy, sorrow, loss of wealth to kings and robbers
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.121-123

input: Saturn dasa, Rahu antardasa
outcome: Disease in every limb, robbers and rulers rob wealth
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.130

input: Saturn dasa, Jupiter antardasa
outcome: Devotion to gods, royal favour, great happiness, rank
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.131

input: Saturn debilitation navamsa in exalted sign
outcome: Happiness at start of dasa, woe at end; reverse placement gives happy end but early evil from robbers and exile
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.132

input: Mercury dasa
outcome: Money through seniors, relatives, friends; fame; embassy; income from gold goods; wind ailment
strength_note: Own bhukti: beautiful houses, apparel, money via Brahmins, success in undertakings
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.133-134

input: Mercury dasa, Sun antardasa
outcome: Apparel, ornaments, wealth, royal favour, moral homilies
strength_note: Venus antardasa: gifts to seniors, duty, wealth, clothing
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.136-137

input: Mercury dasa, Moon antardasa
outcome: Diseases, enemies' ill-will, failure of concerns, risk from quadrupeds
source: Jataka Parijata Vol II, Adh.18 sl.138

input: Sun aspects Ascendant
outcome: Valorous, irascible with women, cruel, gains wealth from father's side, serves the king
strength_note: Aspect on lagna
source: Saravali ch.34 v1-7

input: Moon aspects Ascendant
outcome: Under influence of women, fortunate, courteous, wealthy, gains from water-born goods
strength_note: Aspect on lagna
source: Saravali ch.34 v1-7

input: Mars aspects Ascendant
outcome: Fond of battle and brave acts, irascible, righteous
strength_note: Aspect on lagna
source: Saravali ch.34 v1-7

input: Mercury aspects Ascendant
outcome: Skilled in arts, gains by them, intelligent, famous, honoured
strength_note: Aspect on lagna
source: Saravali ch.34 v1-7

input: Jupiter aspects Ascendant
outcome: Religious, honoured by the king, famous, has virtuous company
strength_note: Aspect on lagna
source: Saravali ch.34 v1-7

input: Venus aspects Ascendant
outcome: Youthful, enjoys wealth and pleasure, beautiful
strength_note: Aspect on lagna
source: Saravali ch.34 v1-7

input: Saturn aspects Ascendant
outcome: Troubled by heavy loads, travel and disease, irascible, devoid of happiness
strength_note: Aspect on lagna
source: Saravali ch.34 v1-7

outcome: Happiness, wealth and closeness to the king
strength_note: If not own sign, benefic gives good and malefic gives bad results
source: Saravali ch.34 v8

input: Two or more planets aspect Ascendant
outcome: Happiness and wealth
strength_note: One benefic aspect is good, one malefic aspect is bad
source: Saravali ch.34 v10-11

input: All planets aspect the Ascendant
outcome: Rules the earth; if planets strong, happiness, fearless, long life
strength_note: Strong planets
source: Saravali ch.34 v10-11

input: Three planets in the Ascendant
outcome: Free from misery and lord of the earth
strength_note: If all three are malefics: fear, grief, eats much, disregarded
source: Saravali ch.34 v12

input: Benefics only in 6th, 7th and 8th from Ascendant, no malefics (Lagnadhi Yoga)
outcome: Minister, army leader or king, many women, long life, no disease
strength_note: Planets must be in own or friendly or exalted sign, weak if fallen
source: Saravali ch.34 v13-14

input: Mars, Saturn and Sun in 2nd house
outcome: Wealth destroyed
strength_note: More so if weak Moon aspects 2nd
source: Saravali ch.34 v15-20

input: Benefics in 2nd house
outcome: Money comes in many ways
source: Saravali ch.34 v15-20

input: Saturn alone in 2nd aspected by Mercury
outcome: Very rich
source: Saravali ch.34 v15-20

input: Jupiter in 2nd aspected by Mercury, or Mercury in 2nd aspected by Moon
outcome: Earned wealth is lost
source: Saravali ch.34 v15-20

input: 2nd from Moon aspected by Venus or Jupiter
outcome: Plenty of wealth
source: Saravali ch.34 v15-20

input: 3rd house owned and occupied by malefic
outcome: Younger siblings are destroyed
strength_note: Benefic sign and benefics there give happiness from siblings
source: Saravali ch.34 v21-24

input: Saturn in 3rd aspected by Mars
outcome: Siblings destroyed
strength_note: Venus in 3rd aspected by Jupiter increases sibling happiness
source: Saravali ch.34 v21-24

input: 5th house has a benefic, or benefic aspects it, or is a benefic sign
outcome: Native surely has children
strength_note: If different, no children
source: Saravali ch.34 v25-26

input: 5th house malefic sign with strong malefics and no benefic aspect
outcome: Childless
source: Saravali ch.34 v37

input: Mars in 5th house
outcome: Children die after birth
strength_note: If Jupiter or Venus aspects, only first child lost; if all planets aspect, no loss
source: Saravali ch.34 v41

input: 5th house in even-sign divisions only with Moon and Venus influence
outcome: Only female children
strength_note: Opposite (odd signs, no Moon or Venus) gives only male children
source: Saravali ch.34 v39

input: Moon in 10th, Venus in 7th, malefics in 4th
outcome: Family line does not continue
source: Saravali ch.34 v40

input: 5th house belongs to Saturn, Saturn there, Moon aspects
outcome: Child by adoption or purchase
strength_note: Same if Mercury in own 5th aspected by Moon
source: Saravali ch.34 v29

input: Malefics only in 3rd house
outcome: Lacks wealth, own people and happiness
strength_note: Mars there gives distress, Saturn gives sickness, Mercury/Jupiter/Venus give wealth and happiness
source: Saravali ch.34 v42

input: 6th house aspected by Saturn and occupied by Mars
outcome: Fear from enemies
strength_note: Benefic in or aspecting 6th removes fear; number of planets in 6th = number of enemies
source: Saravali ch.34 v43-44

input: Malefics in 7th house or 7th in malefic divisions
outcome: Wife is harmed
strength_note: Judge from Ascendant and Moon, stronger one counts
source: Saravali ch.34 v46

input: Moon with Saturn in 7th
outcome: Marries a widow
source: Saravali ch.34 v46

input: Mars in 7th house
outcome: Native loses wife
strength_note: If aspected only by Saturn, wife certainly dies
source: Saravali ch.34 v50-51

input: Venus and Moon strong in 7th or many Venus divisions in 7th
outcome: More than one wife
source: Saravali ch.34 v48

input: Mercury and Jupiter together in 7th
outcome: Only one wife
source: Saravali ch.34 v47

input: Mercury and Venus in 7th
outcome: No wife or children; with benefic aspect, marries late
source: Saravali ch.34 v56

input: Malefics in Ascendant, 12th and 7th with waning Moon in 5th
outcome: No wife and no children
source: Saravali ch.34 v54-55

input: Moon with one of Mercury, Jupiter or Venus in 7th
outcome: Wealthy
source: Saravali ch.34 v57

input: Sun in, aspecting or owning 11th house
outcome: Gains through kings, war, forests, animals
source: Saravali ch.34 v58

input: Moon related to 11th house
outcome: Gains through women; more if Moon waxing
source: Saravali ch.34 v59

input: Mercury related to 11th house
outcome: Gains through writing, arts and debate
source: Saravali ch.34 v61

input: Jupiter related to 11th house
outcome: Gains through city headship, royal favour, gold, religious acts
source: Saravali ch.34 v62

input: Saturn related to 11th house
outcome: Gains through towns, villages, iron, long-lasting works
source: Saravali ch.34 v64

input: Sun or weak Moon in 12th
outcome: Wealth lost to the king
strength_note: Jupiter, waxing Moon and Venus in 12th increase wealth if Mars does not aspect
source: Saravali ch.34 v69-70

input: Three or four strong planets in exaltation or Mulatrikona signs at birth (royal birth)
outcome: Becomes a ruler
strength_note: 5 or 6 such planets make even a low-born person a king; 1 or 2 give wealth only
source: Saravali ch.35 v2

input: Moon-sign lord and Ascendant lord together in an angle with friendly aspects
outcome: Becomes a king
source: Saravali ch.35 v34

input: Ascendant or Moon in Vargottama navamsa aspected by 5 or 6 planets
outcome: Becomes a king even from a low family
source: Saravali ch.35 v6

input: Aries ascendant with Moon, Mars and Jupiter in it
outcome: Emperor, destroys enemies
source: Saravali ch.35 v7

input: Chandradhi yoga: benefics in 6th, 7th, 8th from Moon without Sun or malefic aspect
outcome: King, healthy, fearless, valorous, happy
source: Saravali ch.35 v20-21

input: 3 or 4 strong benefics in Vargottama, in angles, not combust
outcome: Becomes a king
strength_note: Single strong benefic in Vargottama with friendly aspect also gives kingship
source: Saravali ch.35 v28-29

input: Full Moon aspected by Venus, Jupiter, Mercury, strong Ascendant lord, dual sign ascendant in Vargottama
outcome: Becomes a king
source: Saravali ch.35 v27

input: Moon in deep exaltation aspected by Venus, malefics in 3rd, 6th, 9th, 12th
outcome: Becomes a king
source: Saravali ch.35 v33

input: Saturn, Sun, Mars, Moon, Venus, Mercury in second half of Capricorn, Leo, Aries, Cancer, Libra, Virgo respectively
outcome: Becomes an emperor
strength_note: Saturn must be strong
source: Saravali ch.35 v36

input: All planets in Vargottama navamsa and radiant
outcome: Emperor of whole earth
source: Saravali ch.35 v37

input: Full Moon exalted and Vargottama, aspected by a benefic
outcome: Famous ruler, gains most in the dasa of that benefic
strength_note: No strong malefic in an angle
source: Saravali ch.35 v41

input: Full Moon aspected by all planets
outcome: Long life and protection from Kemadruma and similar bad yogas
source: Saravali ch.35 v47

input: Six planets exalted, radiant, in own navamsas
outcome: Emperor
source: Saravali ch.35 v49

input: All planets act as yogakaraka
outcome: Emperor; if only one planet does so, rules a province
source: Saravali ch.35 v62

input: Planet in its own panchamsa
outcome: Becomes a ruler; emperor if all are strong
source: Saravali ch.35 v63

input: Moon aspected by Jupiter from Taurus
outcome: Rules the whole earth
source: Saravali ch.35 v64

input: Saturn in Ascendant and Jupiter in 7th, one aspected by Venus
outcome: Even a villager becomes a king
source: Saravali ch.35 v68

input: Exalted Jupiter in an angle and Venus in 10th
outcome: Famous king
source: Saravali ch.35 v78

input: Moon in 3rd or 10th house with exalted Jupiter
outcome: Ruler of the earth with great wealth
source: Saravali ch.35 v77

input: Mercury, Jupiter, Venus or Moon (one or more) strong in 9th and aspected by a friend
outcome: King-like status
source: Saravali ch.35 v74

input: Nagara yoga: all planets in Ascendant, 4th, 7th and 10th
outcome: Rules the earth
source: Saravali ch.35 v93

input: Chakra yoga: all planets in alternate signs from Ascendant (six signs)
outcome: Becomes a king
source: Saravali ch.35 v89-90

input: All planets in first six houses from Ascendant
outcome: Becomes a king; if in only four houses, becomes a king's minister
source: Saravali ch.35 v91

input: All benefics in 11th and 9th (Kalasa yoga)
outcome: Raja yoga
source: Saravali ch.35 v95

input: Moon exalted in Ascendant, with Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, Mars, Sun in 2nd, Libra, Virgo, Aries, Leo
outcome: Very famous king
source: Saravali ch.35 v101

input: Jupiter in Ascendant (not Capricorn)
outcome: King with elephants and means
source: Saravali ch.35 v103

input: Full Moon in an angle other than Ascendant
outcome: King with wealth, vehicles and valour
source: Saravali ch.35 v106

input: Venus aspects Jupiter
outcome: Valorous king (for royal birth)
source: Saravali ch.35 v107

input: Mercury aspected by Jupiter
outcome: Honoured king
source: Saravali ch.35 v108

input: Jupiter and Venus both in 2nd house
outcome: King who overpowers enemies
source: Saravali ch.35 v125

input: Jupiter in Cancer in 10th from Moon
outcome: Lord of the entire earth
source: Saravali ch.35 v118

input: Jupiter and Venus in exaltation or own houses, one in an angle, 9th, 2nd or 11th (royal birth)
outcome: Becomes a king
source: Saravali ch.35 v121

input: Strong benefic in angle with all strengths, free of malefic aspect or conjunction
outcome: Becomes a king
strength_note: Alternative: three strong planets in angles
source: Saravali ch.35 v122

input: Ascendant lord at beginning of a sign
outcome: Army chief or judge under the king
strength_note: Middle of sign: head of state; end of sign: only a village head
source: Saravali ch.35 v146

input: Ascendant lord and Moon-sign lord strong in an angle in friendly sign, aspecting Ascendant (Pushkala yoga)
outcome: Becomes a king
source: Saravali ch.35 v144-145

input: Moon with Saturn in an angle
outcome: Wealthy king even if born out of wedlock
source: Saravali ch.35 v153

input: Moon in Pushyami, Krittika or Ashwini, or Vargottama
outcome: Emperor born
source: Saravali ch.35 v163

input: Mars in Ashwini, Anuradha or Dhanishta, with Vargottama or exaltation
outcome: Raja yoga
source: Saravali ch.35 v164

input: All other planets in 3rd, 6th, 10th, 11th from Moon
outcome: King honoured by all
source: Saravali ch.35 v166

input: All planets in 3rd, 5th and 11th from the Sun
outcome: King, minister or army chief
source: Saravali ch.35 v172

input: Malefic in 11th from Ascendant lord (radiant) and benefic in an angle
outcome: Self-earned kingdom
source: Saravali ch.35 v173

input: Moon and Jupiter in angles from Ascendant aspected by Venus, no debilitated planet
outcome: King with wide fame
source: Saravali ch.35 v177

input: Sun and Moon in own houses, one aspected by Jupiter
outcome: Becomes a king
source: Saravali ch.35 v179

input: Full Moon in exaltation or own sign aspected by 5 friendly planets, no fallen planet
outcome: Becomes a ruler
source: Saravali ch.35 v184

input: Total planetary rays 11 to 15 (Saravali ray count)
outcome: Learned, virtuous, righteous, handsome, high descent
strength_note: Rays counted by strength rules in ch.36
source: Saravali ch.36 v12-16

input: Total planetary rays 21 to 25
outcome: Honour, fortune, courage, scholarship, kingship in order
source: Saravali ch.36 v21-25

input: Total planetary rays 5 or fewer
outcome: Miserable, low descent, dependent on others, poor
source: Saravali ch.36 v10-11

input: Total planetary rays 6 to 10
outcome: Servant, lives away from birth place, unlucky
source: Saravali ch.36 v10-11

input: Total planetary rays 44
outcome: Emperor, honours gods and Brahmins, long-lived, mighty
source: Saravali ch.36 v21-25

input: Venus in own or exalted sign in an angle (Malavya yoga)
outcome: Great-man yoga: long life about 70, rules regions, good looks
source: Saravali ch.37 v2-4

input: Mars in own or exalted sign in an angle (Ruchaka yoga)
outcome: Valorous, conqueror of enemies, chief, skilled in mantra, dies by weapon or fire
source: Saravali ch.37 v5-7

input: Saturn in own or exalted sign in an angle (Sasa yoga)
outcome: Army chief, ruler of a place, crafty, likes forts and hills
source: Saravali ch.37 v8-10

input: Jupiter in own or exalted sign in an angle (Hamsa yoga)
outcome: Learned, great virility, rules land, lives about 100 years
source: Saravali ch.37 v11-13

outcome: Learned, valorous, knows Shastras, rules middle country, dies about 80

outcome: No kingship, but wealth and children in that planet's dasa

input: Two or more of Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, Sun fallen, one in Ascendant, Moon in Scorpio
outcome: Raja yogas become futile

input: Five planets fallen at birth
outcome: Raja yogas do not work
source: Saravali ch.39 v10

input: Three or more planets fallen
outcome: Even an emperor's son becomes a beggar and poor
source: Saravali ch.39 v20

input: Weak Moon in last navamsa of movable sign, 8th of fixed, or first of dual sign, with no aspect
outcome: Raja yogas only in name
source: Saravali ch.39 v3

input: Aquarius rising and three planets fallen
outcome: Hundreds of raja yogas fail
source: Saravali ch.39 v6

input: Sun in 10th degree of Libra (deep fall)
outcome: Destroys all raja yogas
source: Saravali ch.39 v15

input: Kemadruma yoga with Moon unaspected by planets
outcome: Raja yogas lose effect, poor conduct
source: Saravali ch.39 v19

input: Venus in its debilitation navamsa
outcome: Even a large kingdom is lost
source: Saravali ch.39 v22

input: Meteor, earthquake, Vyatipata or Upaketu seen at birth
outcome: Good raja yogas cancelled
source: Saravali ch.39 v11

input: Raja-yoga planets in war or losing strength
outcome: Raja yogas cancelled
source: Saravali ch.39 v13

input: Moola dasa planet in exaltation, own sign, own navamsa, friendly sign or full strength
outcome: Dasa gives good results
strength_note: Also good if strong or aspected by a benefic at start of dasa
source: Saravali ch.41 v6

input: Moola dasa planet in fall, enemy sign or navamsa, combust, or aspected by malefics
outcome: Dasa gives bad results
source: Saravali ch.41 v7

input: Dasa planet is moving toward exaltation (Arohini dasa) but in enemy or fall division
outcome: Brings difficulties

input: Moon's sign at start of a Moola dasa is Cancer
outcome: Gain of wealth through virtuous women
strength_note: Moon at dasa start is considered important
source: Saravali ch.41 v10-14

input: Moon at start of Moola dasa in Virgo
outcome: Association with courtesans during the dasa
source: Saravali ch.41 v10-14

input: Moon at start of dasa in a sign of Jupiter
outcome: Happiness, wealth, honour and authority
source: Saravali ch.41 v10-14

input: Moon at start of dasa aspected by Mars or Saturn
outcome: Loss of relatives and wealth, then disease
strength_note: Mercury's aspect gives learning
source: Saravali ch.41 v15

input: Dasa lord in Ascendant or in 3rd, 6th, 10th, 11th from the Ascendant at dasa start
outcome: Excellent dasa

input: Moon at dasa start in friendly or exaltation sign, upachaya house, or 5th, 7th, 9th from dasa lord
outcome: Good results in the dasa
strength_note: Otherwise even an exalted planet gives bad results
source: Saravali ch.41 v17-18

input: Planet in friendly sign but in enemy or fall navamsa
outcome: Mixed dasa results
strength_note: A weak planet's dasa is useless
source: Saravali ch.41 v19

outcome: Gains from forests, medicine, travel and royal contact; courage, fame, kingship

input: Adverse Sun dasa

outcome: Gains through women, water, milk, sugar; honour from elders and king

outcome: Gains from kings, land, goats, buffaloes, copper, gold, grain

outcome: Quarrels with friends, wife, brothers; bloody disease, wounds, bile

outcome: Gains through friends, children, king, trade; fame, high intelligence, enemies destroyed

input: Sun dasa, Sun debilitated

outcome: Death-like danger

input: Moon dasa, waning Moon
outcome: Fever, abdomen, head and eye disorders

input: Dasa of an exalted planet in the Ascendant

outcome: Death-like danger

outcome: Leaving own country, disease, loss of position, quarrels, confinement

outcome: Death, loss of wealth or imprisonment

outcome: Gain through friends, happiness and honour

input: Moon dasa, Venus bhukti
outcome: Vehicles, ornaments, many wives
