source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.12-13

input: Auspicious Ketu dasa
outcome: Success all round, gains through bloody acts, favour of a foreign king, enemies destroyed
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.13-14

input: Inauspicious Ketu dasa
outcome: Miseries, fruitless efforts, loss of position, rheumatism, heart pain, tuberculosis
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.13-14

input: Rahu or Ketu in 5th or 9th associated with or aspected by lord of 2nd or 7th
outcome: Death can occur in their dasa
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.14-15

input: Rahu or Ketu in 2nd or 7th associated with lord of 5th or 9th
outcome: Wealth and long life in their dasa
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.14-15

input: Rahu or Ketu in dual signs with sign lords linked to kendra or kona lords
outcome: Wealth and power in their dasa
strength_note: If linked to 6th, 8th or 12th lord: little gain, mother or her relatives may die
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.15-16

input: Rahu or Ketu in 6th, 8th, 12th associated with those house lords
outcome: Harm in their dasa; with maraka lords can cause death
strength_note: With kendra/kona lords in dusthanas: some happiness then death by disease or wounds
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.17-18

input: Rahu or Ketu with strong yogakaraka in 1st, 3rd, 4th, 7th or 10th
outcome: Prosperity, children, wealth, power, vehicles
strength_note: With 7th and 2nd lords they instead bring loss of wealth and death
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.18-19

input: Rahu and Ketu strong and linked to a house lord
outcome: They give the results of that house lord in their dasa
strength_note: Strength of the occupied house lord decides the result
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.20-21

input: Dasa lord of a kendra or kona house
outcome: Dasa and bhukti are auspicious
strength_note: Lords of 2nd, 3rd, 11th medium; lords of 6th, 8th, 12th always adverse
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.22-23

input: Bhukti lord in 6th, 8th or 12th from dasa lord
outcome: Bhukti lord is hostile to dasa lord, bad results
strength_note: Planets in 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, 10, 11 from dasa lord are very good; 7th also favourable
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.23-24

input: Dasa lord inauspicious and bhukti lord auspicious but not associated with dasa lord
outcome: Bhukti results are adverse
strength_note: Benefic bhukti lord associated with dasa lord gives mixed results
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.24-25

input: Dasa lord can cause both yoga and death
outcome: Gives yoga results first in its own bhukti
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.24-25

input: Jupiter and Venus in each other's dasa and bhukti, strong and well placed
outcome: Kingship or minister post, wealth, happiness from wife and children, auspicious functions
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.26-27

input: Jupiter and Venus in 6/8 or 2/12 from each other, or lords of those houses, with malefic aspects and weak
outcome: Separation from wife and sons, trouble through women, royal displeasure
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.27-28

input: Venus and Saturn both strong in exaltation, own sign or Vargottama, mutual dasa and bhukti
outcome: Becomes a beggar even if born rich
strength_note: If one strong and one weak, the stronger gives the yoga
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.28-29

input: Saturn and Sun strong in own or exalted signs, kendra or kona: Saturn dasa Sun bhukti
outcome: Royal favour and wealth; Sun dasa Saturn bhukti gives happiness and victory
strength_note: If both malefic: distress
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.30-31

input: Mars and Jupiter strong in good houses with benefic aspect or company
outcome: Raja yoga, enjoyments, long-lived sons, marriage and pleasant ceremonies in their dasa and bhukti
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.31-32

input: Jupiter and Mercury strong in dasa and bhukti
outcome: Good actions, great learning, clever trader, wife, children, happiness
strength_note: Same for Venus-Mercury, Jupiter-Moon, Moon-Venus, Jupiter-Sun, Sun-Mars, Sun-Mercury
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.32-33

input: Annual chart (solar return): Sun returns to natal position
outcome: Nature of the year's effects read from that chart's lagna, planets and bhavas
strength_note: Divide count of Moon star from natal star by 9 to find the dasa order
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.33-34

input: Annual dasa days per 365-day year: Sun 110, Moon 60, Mars 32, Mercury 40, Jupiter 48, Venus 56, Saturn 4, Rahu 5, Lagna 10
strength_note: Annual dasa starts from Moon's balance in star at start of year
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.34-36

input: Annual dasa results
outcome: Also consider transit of planets through houses from natal Moon sign and combine
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.36-37

input: Strong Sun in annual dasa
outcome: Wealth, ornaments, new clothes
strength_note: Weak Sun: more enemies, loss of wealth
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.37-38

input: Strong Moon in annual dasa
outcome: Royal favour, steady income, respectable position
strength_note: Weak Moon: enemies, sickness, change of place, family quarrels
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.37-38

input: Strong Mars in annual dasa
outcome: Royal favour, success, domestic happiness
strength_note: Weak Mars: displeasure of ruler, disputes with sons, enmity with wife, loss of wealth
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.38-39

input: Strong Jupiter in annual dasa
outcome: Good vehicles and houses, generous, very wealthy
strength_note: Weak Jupiter: change of place, loss of wealth, bad company
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.39-40

input: Strong Venus in annual dasa
outcome: Wealth, name and fame, women around
strength_note: Weak Venus: loss of wealth, enemies, disease from women
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.39-40

input: Strong Saturn in annual dasa
outcome: Gets a mansion, leads a tribe
strength_note: Weak Saturn: loss of wealth, thin body, sickness, bad name
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.40-41

input: Strong Rahu in annual dasa
outcome: Virtue, good income, rise in official status
strength_note: Weak Rahu: father may die, low company, enemies
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.40-41

input: Query (prashna): Lagna at query time rising Aries
outcome: Query concerns two-legged beings
strength_note: Taurus: four-legged; Gemini: pregnancy; Cancer: legal dispute; Leo: Government
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.7 sl.6

input: Query: Virgo rising
outcome: Query about intrigue with a woman other than wife
strength_note: Libra: trade; Scorpio: fear from wicked people; Sagittarius: lost wealth; Capricorn: sinful deed; Aquarius: religious rites; Pisces: position and residence
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.7 sl.7

input: Query planet strength: planet exalted when query is made
outcome: Matter is finished almost at once
strength_note: Own house: a few days; friendly house: a few months
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.7 sl.9-10

input: 5th house signification
outcome: Children, learning, mantras, minister, mind, paternal property, fortune through wife, wisdom, pregnancy
strength_note: Karakatva of bhavas
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.8-9

input: 6th house signification
outcome: Disease, enemies, debt, wounds, maternal uncle, theft, prison, service, poison, urinary trouble
strength_note: Karakatva of bhavas
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.9-11

input: 7th house signification
outcome: Marriage, wife, sex, trade, journey halts, foreign place, theft, adopted son, controversy
strength_note: Karakatva of bhavas
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.11-13

input: 8th house signification
outcome: Longevity, defeat, patrimony, death of relatives, calamity, punishment by ruler, loss of money, loss of limb, battle
strength_note: Karakatva of bhavas
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.13-15

input: 9th house signification
outcome: Charity, religion, pilgrimage, elders, conveyance, fortune, son, daughter, wealth, paternal wealth, Vedic sacrifice
strength_note: Karakatva of bhavas
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.15-17

input: 10th house signification
outcome: Trade, honour from ruler, government work, service, agriculture, fame, mother, medicine, teaching, supremacy, authority
strength_note: Karakatva of bhavas
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.17-18

input: 11th house signification
outcome: Gain from all sources, elder brother, paternal uncle, learning, gold, easy gain, wishes fulfilled, ministership
strength_note: Karakatva of bhavas
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.18-20

input: 12th house signification
outcome: Sleep, mental agony, enemies, imprisonment, debts discharged, expenditure, loss of wife, going to another place, death
strength_note: Karakatva of bhavas
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.20-22

input: Sun as karaka
outcome: Soul, power, courage, royal favour, father, land, bones, eye, kingdom, forest, travel
strength_note: Karakatva of planets
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.22-25

input: Moon as karaka
outcome: Mind, mother, woman, sleep, travel, pearls, silver, water, happiness, fame, beauty, job
strength_note: Karakatva of planets
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.25-29

input: Mars as karaka
outcome: Courage, land, strength, battle, brother, king, army commander, fire, wound, enemy, service under ruler, house
strength_note: Karakatva of planets
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.30-33

input: Mercury as karaka
outcome: Education, mathematics, speech, writing, astrology, trade, maternal uncle, skin, doctor, grammar
strength_note: Karakatva of planets
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.34-37

input: Jupiter as karaka
outcome: Son, grandson, teacher, wealth, religion, charity, royal honour, physical health, eldest brother, merchant
strength_note: Karakatva of planets
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.38-41

input: Venus as karaka
outcome: Marriage, wife, sex pleasure, vehicle, ornaments, music, dance, poetry, income, fame, semen
strength_note: Karakatva of planets
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.42-45

input: Saturn as karaka
outcome: Laziness, obstruction, sickness, misery, death, servant, old age, iron, oil, long distress, theft
strength_note: Karakatva of planets
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.45-50

input: Rahu as karaka
outcome: Going abroad, wickedness, gambling, snakes, falsehood, travel, sharp pain, catarrh
strength_note: Karakatva of planets
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.51-52

input: Ketu as karaka
outcome: Salvation, penance, wealth, fever, stomach pain, boils, indifference to the world, knowledge of Brahma, witchcraft
strength_note: Karakatva of planets
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.53-54

input: Dasa and bhukti lords
outcome: Show fruits of past karma; do shanti remedies for evil periods
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.2

input: Vimshottari dasa years: Sun 6, Moon 10, Mars 7, Rahu 18, Jupiter 16, Saturn 19, Mercury 17, Ketu 7, Venus 20 (this text's sequence)
outcome: First dasa from the Moon star counted from Krittika, count divided by 9
strength_note: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.3
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.3

input: Planet condition (nine avasthas): exalted Deepta, own sign Swastha, dear friend's sign Mudita, friend's sign Shanta, neutral's sign Heena, enemy's sign Dukhita, with malefic Vikala, defeated in war Khala, combust Kopa
outcome: Names the nine states of a planet used to judge its result
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.6 sl.1

input: Lord of a house in 8th from Lagna, combust, fallen or in enemy sign, with no benefic aspect
outcome: Effects of that house are completely destroyed, even benefic company does not save it
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.6

input: Lagna lord in 1st, middle or last drekkana of Lagna
outcome: Becomes a judge, chieftain or village headman respectively
strength_note: With Venus, Jupiter or Mercury or exalted: becomes emperor honoured by rulers
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.7

input: Strong Moon in exaltation, own or friend's sign in 9th, 4th, 10th or 7th aspected by or with Jupiter or Venus; or Mars and Saturn strong in 2nd and 10th
outcome: Learned, virtuous, praised by people, generous, great personality
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.8

input: Jupiter owns 3rd and 12th (Capricorn ascendant), or owns or sits in 8th
outcome: Gives everything good
strength_note: Venus good in 6th; Rahu favourable in 7, 4, 8, 11, 10; Ketu in 3rd
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.9

input: Lord of a house in dusthana 6, 8, 12, or fallen, combust, enemy sign, no benefic aspect, in enemy navamsa, defeated in war
outcome: That house is totally lost or fruitless
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.10

input: Lord of a house in trikona, kendra, 3rd or 11th, in friend's sign, exalted or own navamsa, between two benefics, with benefic aspect
outcome: House prospers greatly and quickly
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.11

input: House, its lord and its karaka all hemmed between malefics without benefic help
outcome: That house is destroyed
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.12

input: Auspicious planet in own, exalted, friend's or Moolatrikona sign or Vargottama
outcome: Enhances the prosperity of the house
strength_note: Even a malefic then gives good results
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.13

input: Planet in 6th, 8th or 12th house
outcome: The sign it occupies becomes inauspicious; lord of 6/8/12 occupying or aspecting a house destroys its effects
strength_note: Venus, Mercury, Jupiter in 6, 8, 12 respectively give happiness
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.14

input: Planet in first or last 6 degrees of a sign, combust or defeated in war
outcome: It does not really aspect
strength_note: Jupiter strongest aspecting from west, Saturn strong when direct, Mars strong in enemy's house
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.15

input: Benefics in kendra, 3rd, 2nd, 11th, 5th, 9th or even 6th
outcome: Auspicious results
strength_note: Malefics are good in upachaya houses (3, 6, 10, 11); Saturn good in own or Jupiter's sign in Lagna
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.16

input: Waning Moon, Mercury, Venus, full Moon, Jupiter
outcome: Benefic strength in ratio 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1, 1; Sun, Rahu/Mars, Ketu/Saturn promote evil in similar ratio
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.17

input: Karaka planet in the house it signifies
outcome: Gives only a small part of the usual effect
strength_note: Karaka, house lord, navamsa lords of house lord all hostile destroys the house
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.18

input: Planet in 2nd from a house is Chhadaka, 3rd is Vedhaka, 4th is Bandhaka, 8th is Pratibandhaka; lords of 2nd and 7th from a house are its Marakas
outcome: Role names of planets relative to a house
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.20

input: Lords of 6th, 8th and 12th linked to each other only (exchange, aspect, conjunction) and free of other links
outcome: A great king, rules over other rulers, renowned and wealthy
strength_note: Viparita-type yoga
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.22

input: Malefics debilitated, strong benefics in kendra and trikona, lords of 10th, 9th and 4th together in 9th or 10th
outcome: King-like, wealthy, long-lived, respected by rulers
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.23

input: Kendras 1,4,7,10; panapharas 2,5,8,11; apoklimas 3,6,9,12; trikonas 5,9; upachayas 3,6,10,11
outcome: House classification
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.24

input: Sun and Moon owning the 8th house
outcome: They become harmful and evil; otherwise Sun and Moon are not marakas
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.25

input: Benefics in 6th, 7th, 8th from Moon with no malefics there
outcome: King or equal, long-lived, victorious, learned, all pleasures
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.26

input: Sum of kalas of lords of 9th from Lagna and 9th from Moon divided by 12 gives a sign from Moon; a benefic alone there
outcome: Becomes very rich (Koteswara); a malefic alone there gives wealth in thousands
strength_note: Kalas: Sun 30, Moon 16, Mars 6, Mercury 8, Jupiter 10, Venus 12, Saturn 1
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.27

input: Two or more lords of 2nd, 5th, 11th, 9th related by sambandha and strong
outcome: Becomes rich (lakhpati); if lord of 6/8/12 joins the link, wealth is destroyed, debts and enemies
strength_note: Results come in dasas of these lords
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.28

input: All planets in four kendras and four panapharas, apoklimas empty
outcome: King or leader of men
strength_note: Weak planets: lesser status
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.29

input: Birth about 2 ghatikas after midnight or mid-day
outcome: Ruler, dominates enemies, well educated
strength_note: Exalted planet in 2nd aspected by an exalted planet: very rich
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.30

input: Yoga between two planets
outcome: It acts only when they are within 12 degrees; full at zero distance, nil at 12; slower planet should be ahead
strength_note: Strong Moon aspecting one of them sharpens the result
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.32-33

input: Padas of 5th, 2nd, 9th from Jupiter and lagna lord, no malefic aspect
outcome: Many children
strength_note: Mercury, Saturn, Mars in those padas, or Saturn with Jupiter: loss of children
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.36-37

input: 10th house or its lord with Saturn aspect or association
outcome: Adopted sons
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.37

input: Malefics in 7th, 8th from Lagna
outcome: 7th house tells of first wife, 8th of second wife; malefics there cause successive wives' deaths
strength_note: Benefics in the 8th prevent prediction of death
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.38

input: Benefics in the Upapada of 7th
outcome: Wife beautiful, long-lived and noble
strength_note: Malefic in Upapada while fallen: loses two wives; exalted malefic with benefic aspect: many wives
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.39

input: Adhikagraha (planet with most degrees in its sign) is the Sun
outcome: Adviser to the king
strength_note: Moon or Venus: rich and learned; Mars: army commander or metal worker; Mercury: sculptor; Jupiter: Vedic Brahmin; Venus: long life; Saturn: many vocations; Rahu/Ketu: poison medicine and metals
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.42-43

input: Sun and Venus occupy or aspect 2nd from Adhikagraha
outcome: Serves in a palace
strength_note: Malefic in 3rd from it gives valour; Moon in 4th aspected by Venus gives sailor
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.4 sl.44

input: 1st house signification
outcome: Body, fame, strength, longevity, appearance, skin, livelihood, honour
strength_note: Karakatva of bhavas
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.1

input: 2nd house signification
outcome: Speech, wealth, family, eyes, clothes, gems, gold, silver, trade
strength_note: Karakatva of bhavas
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.1-3

input: 3rd house signification
outcome: Courage, brothers, battle, ears, short journeys, servants, learning, partition of property
strength_note: Karakatva of bhavas
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.4

input: 4th house signification
outcome: Learning, kingdom, house, vehicles, mother, land, water, wells, garden, palace, cattle
strength_note: Karakatva of bhavas
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.5 sl.4-7

input: Query asked with Saturn exalted in Lagna, or Lagna lord and query-house lord linked with strong benefics
outcome: The matter will be accomplished at once
strength_note: Planet with malefic aspect or association: failure of the aim is certain
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.7 sl.10

input: Query: Moon (gross) aspected by Mercury, Jupiter and subtle Moon
outcome: Query is about an animal
strength_note: Mars, Rahu, Saturn: mineral; Venus and Sun: vegetable; Jupiter, Venus, Rahu: mixed
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.7 sl.14-15

input: Query: lords of Lagna and of the object's house both benefic, well placed and aspecting within 12 degrees
outcome: Object of the query will be fulfilled
strength_note: Result in proportion to their strength; consider karaka also
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.7 sl.19

input: Conception: Moon in a good star, good tithi (2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 12, 13), on Jupiter, Mercury, Venus or Moon day, in a Lagna with no planets
outcome: Favourable time for conception
strength_note: Avoid Ashtami, Purnima, Amavasya
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.1

input: Birth in 1st, 2nd, 3rd or 4th pada of Ashlesha
outcome: Loss of wealth, loss of brother, death of mother, death of father respectively
strength_note: Birth at very end of Ashlesha: child's own death. Magha pada gives opposite results
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.5

input: Birth in Ashlesha, Jyeshtha, Moola, Revati, Ashwini, Magha (Gandanta junctions)
outcome: Gandanta births are very vulnerable to early death of the child
strength_note: Child who survives becomes a king; father should propitiate Kala, Antaka, Mrityu
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.5-6

input: Girl attains puberty at Gandanta time
outcome: She becomes a widow without children, wealth
strength_note: Remedy: Japa, Homa and worship of gods, Brahmins and planets
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.7

input: Birth or puberty of a girl in 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th ghatika of Tyajya kala
outcome: Death of father, death of mother, loss of wealth, own destruction respectively
strength_note: Remedy: worship Rudra, Yama, Fire, Mrityu in that order. Eclipse birth: parent dies
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.8

input: Medicine prepared or taken when Moon is in Amritaghatika or a good star
outcome: Acts like nectar, cures disease, restores health
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.9

input: Childless to age 60 or short-lived without children
outcome: Should adopt a son
strength_note: Adopt in forenoon of auspicious day in Uttarayana, in own gotra, Moon in Swati, Punarvasu, Pushya, Rohini, Anuradha, Hasta, Revati, Ashwini, Shravana, Dhanishta, Shatabhisha, Uttara nakshatras; Lagna and 5th free of malefics
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.10-11

input: Start wedding preparations
outcome: Moon in Punarvasu, Pushya, Ashwini, Anuradha, Hasta, Chitra, Swati, Shravana, Dhanishta, Shatabhisha; not on Venus or Mars day; 5th and 9th empty
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.12

input: Counting from Sun's nakshatra to Moon's nakshatra when entering a new house or starting an enterprise (Vrishabha chakra)
outcome: First 7 stars bad, next 3 bad, next 14 good
strength_note: Kalasa chakra: first 5 bad, next 8 good, next 8 bad, last 6 good
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.16

input: Dasa chakra (male figure) counting from natal star to the day's star
outcome: First 3 head: gain; next 3 face: loss; next 5 chest: wealth; next 6 feet: poverty; next 2 back: danger to life; next 4 abdomen: good; next 2 anus: fear; last 2 hands: wealth and death
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.17-18

input: Buying cow or buffalo: count from Uttara Phalguni to the star of the day
outcome: First 3 gain, next 2 loss, next 8 money, next 5 happiness, next 8 gain, last 1 great fear
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.18-19

input: Riding a horse: count from Sun's star to native's star
outcome: First 5 prosperity, next 10 gain, next 2 loss of wife, next 4 obstacles, next 5 destruction, last 2 gain
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.19-20

input: Starting agriculture or sowing (Hala chakra), counting from Sun's nakshatra to day's star
outcome: 1-3 bad, 4-6 good, 7-9 bad, 10-14 good, 15-17 bad, 18-22 good, 23-25 bad, last good
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.30

input: Digging a well or tank with Moon in a given nakshatra group
outcome: Water found soon, none, medium, none, plenty, sweet, salty, full, medium by group
strength_note: Groups of 3 stars from Rohini assigned to the directions
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.33

input: Erecting a pillar for a house or well, counting from Sun's star to Moon's star
outcome: First 6 give death, next 20 give fame and prosperity, last 2 loss of wealth
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.34

input: Starting to use a new lamp (Deepika chakra) counting from Krittika
outcome: 5 stars face: honour; 9 neck: gain; 8 centre: death of master; 5 post: kingship
source: Uttarakalamrita sec.8 sl.32

input: Jaimini rasi aspect: movable sign (1,4,7,10)
outcome: Aspects the fixed signs other than the adjacent one: 5th, 8th and 11th from it
strength_note: Fixed-sign counts: 4th, 7th, 10th
source: Jaimini Upadesa Sutra (Abhyankar), intro para 47

input: Jaimini rasi aspect: fixed sign (2,5,8,11)
outcome: Aspects the movable signs other than the adjacent one: 4th, 7th, 10th from it
source: Jaimini Upadesa Sutra (Abhyankar), intro para 47

input: Jaimini rasi aspect: dual sign (3,6,9,12)
outcome: Aspects the other dual signs
source: Jaimini Upadesa Sutra (Abhyankar), intro para 47

input: Jaimini sutra Adhyaya 1 topics
outcome: Character, profession, money, health, home happiness, incidental events
source: Jaimini Upadesa Sutra (Abhyankar), intro para 40

input: Jaimini sutra Adhyaya 2 topics
outcome: Span of life (short, middle, long), time and kind of death
source: Jaimini Upadesa Sutra (Abhyankar), intro para 40

input: Karaka order: planet next below the mother-significator is father-significator, then son-, kinsfolk-, wife-significator
outcome: Chara karaka chain of significators
strength_note: Some count seven karakas and omit Rahu
source: Jaimini Sutra I.i.14-19

input: Pada Lagna (Arudha) method
outcome: Count as many signs ahead of the lagna lord as lagna lord is from lagna
strength_note: If lord is in 4th, pada is 4th; if in 7th, pada is 10th
source: Jaimini Sutra I.i.29-31

input: Atmakaraka in 1st sign (Aries)
outcome: Affected by rats and cats
strength_note: Sign 2 quadrupeds; 3 itch and fat; 4 water and leprosy; 5 beasts; 6 itch and fire; 8 water reptiles; 9 fall from vehicle or height; 11 tanks and wells
source: Jaimini Sutra I.ii.2-12

input: Atmakaraka in 12th sign (Pisces)
outcome: Firm in religion, aims at liberation
source: Jaimini Sutra I.ii.13

input: Sun in the sign of Atmakaraka

input: Lagna lord weak, malefics in 6th 8th or 12th, Jupiter in kendra or trikona, malefic in lagna
outcome: Medium life (madhyayu)
strength_note: Jataka Parijata yoga
source: How to Judge a Horoscope Vol2 (B.V. Raman), ch12 longevity examples

input: 8th lord in kendra and 8th house empty
outcome: Lives about 40 years
strength_note: classical yoga
source: How to Judge a Horoscope Vol2 (B.V. Raman), ch12 longevity examples

input: Both benefics and malefics in kendras and trikonas, or lagna lord and benefics all in succeedent houses (2 5 8 11)
outcome: Medium span of life
source: How to Judge a Horoscope Vol2 (B.V. Raman), ch12 longevity examples

input: 8th lord in own sign or Saturn in 8th free of affliction, lagna and 8th lords in own star aspected by well-placed Saturn
outcome: Full life (purnayu)
strength_note: example died aged ninety
source: How to Judge a Horoscope Vol2 (B.V. Raman), ch12 longevity examples

input: 10th lord exalted and malefics in 8th house
outcome: Long-lived
strength_note: classical dictum
source: How to Judge a Horoscope Vol2 (B.V. Raman), ch12 longevity examples

input: Jupiter exalted, benefics in moolatrikona signs and lagna lord strong
outcome: Lives about 80 years
strength_note: classical dictum
source: How to Judge a Horoscope Vol2 (B.V. Raman), ch12 longevity examples

input: Very strong lagna with Sun and exalted Moon, aspected by Jupiter and strong Saturn despite weak lagna lord
outcome: Purnayu
strength_note: example
source: How to Judge a Horoscope Vol2 (B.V. Raman), ch12 longevity examples

input: Heavily afflicted lagna, 8th lord and Moon but strong karaka Saturn (vargottama exalted)
outcome: Pushes longevity into medium group not early death
strength_note: example
source: How to Judge a Horoscope Vol2 (B.V. Raman), ch12 longevity examples

input: Death in dasha or bhukti of 2nd or 7th lord from lagna or Moon, or planet in 2nd or 7th from them, or 8th lord from lagna
outcome: Death
strength_note: Rahu and Ketu give results of the planet they join and of sign dispositor (Rahu like Saturn); maraka status also checked in navamsa
source: How to Judge a Horoscope Vol2 (B.V. Raman), ch12 longevity examples

input: Planet in the star of a maraka or with a maraka
outcome: Acquires maraka power and kills in its bhukti
source: How to Judge a Horoscope Vol2 (B.V. Raman), ch12 longevity examples

input: Lagna lord, 5th and 9th lords, and kendra lords that are natural malefics
outcome: Treated as benefic lords for yoga strength
strength_note: natural benefic kendra lords become malefic lords; 3rd 6th 11th lords malefic; 2nd 8th 12th neutral
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), Intro strength of a yoga

input: Yoga strength scoring: yogakaraka is a benefic lord, with a benefic lord, aspected by benefic lord, or in exaltation or friendly sign (+1 each); opposite conditions (-1 each)
outcome: If positive units predominate yoga gives beneficial results, else weakened or nullified
strength_note: planet with more inherent strength gives larger part of yoga in its dasha, other as bhukti lord
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), Intro strength of a yoga

input: Jupiter in a kendra (1 4 7 10) from the Moon (Gajakesari)
outcome: Many relations, polite and generous, builder or head of towns or civic office, lasting reputation
strength_note: strength of Moon and Jupiter by lordship and dignity modulates; equal positive and negative units nearly neutralise it
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 1 Gajakesari

input: Planets other than Sun in the 2nd house from Moon (Sunapha)
outcome: Self-earned property, ruler-like, intelligent, wealthy, good reputation
strength_note: Mars Mercury Jupiter Venus Saturn count; yogakaraka debilitated or heavily afflicted gives no result
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 2 Sunapha

input: Planets other than Sun in the 12th from Moon (Anapha)
outcome: Well-formed body, majestic, good reputation, polite, generous, fond of dress and pleasures, renunciation in later life
strength_note: debilitated Jupiter with neechabhanga gives feeble result
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 3 Anapha

input: Planets on both sides of Moon, 2nd and 12th from it (Dhurdhura)
outcome: Bountiful, much wealth and conveyances
strength_note: results vary by which planets and their dignity; yoga acts in dasha of the planets forming it
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 4 Dhurdhura

input: No planets on either side of the Moon (Kemadruma)
outcome: Dirty, sorrowful, unrighteous, poor, dependent, rogue
strength_note: some authors cancel it if a planet is in kendra from lagna or Moon or conjoins Moon
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 5 Kemadruma

input: Mars conjoins the Moon, or mutual aspect (Chandra-Mangala)
outcome: Stable financial worth; earnings from trades catering to baser needs (toddy, liquor shops, women) if badly placed
strength_note: classical: unscrupulous earnings and harsh to mother; good in 2nd 9th 10th or 11th; Moon and Mars well disposed: approved means; waxing Moon in a friendly sign strong
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 6 Chandra-Mangala

input: Benefics (Mercury Jupiter Venus) in 6th 7th and 8th from the Moon (Adhi)
outcome: Polite, trustworthy, luxury and affluence, defeats enemies, healthy, long-lived
strength_note: one strong benefic: leader; two: minister; three: higher eminence; weak benefics: feeble
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 7 Adhi

input: All four kendras occupied by planets (Chatussagara)
outcome: Good reputation, ruler-like, long prosperous life, children, health, financial soundness and fame
strength_note: planets in 10th stronger than 7th, then 4th, then 1st
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 8 Chatussagara

input: Benefics in upachayas (3 6 10 11) from lagna or Moon (Vasumathi)
outcome: Never dependent, plenty of wealth
strength_note: from lagna stronger than from Moon; benefics in exaltation upachayas very powerful; malefic association dilutes; pure form is rare
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 9 Vasumathi

input: Jupiter Venus Mercury and Moon in lagna or kendras (Rajalakshana)
outcome: Attractive appearance, high personal qualities, respect and dignity
strength_note: weak Moon or ill-associated Mercury cannot give beauty
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 10 Rajalakshana

input: Lagna occupied by malefic with Gulika in 5th or 9th, or Gulika with lords of kendras and trikonas, or lagna lord with Rahu Saturn or Ketu (Vanchanachorabheethi)
outcome: Constant suspicion of others, fear of being cheated or robbed, material losses
strength_note: example: debilitated lagna lord with Ketu, Sun in lagna
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 11 Vanchanachorabheethi

input: Moon in 6th 8th or 12th from Jupiter (Sakata)
outcome: Loss of fortune that may be regained, poverty, hated by relatives, ordinary status
strength_note: per author misfortune is milder than classics claim; periods recur when transit Moon is in 6th 8th 12th from radical Jupiter
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 12 Sakata

input: Benefic in 10th from Moon or from lagna (Amala)
outcome: Lasting fame and spotless character, prosperity by fair means
strength_note: malefic in 10th still gives wealth in its dasha but means questionable
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 13 Amala

input: Benefics in kendras with 6th and 8th empty or benefic-occupied, or lagna lord and 12th lord in mutual kendras (Parvata)
outcome: Wealthy, liberal, charitable, humorous, head of town or village, passionate; freedom from enemies and debt if 6th and 8th empty
strength_note: gives local standing and financial stability rather than political power
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 14 Parvata

input: Lords of 4th and 9th in kendras from each other with strong lagna lord, or 4th lord exalted or own sign with 10th lord aspect or conjunction (Kahala)
outcome: Stubborn, daring, head of small army or few villages (army, police, collector, tahsildar today)
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 15 Kahala

input: Planets other than Moon (Rahu Ketu excluded) in the 2nd from the Sun (Vesi)
outcome: Fortunate, happy, virtuous, famous
strength_note: benefics make subhavesi; malefics make papavesi with opposite results
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 16 Vesi

input: Planets other than Moon in the 12th from the Sun (Vasi)
outcome: Happy, prosperous, liberal, favoured by rulers
strength_note: malefics make papavasi with opposite results
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 17 Vasi

input: Planets other than Moon on both sides of the Sun (Ubhayachari)
outcome: Eloquent, well-proportioned, liked by all, wealthy, famous
strength_note: Vesi Vasi and Ubhayachari together are present in most charts; subordinate to stronger rajayogas
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 18 Ubhayachari

input: Jupiter in own or exalted sign in a kendra from lagna (Hamsa, Pancha Mahapurusha)
outcome: Handsome, righteous, pure-minded, liked by others, sterling character
strength_note: cannot occur for fixed-sign lagnas in the usual reckoning; 10th kendra strongest; exaltation form better than own-sign kendra; Saturn or Mars affliction of Jupiter restricts it
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 19 Hamsa

input: Venus in own or exalted sign in a kendra (Malavya)
outcome: Strong body and mind, wealthy, wife and children, vehicles, learned, renowned, materialistic pleasure-loving
strength_note: house affected: Taurus Libra Pisces lagna 1st; Aries Scorpio Virgo 7th; Gemini Leo Capricorn 10th; Sagittarius Aquarius Cancer 4th
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 20 Malavya

input: Saturn in own or exalted sign in a kendra (Sasa)
outcome: Good servants, head of village or town or king, covets others' wealth, perverse and unscrupulous
strength_note: unafflicted Moon restricts the evil; 4th house gives lands and industrialist
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 21 Sasa

input: Mars in own or exalted sign in a kendra (Ruchaka)
outcome: Strong physique, famous, learned, king or army leader, wealthy, long-lived
strength_note: Mars afflicted by other malefics gives destructive aggressive ruler
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 22 Ruchaka

input: Mercury in own or exalted sign in a kendra (Bhadra)
outcome: Strong, lion-like face, intellect, generous, helps relatives, good old age
strength_note: Pancha Mahapurusha yogas work only when planet is strong and unafflicted
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 23 Bhadra

input: Mercury with the Sun, Mercury not within about 10 degrees of Sun (Budha-Aditya)
outcome: Intelligent, skilful, good reputation, comfortable
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 24 Budha-Aditya

input: Male: Sun Moon and lagna all in odd signs; female born at night: all in even signs (Mahabhagya)
outcome: Good character, liberal, famous, ruler-like, long-lived; female has long-lived children and wealth
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 25 Mahabhagya

input: Lagna lord with Moon, lord of Moon's sign in kendra or friendly sign aspecting lagna, and strong planet in lagna (Pushkala)
outcome: Wealthy, sweet speech, famous, honoured by ruler
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 26 Pushkala

input: Strong lagna lord and 9th lord in own or exalted sign in kendra or trikona (Lakshmi)
outcome: Wealthy, noble, learned, reputation, handsome
strength_note: variants: lagna and 9th lords associated outside 3 6 8; 9th lord and Venus both in own or exaltation kendra or trikona gives immense wealth
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 27 Lakshmi

input: Lord of the navamsa occupied by the 10th lord is exalted in the 10th and joins lagna lord (Gauri)
outcome: Respectable family, owns lands, charitable, religious rites, good sons, praised
strength_note: alt school: 9th lord and Moon each in own or exalted kendra or trikona
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 28 Gauri

input: Navamsa lord of 2nd lord, or 5th lord, or 11th lord is exalted and conjoined with 9th lord (Bharathi)
outcome: World-famous scholar, music, handsome, religious
strength_note: rare
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 29 Bharathi

input: Jupiter in lagna, Moon in 7th, Sun in 2nd (Kusuma)
outcome: King or equal, helps others, head of town after age 20
strength_note: alt (Rao): Venus in fixed sign kendra, weak Moon in trikona, Sun in 10th
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 30 Kusuma

input: Lagna lord exalted and 4th and 10th lords exchange houses (Chapa)
outcome: Counsellor to ruler, wealthy, controls others' wealth like treasury officer or banker
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 31 Chapa

input: Exalted 7th lord in 10th and 10th lord in 9th (Sreenatha)
outcome: Insignia of Vishnu on body, pleasant speech, godly, good wife and children, loved
strength_note: only possible for Sagittarius lagna (Mercury exalted in Virgo 10th) in strict form
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 32 Sreenatha

input: All seven planets in seven contiguous houses from lagna or any house (Malika)
outcome: Lagna: king or commander wealthy; Dhana: very wealthy; Vikrama: ruler rich sickly; Sukha: charitable; Putra: religious famous; Satru: greedy poor; Kalatra: attractive influential; Randhra: poor and henpecked; Bhagya: religious mighty; Karma: virtuous; Labha: skilful; Vyaya: honoured liberal
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 33-44 Malika

input: Lords of 5th and 6th in mutual kendras with strong lagna lord (Sankha)
outcome: Pleasure-loving, humanitarian, wife children lands, learned, long-lived
strength_note: 6th lordship blemish: troubles from debts diseases enemies
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 45 Sankha

input: Venus lagna lord and Jupiter in mutual kendras with 9th lord strong (Bheri)
outcome: Long-lived, healthy, ruler, various incomes, happy family, religious
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 46 Bheri

input: Malefics in lagna 4th 8th 9th and mixed benefics and malefics in 5th (Matsya)
outcome: Prophet, kind, intelligent, famous, learned
strength_note: rare
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 47 Matsya

input: Navamsa lord of an exalted planet in kendra or trikona in own friendly or exalted sign with strong lagna lord (Mridanga)
outcome: Respected by rulers, famous, influential
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 48 Mridanga

input: Jupiter and Venus in kendras from 9th lord and 11th lord, Mercury in kendra from lagna lord or 10th lord (Brahma)
outcome: Enjoys luxury, respected by learned, long-lived, charitable, health wealth fame
strength_note: partial forms still work feebly; not fully possible for Aries Cancer Virgo
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 65 Brahma

input: Lords of 5th and 11th exchange signs and Moon in 5th (Indra)
outcome: Courageous, lasting fame, king of kings, comforts, but lives only to about 36
strength_note: author doubtful of longevity claim
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 66 Indra

input: Sun in 10th and 10th lord in 3rd with Saturn (Ravi)
outcome: Respected by rulers, scientific, famous after 15, passionate, simple food
strength_note: very rare; impossible for several lagnas as Mercury or Venus cannot be far from Sun
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 67 Ravi

input: Jupiter in moolatrikona (Sagittarius 0-13 degrees) with 2nd lord and lagna lord exalted (Go)
outcome: Wealth
strength_note: yoga depends on Jupiter being in Moola constellation
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 69 Go

input: Full Moon in 9th with Jupiter and Venus and Mercury in navamsa lagna (Gola)
outcome: Polite, learned, magistrate or village head, long-lived
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 70 Gola

input: Sun Moon and Mars in mutual trines (Trilochana)
outcome: Great wealth, feared by enemies, intelligent, long life, smooth career
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 71 Trilochana

input: All planets in 2nd 4th 6th 8th 10th and 12th houses (Samudra)
outcome: King or equal
strength_note: rare akriti yoga
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 72 Samudra

input: 6th lord debilitated and 10th lord exalted (Jaya)
outcome: Always successful, happy, long-lived
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 73 Jaya

input: Benefics in 5th from lagna, Sun and Moon (Kulavardhana)
outcome: Many children, unbroken family line, wealthy, healthy, long-lived
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 74 Kulavardhana

input: All planets in lagna 2nd 3rd and 4th (Yupa); likewise for other kendra starts
outcome: Yupa: liberal, charitable; Ishu (4th-7th): head of jail or camp; Sakti (7th-10th): lazy, poor, disliked; Danda (10th-1st): lacks wife and children's happiness
strength_note: nabhasa yogas operate lifelong per Varahamihira; Yupa and Danda better than Ishu and Sakti
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 75-78 Yupa Ishu Sakti Danda

input: All seven planets in seven contiguous houses from lagna (Nav), 4th (Kuta), 7th (Chatra), 10th (Chapa)
outcome: Nav: occasionally happy famous miserly; Kuta: liar or jailor, evil habits; Chatra: happy early and late, strong mind, wealthy; Chapa: brave, happy early and late
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 79-82 Nav Kuta Chatra Chapa

input: All planets in seven houses starting from a cadent or succeedent house (Ardha Chandra)
outcome: Fair features, happy throughout life
strength_note: eight variants
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 83 Ardha Chandra

input: All planets in odd houses 1 3 5 7 9 11 (Chakra)
outcome: King or equal, respected, earns and spends well
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 84 Chakra

input: All planets in two adjacent kendras (Gada: 1-4 4-7 7-10 10-1)
outcome: Highly religious and wealthy
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 85 Gada

input: All planets in 1st and 7th houses (Sakata, nabhasa)
outcome: Poor, unhappy domestic life, manual labour, sickly, quarrelsome wife
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 86 Sakata nabhasa

input: All planets in 4th and 10th houses (Vihaga)
outcome: Vagrant, quarrelsome, mean, tale-bearer; suits travelling jobs
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 87 Vihaga

input: Benefics in lagna and 7th, malefics in 4th and 10th (Vajra)
outcome: Handsome, brave, happy
strength_note: reverse arrangement (Yava): happy in middle life, harms health of native and spouse
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 88-89 Vajra Yava

input: All planets in lagna and its trines 1 5 9 (Sringhataka)
outcome: Happy in later life; stress on 1st: early life, 5th: middle, 9th: last
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 90 Sringhataka

input: All planets in 2-6-10, or 3-7-11, or 4-8-12 (Hala)
outcome: Agriculturist, farmer, estate manager, landlord
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 91 Hala

input: All planets in four kendras (Kamala)
outcome: High prestige, wide fame, virtues, not very wealthy
strength_note: all planets in four panapara houses 2 5 8 11 or apoklimas 3 6 9 12 (Vapee): hoarder, mean
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 92-93 Kamala Vapee

input: All planets in even houses 2 4 6 8 10 12 (Samudra)
outcome: Ruler or lives like one without care
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 94 Samudra

input: Planets occupy exactly seven signs (Vallaki)
outcome: Many friends, music and fine arts, learned, happy, famous
strength_note: sankhya yogas ignored if another nabhasa yoga is present
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 95 Vallaki

input: Planets occupy exactly six signs (Damini)
outcome: Charitable, helps others, protects cattle; intellect fame wealth
strength_note: strength depends on lagna lord and yogakarakas
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 96 Damini

input: Planets occupy exactly five signs (Pasa)
outcome: Wealth by right means, surrounded by friends and servants
strength_note: Saravali links to imprisonment only with lagna and lagna lord in 6th and 8th in pasa drekkanas
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 97 Pasa

input: Planets occupy exactly four signs (Kedara)
outcome: Livelihood by agriculture, helpful to others, dull intellect per Saravali
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 98 Kedara

input: All planets in exactly three signs (Sula), two signs (Yuga) or one sign (Gola)
outcome: Sula: poor, courageous, cruel, battle wounds; Yuga: poor, ostracised, heretical, drunkard; Gola: poor, dirty, ignorant, indolent
strength_note: strong lagna or Moon moderates the result
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 99-101 Sula Yuga Gola

input: All planets exclusively in movable signs (Rajju), fixed signs (Musala), or common signs (Nala)
outcome: Rajju: travel, seeks wealth abroad, handsome, cruel, envious; Musala: self-respect, wealth, learning, steady, proud; Nala: deformed, shrewd, dejected
strength_note: where an asraya yoga coincides with akriti or sankhya yoga, only one operates
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 102-104 Rajju Musala Nala

input: All benefics (excluding Moon) in kendras (Srik)
outcome: Comfort, conveyances, many enjoyments
strength_note: all malefics in kendras (Sarpa): miserable, cruel, stupid
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 105-106 Srik Sarpa

input: 10th lord in 6th 8th or 12th (Duryoga)
outcome: Does not enjoy fruits of own labour, looked down on, selfish, deceitful, lives in foreign place, manual labour
strength_note: 12th placement least harmful
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 107 Duryoga

input: 11th lord in 6th 8th or 12th (Daridra)
outcome: Debts, poverty, ear trouble, meanness, sinful or criminal deeds
strength_note: strong lagna with 2nd lord in 10th or 11th makes it nominal
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 108 Daridra

input: 6th lord in 6th (Harsha), 8th lord in 8th (Sarala), 12th lord in 12th (Vimala)
outcome: Harsha: fortunate, strong, invincible; Sarala: long-lived, fearless, learned; Vimala: frugal, independent, noble
strength_note: author notes evil lordship only partly mitigated; Parasara: 6th lord in 6th makes relatives enemies, in 8th or 12th sickly and violent
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 109-111 Harsha Sarala Vimala

input: Lagna lord, Jupiter or Venus in a kendra (Sareera Soukhya)
outcome: Long life, wealth, political favour
strength_note: all three in kendras gives full effect
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 112 Sareera Soukhya

input: Lagna lord in movable sign aspected by benefic (Dehapushti)
outcome: Happy, well-developed body, rich
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 113 Dehapushti

input: Lagna lord with a malefic or in 8th house (Dehakashta)
outcome: Bodily discomfort, manual labour
strength_note: void if benefic aspects lagna lord
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 114 Dehakashta

input: Lagna lord in lagna with 6th 8th or 12th lord, or weak lagna lord in kendra or trikona (Rogagrastha)
outcome: Weak constitution, sickly
strength_note: 12th lord conjunction shows financial stress more than illness
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 115 Rogagrastha

input: Lagna lord in a dry sign (Aries Taurus Gemini Leo Virgo Sagittarius) or sign of dry planet, or navamsa lagna owned by dry planet with malefics in lagna (Krisanga)
outcome: Emaciated body, bodily pain
strength_note: dry planets Sun Mars Saturn (Mercury)
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 116-117 Krisanga

input: Lagna lord and navamsa lord of lagna lord in watery signs, or Jupiter in or aspecting lagna from watery sign, or watery sign lagna with benefics or watery lagna lord (Dehasthoulya)
outcome: Stout or corpulent body
strength_note: watery planets Moon Venus (also Mercury Jupiter)
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 118-120 Dehasthoulya

input: Lord of lagna or of the sign occupied by lagna lord in a movable sign (Sada Sanchara)
outcome: Constant wanderer; travelling agents, diplomats
strength_note: stronger if navamsa lagna also movable
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 121 Sada Sanchara

input: 5th house is Venus sign with Venus in 5th and Saturn in 11th (Capricorn or Gemini lagna) (Dhana 122)
outcome: Immense wealth
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 122 Dhana

input: Mercury in own sign as 5th house with Moon and Mars in 11th (Aquarius or Taurus lagna) (Dhana 123)
outcome: Immense wealth
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 123 Dhana

input: Saturn in own sign as 5th house with Mercury and Mars in 11th (Virgo or Libra lagna) (Dhana 124)
outcome: Immense wealth
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 124 Dhana

input: Sun in own sign 5th house (Aries lagna) with Jupiter and Moon in 11th (Dhana 125)
outcome: Immense wealth; also makes Gajakesari in 11th
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 125 Dhana

input: Jupiter in own sign as 5th house with Mars and Moon in 11th (Scorpio or Leo lagna) (Dhana 126)
outcome: Immense wealth; strongest for Scorpio lagna
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 126 Dhana

input: Sun in Leo lagna joined or aspected by Mars and Jupiter (Dhana 127)
outcome: Immense wealth
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 127 Dhana

input: Moon in Cancer lagna aspected by Jupiter and Mars (Dhana 128)
outcome: Immense wealth
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 128 Dhana

input: Mars in Aries or Scorpio lagna joined or aspected by Moon Venus and Saturn (Dhana 129)
outcome: Immense wealth
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 129 Dhana

input: Mercury in Gemini or Virgo lagna joined or aspected by Saturn and Venus (Dhana 130)
outcome: Immense wealth
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 130 Dhana

input: Jupiter in Sagittarius or Pisces lagna joined or aspected by Mars and Mercury (Dhana 131)
outcome: Immense wealth
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 131 Dhana

input: Venus in Taurus or Libra lagna joined or aspected by Mercury and Saturn (Dhana 132)
outcome: Immense wealth
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 132 Dhana

input: Lagna lord in 2nd, 2nd lord in 11th, 11th lord in lagna (Bahudravyarjana)
outcome: Earns much and amasses fortune
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 133 Bahudravyarjana

input: Strongest lagna lord in kendra with Jupiter and 2nd lord in vaiseshikamsa, or strong dispositor chain from lagna lord's navamsa lord, or 2nd lord benefic in kendra or trikona from lagna lord or exalted (Swaveeryaddhana)
outcome: Wealth by own effort
strength_note: self-earned wealth lasts; inherited wealth squandered
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 134-136 Swaveeryaddhana

input: Strong 2nd lord with kalabala in kendra or trikona with lagna lord and 11th lord, aspected by benefics (Madhya Vayasi Dhana)
outcome: Wealth in middle life
strength_note: wealth needs contact among lords of lagna 2nd 11th 5th 9th
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 137 Madhya Vayasi Dhana

input: Lagna lord and 2nd lord with a benefic, whose sign lord is strong in lagna (Anthyavayasi Dhana)
outcome: Wealth late in life
strength_note: rare
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 138 Anthyavayasi Dhana

input: 2nd and 10th lords conjoin in a kendra aspected by the navamsa lord of lagna lord (Balya Dhana)
outcome: Immense riches in early life
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 139 Balya Dhana

input: Lagna and 2nd lords in 3rd aspected by benefics, or 3rd lord in 2nd with Jupiter aspected by lagna lord in vaiseshikamsa
outcome: Money through brothers and relatives
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 140-141 Bhratrumooladdhana

input: 2nd lord joins or is aspected by 4th lord (Matrumooladdhana)
outcome: Money with mother's help; source by nature of 4th lord (Mars: agriculture)
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 142 Matrumooladdhana

input: Strong 2nd lord with 5th lord or Jupiter and lagna lord in vaiseshikamsa (Putramuladdhana)
outcome: Wealth through sons, often after sons grow up or are born
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 143 Putramuladdhana

input: Strong 2nd lord with 6th lord or Mars, lagna lord strong (Satrumuladdhana)
outcome: Money through enemies
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 144 Satrumuladdhana

input: Strong 2nd lord joined or aspected by 7th lord and Venus, strong lagna lord (Kalatramooladdhana)
outcome: Money through wife
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 145 Kalatramooladdhana

input: Several planets in 2nd house with wealth-givers (2nd lord, Jupiter) strong or in own or exalted sign (Amaranantha Dhana)
outcome: Wealth throughout life
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 146 Amaranantha Dhana

input: Lagna lord and 2nd lord exchange signs (Ayatnaddhanalabha)
outcome: Wealth without much effort
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 147 Ayatnaddhanalabha

input: Lagna lord and 12th lord exchange signs, with 7th lord conjunct or aspecting (Daridra 148)
outcome: Dire poverty and misery
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 148 Daridra

input: Lagna lord and 6th lord exchange signs, Moon aspected by 2nd or 7th lord (Daridra 149)
outcome: Dire poverty
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 149 Daridra

input: Ketu and Moon together in lagna (Daridra 150)
outcome: Poverty
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 150 Daridra

input: Lagna lord in 8th with 2nd or 7th lord conjunct or aspecting (Daridra 151)
outcome: Poverty
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 151 Daridra

input: Lagna lord in 6th 8th or 12th with a malefic and 2nd or 7th lord joining or aspecting (Daridra 152)
outcome: Poverty
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 152 Daridra

input: Lagna lord with 6th 8th or 12th lord and malefic aspects (Daridra 153)
outcome: Poverty
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 153 Daridra

input: 5th lord with 6th 8th or 12th lord without benefic influence (Daridra 154)
outcome: Poverty
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 154 Daridra

input: 5th lord in 6th or 10th aspected by 2nd 7th 6th 8th or 12th lords (Daridra 155)
outcome: Poverty
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 155 Daridra

input: Natural malefics not owning 9th or 10th in lagna with maraka lords (Daridra 156)
outcome: Poverty
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 156 Daridra

input: Lagna lord and navamsa lagna lord in 6th 8th or 12th with 2nd and 7th lords (Daridra 157)
outcome: Poverty
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 157 Daridra

input: 2nd lord with benefic in kendra or trikona or exalted with Jupiter, or Mercury in kendra paramochcha, Jupiter or Venus in simhasanamsa (Yukthi Samanwithavagmi)
outcome: Eloquent skilled speaker
strength_note: afflicted Mercury makes speech vulgar
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 158-159 Yukthi Samanwithavagmi

input: Navamsa lord of Sun in vaiseshikamsa and in 2nd house (Parihasaka)
outcome: Humorous and witty speaker
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 160 Parihasaka

input: 2nd lord in Aries Scorpio Capricorn or Aquarius with malefics in kendras and trikonas (Asatyavadi)
outcome: Liar
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 161 Asatyavadi

input: 2nd lord in 10th with malefics, or Sun and Mandi in 2nd (Jada)
outcome: Nervous in public assemblies
strength_note: benefic navamsa of 2nd lord cancels it
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 162 Jada

input: Planet in own varga twice, three, four ... thirteen times
outcome: Named distinctions: parijatamsa, uttamamsa, gopuramsa, simhasanamsa, parvatamsa, devalokamsa, kunkumamsa, iravatamsa, vaishnavamsa, satvamsa, bhaswadamsa, vaiseshikamsa (thirteen, best)
strength_note: more own vargas means stronger planet
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), Appendix technical terms

input: Lord of the sign occupied by lagna lord's dispositor (or navamsa dispositor chain) in kendra trikona own or exalted sign (Parijatha)
outcome: Happy in middle and later life, honoured by rulers, generous, famous; religious head with royal paraphernalia if parivraja yoga also present
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 47 Parijatha

input: Lord of the 9th from the 11th (7th lord) in 11th with Moon and aspected by 11th lord (Gaja)
outcome: Cattle, elephants, horses, happy and rich
strength_note: classics say operative ages 20-29
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 48 Gaja

input: Jupiter with or aspected by Mercury and Venus in 2nd or 5th (or in own sign of Mercury or Venus there) (Kalanidhi)
outcome: Passionate, good-natured, honoured by kings, conveyances, free of disease; alternate adversity and prosperity
strength_note: author finds it works also for conjunction of the three in 9th; example: administrator and statesman with Jupiter Mercury Venus in 2nd
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 49 Kalanidhi

input: Venus and Jupiter in kendras, lagna in movable sign and Saturn exalted in a kendra (Amsavatara)
outcome: Unsullied name, versatile learning, passions controlled, authority in philosophy, ruler or equal
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 50 Amsavatara

input: Benefics in 8th and 12th from 2nd lord, or Jupiter Moon Mercury in 4th 9th 8th from 7th lord, or Sun Venus Mars in 4th 10th 11th from lagna lord (Harihara Brahma)
outcome: Eminent Vedic scholar, truthful, pleasures, pleasing speech, defeats enemies, virtuous
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 51 Harihara Brahma

input: Benefics in 5th 6th 7th in own exalted or friendly navamsa, or benefics in 1st 3rd 11th in exalted own or friendly signs (Kurma)
outcome: World-famous, princely enjoyments, righteous, courageous, leader, mild; fame and influence more than wealth
strength_note: malefics in 5th and 6th weaken it
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 54 Kurma

input: Fixed lagna, lagna lord and 11th lord exchange signs, 2nd lord and 10th lord exchange (Devendra)
outcome: Handsome, unsullied reputation, builder of fortifications, army commander, long life
strength_note: lords must be strong
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 55 Devendra

input: Jupiter in 9th from 9th lord, benefic in 9th from Jupiter, Saturn in 10th (Makuta)
outcome: King or chief of forest tribes or hunters, powerful, evil-minded sportsman
strength_note: observed in 6-7 of 10 charts of forest chiefs and conservators
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 56 Makuta

input: Navamsa lords of 6th lord and 9th lord combine with Sun and fixed lagna aspected by 6th lord (Chandika)
outcome: Aggressive, charitable, wealthy, minister, long happy life, political power
strength_note: only Taurus Leo Scorpio Aquarius lagna
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 57 Chandika

input: 11th lord deeply exalted and with Venus in a kendra from lagna lord (Vidyut)
outcome: Charitable, pleasure-loving, treasurer or controller of wealth, king or equal
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 59 Vidyut

input: 10th lord in 7th 11th or 3rd with lagna lord and Jupiter, Sun exalted and strong, Moon in 9th (Gandharva)
outcome: Skill in fine arts (music dance painting), strong, famous, lives to about 68
strength_note: partial form gives only interest in arts
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 60 Gandharva

input: 5th lord in 9th, 9th lord in 10th and 10th lord in 5th (Siva)
outcome: Big trader, army commander, divine wisdom, virtuous
strength_note: for Aries lagna Sun and Saturn need dignity or the exchange form is harmful
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 61 Siva

input: Navamsa lord of 9th lord's navamsa and 10th lord in 2nd house with the 9th lord (Vishnu)
outcome: Enjoyable life, fortune from various countries, earns in lakhs, strong, witty, praised by rulers, lives 100 years free of disease
strength_note: works to degree strength of navamsa lord; at least three planets usually in 2nd
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 62 Vishnu

input: Lord of navamsa occupied by Moon exalted, birth by day in waxing Moon (Garuda)
outcome: Respected by pious, polished speech, feared by enemies, strong, danger from poison in 34th year
strength_note: danger not predicted if longevity strong
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 66 Garuda

input: Mercury in 2nd from Sun, Moon in 11th from Mercury and Jupiter in 5th or 9th from Moon (Bhaskara)
outcome: Wealthy, valorous, aristocratic, learned in shastras astrology music, good personality
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 159 Bhaskara

input: Jupiter in 5th or 9th from Venus, Moon in 5th from Jupiter and Sun in kendra from Moon (Marud)
outcome: Good conversationalist, large-hearted, rich, learned, successful businessman, king or equal, protruding belly
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 160 Marud

input: Jupiter Venus Mercury in lagna 2nd 4th 5th 7th 9th or 10th with Jupiter in own exalted or friendly sign (Saraswathi)
outcome: Poet, famous, learned, skilled, rich, praised, good wife and children
strength_note: common; merges with stronger yogas if planets weak
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 161 Saraswathi

input: Jupiter in lagna, Moon in kendra, Rahu in 2nd from Moon, Sun and Mars in 3rd from Rahu (Budha)
outcome: Kingly comforts, powerful, famous, learned, no enemies
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 162 Budha

input: 2nd lord with Jupiter in 8th house (Mooka)
outcome: Dumb
strength_note: not if 8th is Jupiter's own or exaltation sign; Ganapathi adds 12th
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 163 Mooka

input: 10th and 6th lords in lagna with 2nd lord, or in neechamsa (Netranasa)
outcome: Loses eyesight, e.g. through displeasure of rulers
strength_note: not if Sun and Moon strong; example lost sight at age 10 in Moon dasha Saturn bhukti
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 164 Netranasa

input: Mercury and Moon in 2nd, or lagna lord and 2nd lord with Sun in 2nd (Andha)
outcome: Night blindness, or born blind
strength_note: modified if 2nd is exaltation sign of one of them
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 165 Andha

input: 2nd lord in kendra aspected by benefics or benefics in 2nd, or 2nd lord in kendra in own exalted or friendly sign with kendra lord in gopuramsa (Sumukha)
outcome: Attractive smiling face
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 166-167 Sumukha

input: Malefics in 2nd with 2nd lord conjoined with evil planet or debilitated, or 2nd lord with Gulika or in debilitated inimical navamsa (Durmukha)
outcome: Ugly or repulsive face, angry and irritable
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 168-169 Durmukha

input: Strong 2nd lord in vaiseshikamsa aspected by Jupiter or Venus (Bhojana Soukhya)
outcome: Rich, always good food
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 170 Bhojana Soukhya

input: 2nd lord in vaiseshikamsa with or aspected by Jupiter and Mercury (Annadana)
outcome: Hospitable, feeds many people, charity of food
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 171 Annadana

input: 2nd lord debilitated or in inimical navamsa aspected by debilitated planet (Parannabhojana)
outcome: Lives on food from others, dependent
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 172 Parannabhojana

input: Saturn owns or joins 2nd lord or debilitated Saturn aspects 2nd (Sraddhannabhuktha)
outcome: Eats food at funeral rites
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 173 Sraddhannabhuktha

input: Rahu with Mandi in 2nd house (Sarpaganda)
outcome: Snake bite
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 174 Sarpaganda

input: Malefic owning 2nd in cruel navamsa without benefic aspect (Vakchalana)
outcome: Stammering
strength_note: Jupiter's state important too
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 175 Vakchalana

input: 2nd house joined and aspected by malefics and 2nd lord in cruel navamsa aspected by malefic (Vishaprayoga)
outcome: Poisoned by others
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 176 Vishaprayoga

input: 3rd lord or Mars or 3rd house joined or aspected by benefics and strong (Bhratruvriddhi)
outcome: Happy through prosperous brothers
strength_note: 3rd lord in Mars vargas mars cordiality
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 177 Bhratruvriddhi

input: Mars and 3rd lord in 8th (or 3rd 5th 7th) aspected by malefics (Sodaranasa)
outcome: Loses nearly all brothers and sisters
strength_note: Mars in 7th less harmful than 8th
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 178 Sodaranasa

input: Mercury as 3rd lord in 3rd, Mars and Moon and Saturn placement as specified (Ekabhagini)
outcome: Only one sister
strength_note: restricted form
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 179 Ekabhagini

input: 3rd lord in kendra and exalted Mars with Jupiter in a trikona from 3rd lord (Dwadasa Sahodara)
outcome: Third of twelve siblings
strength_note: only possible in Capricorn with Mars Jupiter; rare
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 180 Dwadasa Sahodara

input: 12th lord with Mars and Moon in 3rd with Jupiter, no Venus aspect (Sapthasankhya Sahodara)
outcome: Seven brothers
strength_note: navamsas gained by 3rd lord or Mars give number of siblings, benefics intervening fix survivors
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 181 Sapthasankhya

input: 3rd lord in benefic navamsa aspected or joined by benefics and Mars in benefic signs (Parakrama)
outcome: Great courage
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 182 Parakrama

input: Lord of navamsa of 3rd lord's navamsa lord in own vargas (Yuddha Praveena)
outcome: Capable strategist and expert in warfare
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 183 Yuddha Praveena

input: Exalted 3rd lord with malefics in movable signs or navamsas (Yuddhatpoorvadridhachitta)
outcome: Brave before the battle but loses nerve in actual conflict
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 184 Yuddhatpoorvadridhachitta

input: 3rd lord in fixed sign, fixed navamsa and cruel shashtiamsa and the sign lord debilitated (Yuddhatpaschaddrudha)
outcome: Gains courage only after the conflict begins
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 185 Yuddhatpaschaddrudha

input: 3rd house a benefic sign aspected by benefics and 3rd lord in benefic amsa (Satkathadisravana)
outcome: Interested in good literature and religious discourse
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 186 Satkathadisravana

input: 4th lord with benefics in kendra or trikona (Uttama Griha)
outcome: Owns good houses
strength_note: use Chandra lagna if lagna weak
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 187 Uttama Griha

input: 4th and 10th lords together with Saturn and Mars (Vichitra Saudha Prakara)
outcome: Acquires many mansions
strength_note: fits Libra Scorpio Capricorn Leo (4th lord Saturn or Mars)
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 188 Vichitra Saudha Prakara

input: Lagna lord and 7th lord in lagna or 4th aspected by benefics, or 9th lord in kendra with 4th lord exalted moolatrikona or own sign (Ayatna Griha Prapta)
outcome: Acquires house property with little effort
strength_note: without benefic aspect effort needed
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 189-190 Ayatna Griha

input: 4th lord in 12th aspected by malefic, or navamsa lord of 4th lord in 12th (12th from 4th, i.e. 3rd) (Grihanasa)
outcome: Loses house property
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 191-192 Grihanasa

input: Benefic 4th lord aspected by another benefic with Mercury in lagna, or 4th house or lord aspected by Jupiter (Bandhu Pujya)
outcome: Respected and loved by relatives and friends
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 193-194 Bandhu Pujya

input: 4th lord with malefics, in evil shashtiamsa, or in debilitation or enemy sign (Bandhubhisthyaktha)
outcome: Deserted by relatives or misunderstood
strength_note: general, little reliable
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 195 Bandhubhisthyaktha

input: Benefic in 4th, 4th lord exalted and Moon strong; or navamsa lord of 4th lord strong in kendra from lagna and Moon (Matrudeerghayur)
outcome: Mother long-lived
strength_note: waxing Moon in friendly kendra or trikona from 4th lord also gives long life
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 196-197 Matrudeerghayur

input: Moon hemmed by, with or aspected by malefics, or navamsa dispositor chain of 4th lord in 6th 8th 12th (Matrunasa)
outcome: Early death of mother
strength_note: all three afflictions together: mother dies right after birth; Jupiter aspect delays; afflicted 4th lord confirms; example mother died in 2nd year, another at 9 in Mars dasha Venus bhukti
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 198-199 Matrunasa

input: Moon or Venus in kendra with or aspected by malefic and evil planet in 4th (Matrugami)
outcome: Incestuous or immoral sexual conduct with mother-figures
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 200 Matrugami

input: 7th lord and Venus in 4th aspected by malefics or in cruel shashtiamsa (Sahodareesangama)
outcome: Immoral relations with sisters
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 201 Sahodareesangama

input: 4th house with malefic and 4th lord with or hemmed by malefics, or Saturn Mars Rahu in 4th with afflicted 10th lord, or 4th lord with Saturn Mandi Rahu (Kapata)
outcome: Hypocrite
strength_note: common in diplomats
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 202-204 Kapata

input: Benefic or exalted or friendly planet in 4th, or lagna lord in 4th aspected by benefic (Nishkapata)
outcome: Pure-hearted, hates secrecy and hypocrisy
strength_note: 4th lord free of Rahu Saturn matters most
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 205-206 Nishkapata

input: Mercury lord of lagna and 4th (Gemini lagna) with or aspected by malefic (Matru Satrutwa)
outcome: Hates mother
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 207 Matru Satrutwa

input: Lords of 1st and 4th are the same, friends or aspected by benefics (Matru Sneha)
outcome: Cordial mother-son relations
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 208 Matru Sneha

input: Lagna lord joins 4th 11th or 9th and is strong; or 4th lord exalted and its dispositor in kendra or trikona (Vahana)
outcome: Conveyances and comforts
strength_note: Venus with 4th lord in 4th: ordinary vehicles; in 11th or 9th: many; 4th lord with Moon: horse carriages or cars; example car bought in Venus bhukti of Jupiter dasha
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 209-210 Vahana

input: Jupiter and lords of lagna 7th and 5th all weak (Anapathya)
outcome: No children
strength_note: strong Jupiter and 5th lord modify it
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 211 Anapathya

input: Rahu in 5th aspected by Mars, or 5th a Mars sign with Rahu (Sarpasapa 212)
outcome: Death of children (serpent curse)
strength_note: only Cancer or Sagittarius lagna for second form
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 212 Sarpasapa

input: 5th lord with Rahu and Saturn in 5th with Moon aspect or association (Sarpasapa 213)
outcome: Death of children, sorrow
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 213 Sarpasapa

input: Jupiter with Mars, Rahu in lagna and 5th lord in dusthana (Sarpasapa 214)
outcome: Death of children
strength_note: void if Jupiter has strong shadbala; may show as abortions instead
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 214 Sarpasapa

input: Mars sign 5th house with Rahu and Mercury aspect or association (Sarpasapa 215)
outcome: Death of children
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 215 Sarpasapa

input: Debilitated Sun in 5th (Gemini lagna), or Sun in 5th in Capricorn or Aquarius navamsa, or Sun in 5th hemmed by malefics, or 5th lord Sun in trikona hemmed by malefics (Aries lagna) (Pitrusapa Sutakshaya)
outcome: Loss of children due to father's curse
strength_note: 5th house falling in Saturn's navamsa also indicates child loss unless relieved
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 216 Pitrusapa Sutakshaya

input: 5th and 8th lords exchange signs and Moon and 4th lord in 6th (Matrusapa Sutakshaya)
outcome: Loss of children due to mother's curse
strength_note: not possible for Leo or Aquarius lagna
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 217 Matrusapa Sutakshaya

input: Lagna lord and 5th lord in 8th and 3rd lord with Mars and Rahu in 5th (Bhratrusapa Sutakshaya)
outcome: Loss of children due to brother's curse
strength_note: 5th lord with Mars, or Mars and Rahu in 5th, also
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 218 Bhratrusapa Sutakshaya

input: Sun and Saturn in 5th, weak Moon in 7th, Rahu in lagna, Jupiter in 12th (Pretasapa)
outcome: Children die (curse of departed spirits)
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 219 Pretasapa

input: Rahu in 5th in navamsa other than Saturn's; or lord of navamsa of a planet joined with 7th lord in 1st 2nd or 5th (Bahuputra)
outcome: Many children
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 220-221 Bahuputra

input: Mars and Saturn in 5th and lagna lord in Mercury sign aspected by or with Mercury; or 7th lord in 11th, 5th lord with benefic and Mars or Saturn in 5th (Dattaputra)
outcome: Adopted children
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 222-223 Dattaputra

input: 5th lord in a dusthana (6th 8th 12th) (Aputra)
outcome: No children
strength_note: general; check 5th house strength
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 224 Aputra

input: 5th lord in kendra or trikona (Ekaputra)
outcome: Only one son
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 225 Ekaputra

input: Jupiter lord of 5th (Leo or Scorpio lagna) with Sun well placed (Suputra)
outcome: Worthy son
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 226 Suputra

input: Jupiter in 5th and 5th lord with Venus (Kalanirdesat Putra)
outcome: Son born in 32nd or 33rd year
strength_note: valid only if dasha supports
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 227 Kalanirdesat Putra

input: Jupiter 9th from lagna and Venus 9th from Jupiter with lagna lord (Kalanirdesat Putra 228)
outcome: Son born in 40th year
strength_note: dasha must support
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 228 Kalanirdesat Putra

input: Rahu in 5th, 5th lord with malefic and Jupiter debilitated (Kalanirdesat Putranasa 229)
outcome: Loss of children in 32nd year; author observes still-birth or death of all children in first year
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 229 Kalanirdesat Putranasa

input: Malefics in 5th from lagna and 5th from Jupiter (Kalanirdesat Putranasa 230)
outcome: Loss of a child in 32nd or 40th year; some survive
strength_note: aspect gives milder affliction
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 230 Kalanirdesat Putranasa

input: Benefic 5th lord aspected by a benefic or in benefic sign (Buddhimaturya)
outcome: Great intelligence and character
strength_note: works for any lagna if benefics occupy 5th and 5th lord is with Jupiter Mercury Venus
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 231 Buddhimaturya

input: Navamsa lord of 5th lord aspected by or with benefics and 5th lord benefic (Theevrabuddhi)
outcome: Precocious intelligence
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 232 Theevrabuddhi

input: Lagna lord with or aspected by malefics, Saturn in 5th aspecting lagna lord (Buddhi Jada)
outcome: Dullness of intellect (or loss of children)
strength_note: 5th lord with Mars and Rahu aspected by Saturn in inimical sign: near-insane dullness
source: Three Hundred Important Combinations (B.V. Raman), 233 Buddhi Jada

input: Jupiter in own navamsa in mrudwamsa, or in gopuramsa aspected by benefic (Thrikalagnana)
