input: Lord of rising navamsa strong
outcome: Happiness and comfort; strong rising drekkana lord: king-equal; strong lagna lord: ruler of the earth
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch3.11

input: Malefics in solar hora of odd signs
outcome: Strong, cruel, wealthy; benefics in lunar hora of even signs: brilliant, mild, graceful; otherwise opposite
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch3.12

input: Lagna and Moon strong and their sign lords strong
outcome: Long life without sorrow, famous
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch3.12

input: Rising drekkana is armed, noose, fettered, vulture-faced, bird, pig, or serpent or quadruped type
outcome: Poor, cruel, indigent
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch3.13-14

input: Rising drekkana in dual sign: 1st bad 2nd medium 3rd good; movable: reverse; fixed: bad, good, mixed
outcome: Quality of birth drekkana
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch3.14

input: Lord of rising drekkana, trimsamsa, dwadasamsa or hora strong in own varga, exaltation, friendly sign or with benefic
outcome: All virtues, long life, merciful, wealthy, children, royal comfort
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch3.15

input: Moon in own or friendly drekkana
outcome: Beautiful and good; in uttama varga very lucky
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch3.17

input: One planet in own or exaltation sign and aspected or joined by friend
outcome: King with riches
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch3.17

input: Planet is blazing (exalted), happy (moolatrikona), confident (own), delighted (friend), calm (benefic varga), capable (bright), tortured (defeated), base (malefic varga), distressed (enemy house), afraid (debilitated), failing (combust)
outcome: Avasthas of planets; effect full in pradeeptavastha, nil in vikala, proportionally between
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch3.18-20

input: Planet in northern position and brilliant wins planetary war
outcome: Winner of war; loser's results reduced
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch4.2

input: Sun and Mars strongest in 10th, Venus and Moon in 4th, Mercury and Jupiter in 1st, Saturn in 7th
outcome: Directional strength
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch4.2

input: Mars, Moon, Venus strong at night; Mercury always; Sun Jupiter Saturn by day; benefics in bright half and malefics in dark half
outcome: Temporal strength
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch4.1

input: Retrograde planet or one with full bright rays in debilitated or enemy sign
outcome: Still strong
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch4.4

input: Planet in own or exaltation sign but eclipsed (combust)
outcome: Weak
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch4.4

input: Lagna lord in upachaya house, or lagna aspected or occupied by lord, Jupiter or Mercury, or joined by Venus and not by others
outcome: Lagna strong
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch4.6

input: Planet in exaltation 1 rupa, moolatrikona three quarters, own half, friend one quarter, enemy little, debilitated or combust zero (positional strength)
outcome: Strength scale
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch4.7

input: Jupiter is the most powerful planet to ward off evil and promote prosperity; Mercury and Venus a fraction
outcome: Remedial strength order
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch4.11

input: Total shadbala needed: Sun 6.5 rupas, Moon 6, Mars 5, Mercury 7, Jupiter 6.5, Venus 5.5, Saturn 5
outcome: Below these a planet is weak
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch4.22-23

input: 10th house from lagna or Moon (whichever stronger) holds Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn
outcome: Wealth from father, mother, foe, friend, brother, wife, servant respectively
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch5.1

input: Navamsa occupied by 10th lord is Sun's
outcome: Livelihood through fruit trees, mantras, fraud, wool, medicine, metals, or service to a king
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch5.2

input: Navamsa of 10th lord is Moon's
outcome: Water products, agriculture, cattle, pilgrimage, service under a woman, cloth trade
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch5.3

input: Navamsa of 10th lord is Mars's
outcome: Metals, battle, cooking, land, gold, weapons, adventure, spying or theft
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch5.4

input: Navamsa of 10th lord is Mercury's
outcome: Poetry, scriptures, scribe or clerk, astrology, priesthood
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch5.5

input: Navamsa of 10th lord is Jupiter's
outcome: Support from Brahmins, gods or king, reciting Puranas, teaching, money lending
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch5.6

input: Navamsa of 10th lord is Venus's
outcome: Women, cattle, elephants, horses, dance and music, silver, scent, milk, ornaments, silk, poetry
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch5.7

input: Navamsa of 10th lord is Saturn's
outcome: Roots and fruits, labour, servants, base work, sculpture, carpentry, executioner or butcher
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch5.8

input: Lord of the navamsa occupied by the 10th lord is strong
outcome: Wealth without much exertion; weak: very little
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch5.9

input: 10th sign or the navamsa of 10th lord occupied or aspected only by its own lord, or in fixed sign
outcome: Earns in own country; if occupied or aspected by other planets: earns elsewhere
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch5.9

input: Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus or Saturn in a kendra in own or exaltation sign (Ruchaka, Bhadra, Hamsa, Malavya, Sasa)
outcome: Pancha mahapurusha yoga
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.1

input: Ruchaka yoga
outcome: Long face, daring wealth, brave, army leader, victorious
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.2

input: Bhadra yoga
outcome: Long life, keen intellect, clean, leader, very rich, good speaker
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.2

input: Hamsa yoga
outcome: King praised by the good, beautiful body, righteous
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.3

input: Malavya yoga
outcome: Strong limbs, resolute, wealthy, family, vehicles, learned, famous
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.3

input: Sasa yoga
outcome: Village head or king, strong, intrigues with others' women, usurps wealth
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.4

input: Pancha mahapurusha yogas counted from Moon as well
outcome: One yoga fortunate, two equal to king, three a king, four an emperor, five better still
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.4

input: Planet other than Sun in 2nd from Moon (Sunapha)
outcome: King or equal, self-earned wealth, wise
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.5-6

input: Planet other than Sun in 12th from Moon (Anapha)
outcome: Powerful, healthy, amiable, famous, well dressed, content
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.5-6

input: Planets in both 2nd and 12th from Moon (Durudhura)
outcome: Enjoyments, wealth, vehicles, generous, loyal servants
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.7

input: No planet in 2nd or 12th from Moon (Kemadruma)
outcome: Obscure, miserable, menial even if of royal birth
strength_note: Cancelled if planet in kendra from Moon or Moon in kendra or with planet
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.5-7

input: Benefic other than Moon in 2nd, 12th, or both from Sun (Subhavesi, Subhavasi, Subhobhayachari)
outcome: Handsome, brave, virtuous king; famous liked liberal; beautiful, eloquent, wealthy
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.8-9

input: Malefic in 2nd, 12th, or both from Sun
outcome: Slanderer low associates; deceitful abusive; dishonoured, without learning and luck
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.10

input: Benefics in 12th and 2nd from lagna (Subhakartari)
outcome: Long-lived, fearless, healthy, rich
strength_note: Malefics there (Papakartari): poor, impure, no wife or children, limb defect, short-lived
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.11

input: Benefic unaspected by malefics in 2nd from lagna (Susubha)
outcome: Good results like Sunapha
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.8

input: Benefic in 10th from lagna or Moon (Amala)
outcome: Virtuous, famous, wealthy, honoured by king
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.12

input: Day birth male with Sun, Moon, lagna in odd signs, or night birth female with all in even signs (Mahabhagya)
outcome: Ruler, liberal, famous, lives about 80 years; woman: wealth, long-lived husband, sons
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.14-15

input: Moon in kendra from Jupiter (Kesari)
outcome: Defeats enemies, eloquent, long-lived, famous, intelligent
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.14-16

input: Moon in 6th, 8th or 12th from Jupiter (Sakata)
outcome: Fluctuating fortune, ordinary, mental grief
strength_note: Cancelled if Moon in kendra from lagna
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.14-17

input: Moon in kendra, panaphara or apoklima from Sun (Adhama, Sama, Varishtha)
outcome: Lowest, middling, highest wealth, fame, knowledge, ability
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.14-18

input: All benefics in upachaya houses from lagna or Moon (Vasumat)
outcome: Plenty of money, stays at home
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.19-20

input: Moon's sign lord with lagna lord in kendra or friend's house and strong benefic aspecting lagna (Pushkala)
outcome: Wealthy, honoured by kings, eloquent
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.19-20

input: Benefics in 5th, 6th, 7th houses (Subhamala)
outcome: Governor, praised by kings, generous, good wife and sons
strength_note: Benefics in 8th 6th 12th: bad conduct, unhappy, quarrelsome, ungrateful
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.21-23

input: 9th lord and Venus in own or exaltation sign in kendra or trikona (Lakshmi)
outcome: Wealthy, healthy, brilliant, best of kings
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.21-24

input: Lakshmi yoga with Moon aspected by Jupiter (Gauri)
outcome: Beautiful, illustrious family, friend of king, good sons
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.21-25

input: Venus, Jupiter, Mercury in kendra, trikona or 2nd with strong Jupiter in own, exaltation or friendly sign (Saraswati)
outcome: Highly learned in arts, poetry and scripture, wealthy, family, respected by kings
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.26-27

input: Lagna lord, Sun, Moon in kendra or trikona in own, exaltation or friendly sign (Srikantha)
outcome: Devout of Shiva, magnanimous, powerful
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.28-29

input: Venus, 9th lord, Mercury so placed (Srinatha)
outcome: Wealthy, skilled in speech, devoted to Vishnu, good wife and sons
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.28-30

input: Jupiter, 5th lord, Saturn so placed (Virinchi)
outcome: Absorbed in Vedic knowledge, intelligent, wealthy, saluted by kings
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.28-31

input: Two bhava lords exchange signs including one of the 6th, 8th, 12th lords (Dainya)
outcome: Foolish, reviles others, sinful, tormented by enemies
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.32-33

input: Exchange involving 3rd lord (Khala)
outcome: Alternates between gentleness and wrongdoing, prosperity and distress
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.32-33

input: Exchange among lords of 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10, 11 (Maha)
outcome: Blessed by Lakshmi, wealthy, authority, vehicles, children
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.32-34

input: Lord of sign occupied by lagna lord exalted or in own sign in kendra or trikona (Kahala)
outcome: Prosperous, noble, respected
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.35-36

input: Lord of sign occupied by that lord also so placed (Parvata)
outcome: Lasting wealth and happiness, lord of earth
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.35-36

input: 9th and 10th lords in conjunction in an auspicious house (Raja yoga)
outcome: King with full retinue
strength_note: Kendra and trikona lords conjoined: Sankha yoga, comforts with women
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.37-38

input: Sankhya yogas (Veena, Dama, Pasa, Kedara, Sula, Yuga, Gola by seven planets in 7,6,5,4,3,2,1 signs)
outcome: Veena dance music wealth; Dama liberal king; Pasa opulent; Kedara agricultural land; Sula cruel indigent; Yuga heretic poor; Gola poor sinful short-lived
strength_note: Counted only if the earlier yogas are absent
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.39-41

input: Benefics in 7th, 6th, 8th from Moon or lagna (Adhiyoga)
outcome: Commander, minister, ruler by degree; famous, wealthy, long-lived, destroys enemies
strength_note: Police head, minister or district ruler per ordering
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.42-43

input: Bhavas occupied or aspected by benefics with strong lords in good houses (12 bhava yogas: Chamara, Dhenu, Saurya, Jaladhi, Chhatra, Astra, Kama, Asura, Bhagya, Khyati, Suparijata, Musala)
outcome: Chamara famous long-lived leader; Dhenu wealthy educated large family; Saurya valorous and loved; Jaladhi cattle wealth mansion honoured; Chhatra minister of king; Astra subdues foes quarrelsome; Kama devoted to wife; Asura tale-bearer poor; Bhagya wealthy honoured; Khyati king; Parijata king festive; Musala wealth with humiliation
strength_note: Order is bhavas 1 to 12
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.44-56

input: Bhava lord in 6th, 8th, 12th or bhava afflicted by malefics (Avayoga lagna, Nisswa 2nd, Mriti 3rd, Kuhu 4th, Pamara 5th, Harsha 6th, Dushkriti 7th, Sarala 8th, Nirbhagya 9th, Duryoga 10th, Daridra 11th, Vimala 12th)
outcome: Avayoga insignificant poor short-lived; Nisswa no kind words barren wife no children; Mriti defeated by enemies; Kuhu bereft of mother vehicles friends; Pamara miserable liar loses children; Dushkriti loses wife venereal disease trouble from king; Nirbhagya loses paternal property irreligious; Duryoga labour fruitless absent abroad; Daridra debts ear trouble menial
strength_note: Harsha (6), Sarala (8) and Vimala (12) are good: success over enemies, long life, thrift
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.57-69

input: Lords of 8th, 6th, 12th strong in kendras or trikonas while lords of 1, 4, 9, 10 weak or combust in 6, 8, 12 (Duryoga)
outcome: Failure and poverty; reverse gives a fortunate king
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch6.70

input: Three or more planets in own or exaltation sign in kendras (Maharaja)
outcome: Widely renowned king; five or more make ordinary-born a king
strength_note: Royal family needed for three; no Duryoga and no combust planets
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.1-2

input: A debilitated planet with bright rays, retrograde, in house other than 6th 8th 12th
outcome: Equal to a king; two or three such planets: king
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.3

input: Two, three or more planets with digbala (four or five other than Saturn for ordinary-born)
outcome: King
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.4

input: Vargottama rising navamsa or Moon vargottama and lagna aspected by four planets other than Moon
outcome: Low-born becomes king
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.5

input: Lagna lord in kendra or 9th vargottama and 9th lord in exaltation or own sign vargottama
outcome: King on a golden elephant
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.6

input: Bright Moon aspected by a planet in exaltation or own sign
outcome: Even low-born becomes king; full Moon in kendra other than lagna also gives a king
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.7

input: Mars in Aries, Leo or Sagittarius lagna aspected by friendly planet
outcome: Ruler of the earth
strength_note: 10th lord in 9th and 9th lord in 10th also makes a king
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.9

input: Sun and Moon in middle of Sagittarius, Saturn in lagna, strong Mars in exaltation
outcome: Mighty king whose enemies pay homage
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.10

input: Full Moon in Sun's navamsa with unafflicted benefics in kendras
outcome: King with many elephants
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.11

input: Full Moon and three strong planets in their own amsas aspected by benefics, not debilitated
outcome: King who vanquishes enemies
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.12

input: Moon vargottama aspected by strong planet with no malefic in lagna
outcome: Emperor with handsome body
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.13

input: Jupiter, Mercury, Venus or Moon bright and uncombust in 9th, aspected or joined by friends
outcome: Great king worshipped like a deity
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.14

input: Venus Jupiter Saturn in Pisces, near-full Moon exalted, Sun aspected by Mars, Aries rising
outcome: King with a vast army
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.15

input: Night birth, benefics debilitated or inimical in 11th, 6th, 3rd or exalted or all in kendras with Moon in Cancer in 10th
outcome: Emperor
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.16

input: Full Moon in vargottama navamsa
outcome: Mighty ruler of the earth
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.17

input: Jupiter and Moon in a kendra aspected by Venus with no debilitated planet
outcome: King of unparalleled fame
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.18

input: Moon in watery sign or amsa that is lagna or in own or benefic varga
outcome: King who does good to subjects; if no malefic in kendras and Moon outside kendra, king who oppresses people
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.19

input: Venus aspected by Jupiter (royal family); Jupiter in lagna not Capricorn; lagna lord strong in kendra; Mercury strong aspected by Jupiter
outcome: King or ruler of rulers
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.20

input: Single planet at highest exaltation point aspected by friends; Sun in own amsa with Moon in own sign
outcome: King
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.21

input: Full Moon in Pisces aspected by friendly planet, or full Moon exalted
outcome: Pre-eminent generous king
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.22

input: Moon in navamsa of very friendly planet aspected by Venus (wealthy king) or Jupiter (rules entire earth)
outcome: King
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.23

input: Malefics in 3rd, 6th, 11th from lagna lord or Moon sign lord; or Mars and Mercury in 2nd; or Sun and Venus in 4th; or Mars Saturn Jupiter in 10th, 11th, lagna
outcome: Raja yogas
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.24

input: One of 11th, 9th, 2nd lords in kendra from Moon with Jupiter lord of 2nd, 5th or 11th
outcome: Ruler of a full empire
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.25

input: Debilitated planet whose sign lord or exaltation-sign lord is in kendra from Moon or lagna (neechabhanga)
outcome: Just king; both lords mutually in kendra: emperor respected by kings; aspect by sign lord also gives ruler
strength_note: Debilitated planet in a kendra itself also counts
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch7.26-30

input: Sun in 1st house
outcome: Sparse hair, inactive, angry, tall, proud, lean; Cancer lagna cataract, Aries eye disease, Leo night-blind, Libra poor and lose children
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.1

input: Sun in 2nd house
outcome: Little learning and wealth, stammering
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.2

input: Sun in 3rd house
outcome: Strong, brave, wealthy, liberal, hostile to relatives
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.2

input: Sun in 4th house
outcome: No happiness, friends, land or house; serves state, spends inheritance
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.2

input: Sun in 5th house
outcome: No happiness, wealth, children; short life; intelligent, forest wanderer
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.3

input: Sun in 7th house
outcome: Displeases king, deformed, wanderer, no wife
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.3

input: Sun in 8th house
outcome: Loses wealth and friends, short life, defective sight
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.3

input: Sun in 9th house
outcome: Loses father; has children and revered gods
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.4

input: Sun in 10th house
outcome: Sons, vehicles, fame, wealth, strength, king
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.4

input: Sun in 11th house
outcome: Very wealthy, long-lived, king, no sorrow
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.4

input: Sun in 12th house
outcome: Hates father, weak eyes, no wealth or children
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.4

input: Waxing Moon in lagna
outcome: Strong, long-lived, fearless, wealthy; waning Moon reverses
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.5

input: Moon in 2nd house
outcome: Rich, learned or soft-spoken, sensual, a limb defect
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.5

input: Moon in 3rd house
outcome: Brothers, lustful, strong, miserly
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.5

input: Moon in 4th house
outcome: Happy, sensual, generous, friends, vehicles, renowned
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.6

input: Moon in 5th house
outcome: Good sons, intelligent, minister
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.6

input: Moon in 6th house
outcome: Short-lived, ignorant, stomach pain, humiliation
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.6

input: Moon in 7th house
outcome: Handsome, loved by a beautiful woman
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.6

input: Moon in 8th house
outcome: Diseases, short life
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.7

input: Moon in 9th house
outcome: Prosperous, virtuous, children, successful from the start
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.7

input: Moon in 10th house
outcome: Good deeds, helps the virtuous
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.7

input: Moon in 11th house
outcome: High-minded, long-lived, riches, children, servants
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.7

input: Moon in 12th house
outcome: Odious, miserable, insulted, indolent
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.7

input: Mars in 1st house
outcome: Injured limb, short-lived, cruel, adventurous
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.8

input: Mars in 2nd house
outcome: Ugly face, no learning or wealth, dependent on bad people
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.8

input: Mars in 3rd house
outcome: Good qualities, wealth, brave, happy, no brothers
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.8

input: Mars in 4th house
outcome: No friends, mother, land, happiness, house, vehicles
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.8

input: Mars in 5th house
outcome: Unhappy, childless, reverses, weak-minded
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.9

input: Mars in 6th house
outcome: Passionate, wealthy, famous, king, victorious
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.9

input: Mars in 7th house
outcome: Improper acts, disease, wanderer, loses wife
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.9

input: Mars in 8th house
outcome: Deformed body, poor, short-lived, cursed
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.9

input: Mars in 9th house
outcome: Friend of sovereign but hated by others, fatherless, may commit homicide
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.10

input: Mars in 10th house
outcome: King, cruel, liberal, praised
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.10

input: Mars in 11th house
outcome: Riches, happiness, brave, no sorrow
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.10

input: Mars in 12th house
outcome: Deformed eyes, cruel, no wife, slanderer
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.10

input: Mercury in lagna
outcome: Long-lived, sweet-spoken, clever, learned
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.11

input: Mercury in 2nd house
outcome: Earns by own talent, poet, attractive speech, good food
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.11

input: Mercury in 3rd house
outcome: Brave, medium life, good brothers, fatigue and dejection
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.11

input: Mercury in 4th house
outcome: Learned, witty, friends, land, grain, wealth
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.11

input: Mercury in 5th house
outcome: Learned, happy, courageous, many children, knows spells
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.12

input: Mercury in 6th house
outcome: Quarrelsome, harsh speech, idle, destroys enemies
source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara), Ch8.12

input: Mercury in 8th house
